obligations.quote: In accordance with Article 104 of Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code, the department shall examine or cause to be examined the accompanying construction documents and shall ascertain by such examinations whether the construction indicated and described is in accordance with the requirements of this code and other pertinent laws, rules and regulations.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Require submittal of an evaluation report by the manufacturer or approved agency for prefabricated construction assemblies with concealed mechanical work prior to work permit issuance.
obligations.quote: Prior to the issuance of a work permit for a prefabricated construction assembly having concealed mechanical work, the department shall require the submittal of an evaluation report by the manufacturer or approved agency on each prefabricated construction assembly, indicating the complete details of the mechanical system, including a description of the system and its components, the basis upon which the system is being evaluated for energy use, test results and similar information, and other data as necessary for the commissioner to determine conformance to this code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Provide evidence of mechanical systems commissioning and completion prior to final mechanical and plumbing inspections, including commissioning plan, systems adjusting and balancing, functional performance testing, preliminary commissioning report, and documentation.
obligations.quote: Prior to the final mechanical and plumbing inspections, the approved agency shall provide evidence of mechanical systems commissioning and completion in accordance with the provisions of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a Final Commissioning Report within 30 months for large buildings or 18 months for R-2 occupancies and other buildings, documenting test procedures, results, and disposition of deficiencies.
obligations.quote: Within 30 months for new buildings 500 000 gross square feet (46 451.5 m²) or greater, excluding R-2 occupancies, or within 18 months for R-2 occupancies and all other buildings, of the issuance of the certificate of occupancy or letter of completion, an approved agency shall prepare a report of test procedures and results, including test procedures and results performed after occupancy, identified as the "Final Commissioning Report," provide such report to the building owner, and submit a certification to the department with applicable fees in accordance with department rules.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 30 months for new buildings 500 000 gross square feet (46 451.5 m²) or greater, excluding R-2 occupancies, or within 18 months for R-2 occupancies and all other buildings, of the issuance of the certificate of occupancy or letter of completion
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Conduct and report results of whole-building air leakage testing in accordance with ASTM E779, ASTM E1827, ASTM E3158 or equivalent, with measured air leakage not exceeding 0.35 cfm/ft².
obligations.quote: The whole building thermal envelope shall be tested by an approved third party in accordance with ASTM E779, ASTM E1827, ASTM E3158 or an equivalent approved method. Air leakage shall be measured following a multi-point regression method and then averaged from depressurization and pressurization tests. A report that includes the tested surface area, floor area, air by volume, stories above grade, and air leakage rates shall be submitted to the building official and the building owner
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Examine construction documents and establish whether all required meters and measurement devices for end-use electrical energy monitoring are provided in buildings 10,000 square feet or larger.
obligations.quote: For electrical energy supplied to the building and its associated site, including but not limited to site lighting, parking, recreational facilities and other areas that serve the building and its occupants, meters or other measurement devices shall be provided to collect energy consumption data for each end-use category required by Section C405.14.2.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Receive and approve a letter of transmittal from the building owner acknowledging receipt of the Preliminary Commissioning Report before accepting buildings or portions thereof for final inspection.
obligations.quote: Buildings, or portions thereof, shall not be considered as acceptable for a final inspection pursuant to Chapter 1 of this code until the building official has received a letter of transmittal from the building owner acknowledging that the building owner or owner's authorized agent has received the Preliminary Commissioning Report.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Perform field inspections during construction to verify compliance with continuous air barrier requirements, proper material handling and storage, approved materials, proper surface preparation, and air barrier continuity.
obligations.quote: Reports from field inspections during project construction showing compliance with continuous air barrier requirements including proper material handling and storage, use of approved materials and material substitutes, proper material and surface preparation, and air barrier continuity shall be provided to the owner and, upon request, to the building official. Air barrier continuity shall be determined by testing or inspecting each type of unique air barrier joint or seam in the building envelope for continuity and defects.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Provide a Final Commissioning Report indicating compliance with continuous air barrier requirements to the building owner and, upon request, to the building official.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Test mechanical ventilation systems and verify they provide minimum ventilation flow rates required by Section R403.6 in accordance with ANSI/RESNET/ICC 380, with results signed and provided to the building official.
obligations.quote: Mechanical ventilation systems shall be tested and verified to provide the minimum ventilation flow rates required by Section R403.6 in accordance with ANSI/RESNET/ICC 380. Testing shall be conducted by an approved agency. A written report of the results of the test shall be signed by the party conducting the test and provided to the building official.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.action_summary: Test residential buildings for air leakage to determine compliance with maximum air leakage rate of 3.0 air changes per hour at 0.2 inch water gauge pressure.
obligations.quote: The building shall be tested for air leakage in accordance with Sections R402.5.1.3 and R402.5.1.4. Where required by the building official, testing shall be conducted by an approved third party. A written report of the results of the test shall be signed by the party conducting the test and provided to the building official.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city, and to repeal section 28-1001.2 of such administrative code relating to such conforming amendments

obligations.quote: Identify hard to count areas and populations, and community leaders in such areas and populations, by working with the department of city planning, office of immigrant affairs, the New York city housing authority, the New York city commission on human rights, and any other relevant office or agency
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of the census

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of the census
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.agency_full: director of the office of the census

obligations.quote: Work with leaders from all sectors across the city, such as businesses, cultural and education institutions, religious and social organizations, community-based organizations, labor unions, and disability advocacy groups, to promote awareness of the federal decennial census

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Inspect buildings within 14 days of receiving a rat or rat-attractant complaint, and conduct follow-up inspections within 20 days if initial access or completion was impossible.
obligations.quote: Within 14 days of receipt of a covered complaint, the department shall make its best effort to inspect the building to which such complaint pertains for signs of rat activity or conditions that attract rats
obligations.deadline_text: Within 14 days of receipt of a covered complaint
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to building inspections and reporting following complaints related to rats and conditions that attract rats

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Record inspection information including date, address, pass/fail determination, violations or abatement orders issued, and inspector observations during rat and rat-attractant inspections.
obligations.quote: During an inspection, the department shall record the following information: 1. The date of the inspection; 2. The street address of the building so inspected; 3. Whether such building passed or failed such inspection, as determined by the department; 4. If any notice of violation relating to the presence of rats or order to abate a condition related to the presence of rats is issued to the person in charge of such building in response to such inspection, the number of such notices of violation or orders to abate so issued; and 5. The inspector's observations of signs of rats or conditions that attract rats during such inspection or any subsequent inspection.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to building inspections and reporting following complaints related to rats and conditions that attract rats

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Make publicly available on a website inspection information collected during rat and rat-attractant inspections, viewable by address or through an interactive map.
obligations.quote: Within 30 days of completing an inspection pursuant to subdivision b of this section, or pursuant to any other lawful rat mitigation program inspection conducted by the department related to rats or conditions that attract rats, the department shall make publicly available on a website the information collected during such inspection
obligations.deadline_text: Within 30 days of completing an inspection
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to building inspections and reporting following complaints related to rats and conditions that attract rats

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Test no fewer than 3 different types of high visibility pavement marking products not currently utilized by the department, evaluating their durability, visibility in poor driving conditions, and operational feasibility for widespread use.
obligations.quote: the department shall test no fewer than 3 different types of high visibility pavement marking products that are not currently utilized by the department, except that if fewer than 3 such products may be procured by the department then only those products that may be procured shall be tested
obligations.deadline_text: No later than January 1, 2027
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to testing high visibility pavement markings and establishing a pilot program

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: If feasibility and safety improvement are determined, establish a pilot program to install high visibility pavement markings in at least 5 locations in each borough, prioritizing locations with histories of traffic-related injuries or fatalities.
obligations.quote: if the commissioner determines that a high visibility pavement marking would both be feasible to install throughout the city and likely to improve traffic safety during poor driving conditions, the commissioner shall establish a pilot program no later than January 1, 2028 to install such high visibility pavement markings in at least 5 locations in each borough
obligations.deadline_text: no later than January 1, 2028
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to testing high visibility pavement markings and establishing a pilot program

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report detailing the findings of the testing program, including challenges, issues, and a recommendation on whether to conduct a pilot program.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report detailing the findings of such testing program, including any challenges and issues presented by such testing program, and a recommendation on whether to conduct a pilot program
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 2 months after the conclusion of the testing program
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to testing high visibility pavement markings and establishing a pilot program

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: If a pilot program is established, submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report one year after its conclusion with a recommendation on whether to expand or make permanent the program and identifying any challenges and issues.
obligations.quote: if a pilot program is established pursuant to subdivision c of this local law, 1 year after the conclusion of such pilot program, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report that includes a recommendation on whether to expand or make permanent such program, and shall also identify any challenges and issues presented by such pilot program
obligations.deadline_text: 1 year after the conclusion of such pilot program
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to testing high visibility pavement markings and establishing a pilot program

obligations.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Develop written materials containing information about water safety and drowning prevention, and update the content each year to reflect changes in best practices.
obligations.quote: the department of parks and recreation shall develop written materials containing information about water safety and drowning prevention. Such department shall update the content of such materials each year
obligations.deadline_text: No later than August 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the distribution of materials on water safety in schools

obligations.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Post the written materials on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department shall post the written materials developed pursuant to this section on its website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the distribution of materials on water safety in schools

obligations.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Provide the written materials to the Department of Education for distribution to each school.
obligations.quote: The department of parks and recreation shall provide the department with the written materials developed pursuant to this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the distribution of materials on water safety in schools

obligations.action_summary: Distribute the water safety materials to each school to be shared with every student at the beginning and end of each academic year.
obligations.quote: The department shall distribute such materials to each school, to be shared with every student of each school, at the beginning and end of each academic year.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the distribution of materials on water safety in schools

obligations.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a feasibility study to determine the interest of New York City public high school students in being trained and certified as lifeguards, and submit findings to the mayor and speaker of the council.
obligations.quote: the department of parks and recreation, in consultation with the department of education, shall conduct a feasibility study to determine the interest of New York city public high school students in being trained and certified as lifeguards
obligations.deadline_text: by November 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to determining the feasibility of increasing high school student participation in the city lifeguard corps

obligations.action_summary: Stock airway clearance devices in all school buildings under its control within 180 days after FDA authorization and American Heart Association or American Red Cross issuance of choking-rescue protocols.
obligations.quote: the department of education and each private school and charter school shall stock airway clearance devices in all school buildings under their respective control
obligations.deadline_text: Within 180 days after (1) airway clearance devices have received authorization from the FDA for use as choking-rescue devices during choking emergencies for school aged children and (2) either the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross has issued choking-rescue protocols
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring all schools to stock airway clearance devices, and to repeal section two of such local law upon the expiration thereof

obligations.actor_raw: the department of health and mental hygiene
obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Offer training to relevant staff from the Department of Education, private schools, and charter schools in nationally recognized choking-rescue protocols prior to stocking airway clearance devices.
obligations.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall offer training to relevant staff from the department of education, private schools, and charter schools in accordance with nationally recognized choking-rescue protocols
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring all schools to stock airway clearance devices, and to repeal section two of such local law upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council an annual report on the number of airway clearance devices available in each school building and instances of use during choking emergencies.
obligations.quote: the chancellor shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report that shall include, for the prior school year: 1. The number of airway clearance devices available for use in each school building; and 2. The number of instances that an airway clearance device was used during a choking emergency, disaggregated by school building
obligations.deadline_text: No later than November 30 of the year after airway clearance devices are stocked pursuant to section 1 of this local law and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring all schools to stock airway clearance devices, and to repeal section two of such local law upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Maintain an interactive map on the department's website displaying information about each swimming pool under its jurisdiction, including address, operational times, contact information, events and programs offered, and planned maintenance or construction projects.
obligations.quote: The department shall maintain an interactive map on its website that shall include regularly updated information related to each swimming pool under its jurisdiction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an interactive map of information regarding department of parks and recreation swimming pools

obligations.action_summary: Maintain at least one epinephrine device in each school premises under its control in accordance with section 3000-c of the public health law.
obligations.quote: The department of education and any entity operating a charter school or nonpublic primary or secondary school shall maintain an epinephrine device in each school premises under its control
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring schools and child care programs to stock epinephrine devices

obligations.action_summary: Send a monthly email notification to all council members and community boards reporting all new sidewalk shed permits issued in the preceding month, disaggregated by council district and community district, including the reason for each installation.
obligations.quote: No later than the fifth day of each month, the commissioner shall send an e-mail notification to all council members and community boards containing a report of all new sidewalk shed permits issued during the immediately preceding month. Such report shall be disaggregated by council district and community district and shall include the reason for each sidewalk shed installation.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than the fifth day of each month
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city building code, in relation to providing community boards and elected officials with notice of sidewalk shed permits

obligations.action_summary: Submit a written response to recommendations from the board of correction ad hoc committee regarding the work release program, indicating which recommendations will be implemented and providing reasons for any recommendations the department declines to implement.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council and the board of correction a written response to recommendations published in a report from the board of correction ad hoc committee to review the utilization of the department's work release program
obligations.deadline_text: No later than March 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of correction work release program

obligations.action_summary: Submit a biannual report regarding utilization of the work release program covering six-month periods ending June 30 and December 30, with detailed disaggregated data on eligible, participating, declined, and ineligible incarcerated persons, and post such report on the department's website.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the board of correction a biannual report regarding utilization of the work release program for the six months ending on June 30 and December 30, and post such report on the department's website.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning on July 1, 2026, by February 1 and August 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of correction work release program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Records and Information Services
obligations.action_summary: Develop and maintain a centralized portal to process freedom of information law requests, with specified information fields in machine-readable and externally-searchable format.
obligations.quote: the commissioner, in consultation with the department of information technology and telecommunications or any successor agencies, shall develop and maintain a portal to process requests, whether such requests are received through such portal or sent directly to an agency by any other method.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 18 months after the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Ensure the website of every agency includes a link to the centralized FOIL request portal.
obligations.quote: The website of every agency shall include a link to the portal developed and maintained pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.action_summary: Upon receipt of a FOIL request by means other than the portal, enter the request into the portal and track its progress as required.
obligations.quote: Upon receipt of a request by means other than the portal developed and maintained pursuant to subdivision b of this section, the receiving agency shall enter the request into such portal and shall track the progress of such request as required by subdivision c of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Develop performance indicators in connection with statistical information required to be made available on the FOIL request portal, in consultation with the mayor's office of operations and as part of the mayor's management report.
obligations.quote: The department, in consultation with the mayor's office of operations and as part of the mayor's management report as required by section 12, shall develop performance indicators in connection with the statistical information required to be made available pursuant to paragraph 10 of subdivision c of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Submit an implementation plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council describing the steps necessary to implement the FOIL portal requirements and standards for tracking and filing requests and responses.
obligations.quote: Within 180 days of the enactment of this local law, the department shall submit an implementation plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council. The plan shall describe the steps necessary to implement the requirements of this local law, and the standards for the tracking and filing of requests and responses to such requests.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 180 days of the enactment of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.actor_raw: the department of records and information services
obligations.agency_full: Department of Records and Information Services
obligations.action_summary: Hold a public hearing at which members of the public may provide comments and feedback on performance indicators for FOIL request statistics, and finalize the performance indicators after considering public comments and feedback.
obligations.quote: the department of records and information services shall hold a public hearing at which members of the public may provide comments and feedback on such performance indicators. Such department shall finalize such performance indicators after considering public comments and feedback.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the creation of a centralized system for processing freedom of information law requests

obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence
obligations.action_summary: Create a poster including information regarding services available in the city to address gender-based violence, including free hotline services, and provide it to cosmetology establishments at no cost in each designated citywide language.
obligations.quote: The office shall create a poster that includes information regarding services available in the city to address gender-based violence, including, but not limited to, free hotline services. Such poster shall be provided to cosmetology establishments at no cost and shall be made available in each of the designated citywide languages
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to cosmetology establishments displaying resources regarding gender-based violence
obligations.committee: Committee on Women and Gender Equity

obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence
obligations.action_summary: Provide minimum requirements for cosmetology establishments that choose to design and print their own poster regarding gender-based violence resources.
obligations.quote: The office shall provide minimum requirements for cosmetology establishments that choose to design and print their own poster.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to cosmetology establishments displaying resources regarding gender-based violence
obligations.committee: Committee on Women and Gender Equity

obligations.action_summary: Collaborate with the other four borough presidents and, in consultation with the civic engagement commission, develop uniform training materials regarding the legislative process of the council and rules of parliamentary procedure.
obligations.quote: Each borough president shall collaborate with the other four borough presidents and, in consultation with the civic engagement commission, shall develop uniform training materials regarding the legislative process of the council and any additional relevant rules of parliamentary procedure.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: The department of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Make a learning platform available to, or assist in engaging a consultant for, the borough presidents to use in developing training materials upon request.
obligations.quote: The department of citywide administrative services shall make a learning platform available to, or assist in engaging a consultant for, the borough presidents to use in developing such training materials upon request.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: Each borough president, or a borough president designated by the other four borough presidents
obligations.agency: Each borough president, or a borough president designated by the other four borough presidents
obligations.agency_full: Each borough president, or a borough president designated by the other four borough presidents
obligations.action_summary: Provide training materials to the designated agency.
obligations.quote: Each borough president, or a borough president designated by the other four borough presidents, shall provide such materials to the designated agency.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.action_summary: Beginning on April 1, 2026, and annually thereafter, provide training to members and district managers of community boards within their respective boroughs using the developed materials, and record which community board members and district managers have completed such training.
obligations.quote: Beginning on April 1, 2026, and annually thereafter, borough presidents, in consultation with the civic engagement commission, shall provide training to members and district managers of community boards within their respective boroughs using the materials developed pursuant to subdivision b of this section. Each borough president shall record which community board members and district managers have completed such training.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning on April 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Within 30 days of receipt of training materials, distribute such materials to members of precinct community councils, members of community district education councils, and to the boards of directors of district management associations for business improvement districts.
obligations.quote: Within 30 days of receipt of the training materials provided pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision a of section 3-511, the designated agency or agencies shall distribute such materials to members of precinct community councils, members of community district education councils, and to the boards of directors of district management associations for business improvement districts.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 30 days of receipt of the training materials
affected_groups: business improvement district boards of directors
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Beginning July 1, 2026, and annually thereafter, provide training based on distributed materials to members of precinct community councils, members of community district education councils, and to the boards of directors of district management associations for business improvement districts.
obligations.quote: Beginning July 1, 2026, and annually thereafter, the designated agency or agencies shall provide training based on materials distributed pursuant to subdivision b of this section. Such training shall be provided to members of precinct community councils, members of community district education councils, and to the boards of directors of district management associations for business improvement districts.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July 1, 2026
affected_groups: business improvement district boards of directors
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to training local entities on legislative process and rules of parliamentary procedure
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: the department of consumer and worker protection
obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules to enforce the preauthorization holds disclosure requirements imposed on sellers of petroleum products.
obligations.quote: Any person who sells or offers for sale at retail any petroleum product for use in motor vehicles or motor boats shall conspicuously post at the place where payment is accepted a written notice indicating whether a preauthorization hold will be imposed
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring sellers of petroleum products for use in motor vehicles or motor boats to disclose preauthorization holds
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.action_summary: Make publicly available on the city's website a list of all artificial intelligence systems for which it has conducted a pre-deployment assessment, including system names, descriptions, developers, vendors, purposes, assessment dates, identified risks, recommendations, data access descriptions, and access by non-city personnel.
obligations.quote: the office of algorithmic accountability shall make publicly available on the city's website a list of all artificial intelligence systems for which it has conducted a pre-deployment assessment. The list shall include the following information
obligations.deadline_text: No later than March 31, 2027
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a list of artificial intelligence systems that have been assessed by the office of algorithmic accountability

obligations.action_summary: Update the list of artificial intelligence systems assessed by the office annually, ensuring no previously assessed systems are removed from the list.
obligations.quote: The list published pursuant to subdivision a of this section shall be updated annually, provided that no artificial intelligence system that has been assessed by the office of algorithmic accountability shall be removed from such list.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a list of artificial intelligence systems that have been assessed by the office of algorithmic accountability

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website a list of wheelchair repair providers that operate in the city, compiled based on information from other agencies, including specified details such as name, address, contact information, hours of operation, insurance providers accepted, and forms of payment accepted.
obligations.quote: The office shall post on its website a list of wheelchair repair providers that operate in the city. The office may compile such list based on information from other agencies about persons in the city that provide services or sell or lease products for persons with disabilities.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to providing information on wheelchair repair providers
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Disabilities and Addiction

obligations.action_summary: Update the list of wheelchair repair providers on its website no less than once each year.
obligations.quote: The office shall update such list no less than once each year.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to providing information on wheelchair repair providers
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Disabilities and Addiction

obligations.actor_raw: the department of health and mental hygiene
obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Post on its website a link to the list of wheelchair repair providers created by the office.
obligations.quote: The department of health and mental hygiene shall post on its website a link to the list the office creates pursuant to subdivision b.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to providing information on wheelchair repair providers
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Disabilities and Addiction

obligations.action_summary: Provide in response to a request from the public for information regarding how to locate wheelchair repair providers, a link to the list the office posts.
obligations.quote: The 311 customer service center shall provide, in response to a request from the public for information regarding how to locate wheelchair repair providers, a link to the list the office posts pursuant to subdivision b.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to providing information on wheelchair repair providers
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Disabilities and Addiction

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing basic compliance standards that all agencies must meet in developing, procuring, deploying, and using public-impacting artificial intelligence, including reporting requirements and standards for fairness, risk mitigation, monitoring, privacy protection, and verification procedures.
obligations.quote: The office shall promulgate rules establishing basic compliance standards that all agencies must meet in developing, procuring, deploying, and using public-impacting artificial intelligence. Such rules shall include reporting requirements for agencies to document compliance with such standards.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing basic compliance standards for the use of artificial intelligence by city agencies

obligations.action_summary: Review and update rules establishing basic compliance standards for public-impacting artificial intelligence at least every other year as necessary.
obligations.quote: Such standards shall be reviewed no less than every other year and updated by rule as necessary.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing basic compliance standards for the use of artificial intelligence by city agencies

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Conduct an advertising campaign to promote civil service examinations throughout the city using social media, agency websites, online advertising, television, radio, public transportation, and LinkNYC kiosks.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of citywide administrative services shall conduct an advertising campaign to promote civil service examinations throughout the city. Such campaign shall include promotion through social media; agency websites; online advertising; and advertising on television, radio, public transportation, or LinkNYC kiosks.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the promotion of civil service examinations
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.action_summary: Provide detailed information about each algorithmic tool reported, including name, description, purpose, data types, usage, vendor involvement, deployment date, modifications, and assessment results.
obligations.quote: Each agency shall provide the following information about each algorithmic tool reported pursuant to subdivision b of this section: 1. The name or commercial name, and a brief description of such algorithmic tool; 2. The purpose for which the agency is using such an algorithmic tool; 3. The type of data collected or analyzed by the algorithmic tool and the source of such data; 4. A description of how the information received from such algorithmic tool is used; 5. Whether a vendor or contractor was involved in the development or ongoing use of the algorithmic tool, a description of such involvement, and the name of such vendor or contractor when feasible; 6. The month and year in which such algorithmic tool began to be used, if known; 7. Whether, since the prior report, any modifications were made to the design or functionality of the tool that may affect the tool's outcomes; and 8. Whether such algorithmic tool has been assessed by the office of algorithmic accountability pursuant to subparagraph (a) of paragraph 1 of subdivision c of section 20-u of the charter, a summary of the result of such an assessment, and whether any corrective actions were conducted.

obligations.action_summary: Provide a victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program that includes the long-term health implications of physical violence including traumatic brain injury.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide a victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program designed to develop skills for the response to and investigation of incidents involving domestic violence, sexual crimes, or human trafficking. The training program shall include but not be limited to the following components: the dynamics of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking, including abuser tactics of power and control; danger and lethality factors in domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking cases; the criminal law provisions of the family protection domestic violence intervention act of 1994, chapter 222 of the laws of 1994; how to determine the primary aggressor in a domestic violence incident; the family offenses; the offense of endangering the welfare of a child; the offenses of assault in the first degree, manslaughter in the first and second degrees, criminally negligent homicide, and murder in the second degree, together with the defense of justification and the role of trauma in victims' acts of self-defense; the importance of avoiding expressions of skepticism, victim-blaming, and minimizing of the offense in early communications with victims; how to recognize signs of drug-facilitated sexual assault and preserve crucial evidence thereof; the overlap among domestic violence, sexual assault and human trafficking; victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning in domestic violence, sexual assault, human trafficking, and related cases; the effects of trauma on victims; the long-term health implications of physical violence including, but not limited to, traumatic brain injury; techniques of trauma-informed policing; the resources available to victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking, including shelter and nonresidential services, locating hospital-based sexual assault forensic exams, and domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking emergency resources; and any other training deemed relevant by the commissioner, except that the commissioner may eliminate a training component or replace a training component with an alternative component in order to provide a comprehensive victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a training program for first responders and a public awareness campaign regarding health effects of domestic violence-related traumatic brain injuries

obligations.action_summary: Develop materials regarding afterschool programs including program lists, eligibility requirements, costs, application processes, and provider contact information.
obligations.quote: The department shall, in consultation with the department of youth and community development, develop materials regarding afterschool programs, including but not limited to, afterschool programs funded by the department and those funded by the department of youth and community development.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Electronically distribute afterschool program materials to parents annually by October 1 and by February 1 for programs beginning after October 1.
obligations.quote: The department shall electronically distribute all materials developed pursuant to subdivision a of this section to parents annually by October 1 of each academic year. For any afterschool program beginning after October 1, all materials shall be updated to include such programs and redistributed to parents electronically by February 1 of the same academic school year.
obligations.deadline_text: annually by October 1 of each academic year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Distribute afterschool program materials in hard copy to each school for distribution to students annually by October 1 and by February 1 for programs beginning after October 1.
obligations.quote: The department shall distribute all materials developed pursuant to subdivision a of this section in hard copy to each school for distribution to every student of such school annually by October 1 of each academic year. Schools shall also distribute such materials to any student who transfers into such school after January 15 of the same academic year. For any afterschool program beginning after October 1, all materials shall be updated to include such programs and redistributed to students in hard or digital copy by February 1 of the same academic school year.
obligations.deadline_text: annually by October 1 of each academic year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Make all materials available in English, the 9 most common home languages of enrolled students, and additional languages as determined by the department, using plain, simple, and age-appropriate language.
obligations.quote: All materials developed pursuant to subdivision a of this section shall use plain, simple, and age appropriate language and shall be made available in English, the 9 most common home languages of students enrolled in schools, and in additional languages as determined by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Ensure all materials are provided to schools in sufficient quantity and made available in school offices, school websites, the department website, and online portals.
obligations.quote: The department shall ensure that all materials developed pursuant to subdivision a of this section are provided to all schools in sufficient quantity to satisfy the requirements of subdivision c of this section. Materials shall also be made available (i) in the main or central office of each school; (ii) on each school's individual website, if available; (iii) on the department's website; and (iv) on any online portal for students and parents.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.quote: The mayor shall establish an office for coordination of the transition to borough-based jails. obligations.action_summary: Appoint a full-time coordinator to head the office for coordination of the transition to borough-based jails.
obligations.quote: Such office shall be headed by a full-time coordinator, who shall be appointed by the mayor.

obligations.action_summary: Establish an interagency working group to provide recommendations regarding the cessation of housing incarcerated individuals in jails on Rikers Island and transition to other jails, with specified agency heads or their designees as members.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall establish an interagency working group to provide recommendations to the mayor, or to any agency affected by the cessation of housing incarcerated individuals in jails located on Rikers Island and the transition to housing incarcerated individuals in jails other than jails located on Rikers Island, about such transition
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a coordinator of the transition to borough-based jails and a department of correction coordinator for borough-based jail transition

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the city's website a strategic planning report with recommendations for cessation of housing incarcerated individuals on Rikers Island and transition to other jails, including programmatic and budgetary recommendations, projected timeline for construction, and recommendations for prospective use of Rikers Island.
obligations.quote: No later than May 1, 2026, the interagency working group shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the city's website a strategic planning report with recommendations relating to the cessation of housing incarcerated individuals in jails located on Rikers Island and the transition to housing such individuals in jails other than jails located on Rikers Island, including, but not limited to, any programmatic and budgetary recommendations; a projected timeline for constructing and opening jails other than jails located on Rikers Island; and any recommendations, including proposed implementation timelines, for the prospective use of any portion of Rikers Island for environmental, sustainability, or resiliency purposes after the cessation of housing incarcerated individuals in jails located on Rikers Island.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than May 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a coordinator of the transition to borough-based jails and a department of correction coordinator for borough-based jail transition

obligations.action_summary: Following submission of the strategic planning report, meet no less than once every 2 months and submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the city's website quarterly updates describing progress toward adoption or implementation of recommendations in the strategic planning report.

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a feasibility study examining vacant commercial space availability, temporary occupancy periods, financial considerations including rent payments, coordination with economic opportunity programs, potential grants up to $10,000 per business, and liability and indemnification requirements for resident-owned businesses.
obligations.quote: The feasibility study required by this section shall examine, among other factors, the availability of vacant commercial space or other appropriate spaces for use by businesses owned by a public housing resident; the appropriate temporary occupancy period of the commercial space; financial considerations, including appropriate rent payments for the use of such space; opportunities for coordination with the economic opportunities programs for residents of the New York city housing authority; the potential for providing financial assistance up to $10,000 to facilitate the establishment, expansion, or growth of some or all such businesses; and potential liability and indemnification requirements in connection with such use of space.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to including grants in the feasibility study on the use on a temporary basis of vacant New York city public housing authority commercial space by resident-owned businesses

obligations.quote: The agency or office shall be available by both email and telephone to communicate, as described in this section, with such residents between at least the hours of 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. every day in the year except Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays.

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Respond to inquiries submitted by residents displaced by qualifying events with information regarding timelines of services, agency inspection statuses, vacate order statuses, permit application statuses, personal artifact collection permissions, assistance from not-for-profits and government agencies, and relevant agency roles.
obligations.quote: The agency or office shall, in response to inquiries submitted by residents displaced by qualifying events, provide information that may include but need not be limited to: 1. The applicable timeline of services and deadlines following a qualifying event; 2. The status of relevant agency inspections; 3. The status of relevant vacate orders, such as whether a vacate order has been rescinded; 4. The status of permit applications filed by the owner of a relevant building; 5. Whether the owner of a building subject to a vacate order has requested permission from the relevant agency that residents be permitted to return to such building for the purpose of collecting personal artifacts, and, if applicable, whether the relevant agency has granted such permission; 6. Information about assistance offered by not-for-profit organizations or city, state, and federal agencies to residents displaced by a qualifying event, including information about the emergency housing services provided by the department of housing preservation and development; and 7. A summary of relevant agencies and their roles following a qualifying event.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
