obligations.action_summary: Upon rescission of a vacate order by the commissioner of buildings, housing preservation and development, or other relevant agency, provide notice of such rescission to the community board, borough president, council member, and affected residents via email, text message, or phone call if contact information is known.
obligations.quote: Upon the rescission of a vacate order associated with a qualifying event by the commissioner of buildings, the commissioner of housing preservation and development, or the commissioner of any other relevant agency, the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b of this section shall provide notice of the rescission of such vacate order to the community board, borough president, and council member representing the district where the qualifying event occurred, and, by email, text message, or phone call, if such contact information is known, to the residents displaced by the qualifying event that gave rise to the vacate order.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules for the implementation of the gratuity payment opportunity requirement, including specifying the form and manner of the opportunity to pay a gratuity.
obligations.quote: The department may promulgate rules for the implementation of this section, including specifying the form and manner of the opportunity to pay a gratuity pursuant to this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide an opportunity to pay a gratuity before or at the same time an online order is placed
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Relocate tenants requesting relocation services to suitable vacant accommodations in the same community district, an immediately adjacent community district, or the nearest community district in the same borough, without imposing any deadline or limitation of time on applications.
obligations.quote: Upon a request from a tenant applying for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph, such commissioner shall relocate such tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the same community district, or an immediately adjacent community district, as the building from which such tenant was displaced. If, following such a request, suitable vacant accommodations are unavailable in such same or any immediately adjacent community district, such commissioner shall relocate such tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the nearest community district in the same borough, where possible.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Provide temporary housing to tenants applying for relocation services upon request.
obligations.quote: For any tenant applying for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph, such services may also include the provision of temporary housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Not impose any deadline or limitation of time in which a tenant may apply for relocation services.
obligations.quote: Such commissioner shall not impose any deadline or limitation of time in which a tenant may apply for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.action_summary: Investigate deaths of incarcerated individuals in the department of correction's custody and prepare reports with recommendations about preventive measures.
obligations.quote: the board shall investigate such death and prepare a report about such investigation. Such report shall include any recommendations about measures the department or correctional health services may implement to prevent the circumstances that contributed to the individual's death.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit investigation reports to the department of correction and correctional health services for review.
obligations.quote: The board shall submit such report to the department and correctional health services for review by the department and correctional health services pursuant to subdivision h of section 9-171 of the administrative code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post investigation reports and departmental responses on the board's website.
obligations.quote: the board shall post such report and any response to such report from the department and correctional health services on the website of the board, provided that the board may post such report and any such response on any date after the department and correctional health services have provided such a response.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 30 days after the board submits the report to the department and correctional health services
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post statements on the website every 60 days indicating that an investigation has not been concluded, if the investigation exceeds 180 days from the death.
obligations.quote: the board shall, every 60 days until the board concludes such investigation and posts a report about such investigation, post on its website a statement that the board has not concluded such investigation
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide records received from the department and correctional health services to next of kin upon request, in accordance with the public officers law.
obligations.quote: the board shall provide to such next of kin records provided to the board by the department and correctional health services for purposes of such investigation in accordance with section 87 of the public officers law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Notify the office of chief medical examiner and the board of correction as soon as practicable, and no later than 3 hours, after becoming aware of a death of an incarcerated individual in custody.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the office of chief medical examiner and the board of correction as soon as practicable after becoming aware of a death of an incarcerated individual in the custody of the department, other than any such individual who the department has released pursuant to the work release program, provided that the department shall notify such office and such board no later than 3 hours after becoming aware of such death.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 3 hours after becoming aware of such death
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Make a good faith effort to notify the attorney of a deceased incarcerated individual as soon as practicable after notifying next of kin, and no later than 24 hours after notifying next of kin, or 48 hours after becoming aware of the death if unable to notify next of kin.
obligations.quote: The department shall make a good faith effort to notify the attorney of an incarcerated individual who has died as soon as practicable after notifying the next of kin of such individual as described in subdivision c of this section, provided the department shall notify such attorney no later than 24 hours after notifying such next of kin, and provided further that, where the department is unable to notify such next of kin within 48 hours after becoming aware of such death, the department shall notify the attorney of such death.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 24 hours after notifying such next of kin, and provided further that, where the department is unable to notify such next of kin within 48 hours after becoming aware of such death, the department shall notify the attorney of such death
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Document all efforts to notify the next of kin of a deceased incarcerated individual, including the employee name, next of kin name, communication means, relationship, and date/time of notification or attempted notification.
obligations.quote: The department shall document any efforts of the department to notify the next of kin of such incarcerated individual pursuant to section 3-10 of title 40 of the rules of the city of New York, and shall include the name of the employee of the department who notified or attempted to notify the next of kin, the name of the next of kin such employee notified or attempted to notify, the means of communication the department used for such notification or attempt to notify, the next of kin's relationship to the deceased incarcerated individual, and the time and date that the department notified or attempted to notify the next of kin.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Utilize interpretation services when notifying next of kin of a deceased incarcerated individual.
obligations.quote: Where applicable, the department shall utilize interpretation services pursuant to section 23-1102 for purposes of notifying a next of kin of a deceased incarcerated individual.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Notify the board of correction that the next of kin has been notified of the death.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the board of correction that the department has notified the next of kin of a death of an incarcerated individual pursuant to subdivision c of this section, after the department notifies such next of kin of such death.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post a notification about the death on the department's website with specified information about the deceased individual and facility within 24 hours of notifying next of kin, office of chief medical examiner, and board of correction.
obligations.quote: No later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin of the incarcerated individual, the office of chief medical examiner, and the board of correction pursuant to this section, the department shall post a notification about such death on the department's website.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin of the incarcerated individual, the office of chief medical examiner, and the board of correction
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Update website notifications to include the name, age, and race of the deceased incarcerated individual no later than 24 hours after notifying next of kin, when initial notification did not include this information.
obligations.quote: provided further that department shall update any such notification to include the name, age, and race of the incarcerated individual who has died no later than 24 hours after the department notifies the next of kin of such individual.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 24 hours after the department notifies the next of kin of such individual
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide contact information for a family member from the medical record of a deceased incarcerated individual when the department of correction requests such information.
obligations.quote: the department shall request that correctional health services provide contact information for a family member of such incarcerated individual included in the medical record of such individual, and correctional health services shall provide such information to the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post on the department's website information about how next of kin may obtain a deceased incarcerated individual's personal items and provide assistance to next of kin in obtaining such items.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on the department's website information about how the next of kin of an incarcerated individual who has died may obtain such individual's personal items, in accordance with applicable law and department policy, and to the extent practicable, shall provide assistance to such next of kin in obtaining such items.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Not dispose of personal items of a deceased incarcerated individual except in accordance with applicable law.
obligations.quote: The department shall not dispose of any such personal items except in accordance with applicable law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to recommendations in the department of investigation's report about a death of an incarcerated individual, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and providing reasons for any rejections.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report by the department of investigation about such death, including to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such a recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to recommendations in the board of correction's report posted on the board's website, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and providing reasons for any rejections.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report about such death the board of correction posts pursuant to subdivision i of section 626 of the charter to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit and post a report to the mayor and speaker of the council regarding employees under investigation for misconduct related to a death within 30 days of the board posting its investigation report or the attorney general completing its investigation.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and shall post on the department's website a report regarding any employee under investigation by the department for any misconduct in relation to such death.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 30 days after (i) the board of correction posts a report about an investigation by such board of a death of an incarcerated individual held or confined under the jurisdiction of the department pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision i of section 626 of the charter, and (ii) where the attorney general commences an investigation such death, such attorney general completes such investigation
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Redact identifying information and information prohibited from disclosure under federal or state law before submitting or posting the misconduct report.
obligations.quote: Before submitting such a report to the mayor or the speaker of the council or posting such report on the website of the department, the department shall redact any identifying information or any information prohibited from disclosure under federal or state law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit and post updated reports to the mayor and speaker of the council no less than once every 60 days until the investigation concludes.
obligations.quote: The department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and shall post on the department's website an update to any report required by this subdivision no less than once each 60 days until the department concludes such investigation.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Keep a record of any meetings or proceedings of the prison death review board.
obligations.quote: The prison death review board shall keep a record of any meetings or any other proceedings of such board.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide staff for the prison death review board.
obligations.quote: The board of correction shall provide staff for the prison death review board
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to recommendations in the department of investigation's report about a death of an incarcerated individual, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and providing reasons for any rejections.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report by the department of investigation about such death, including to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such a recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to recommendations in the board of correction's report posted on the board's website, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and providing reasons for any rejections.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report about such death the board of correction posts pursuant to subdivision i of section 626 of the charter to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the website of such contracted entity a community impact report for each economic development project.
obligations.quote: Each covered contract executed on or after the effective date of the local law that added this section shall require a contracted entity to submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the website of such contracted entity a community impact report
obligations.deadline_text: no less than 15 days before (i) the execution of an agreement between such contracted entity and the person or entity that undertakes an economic development project for the provision of an economic development benefit for such project, or (ii) the conveyance of title of such project from such contracted entity to such person or entity, whichever is later
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the posting of community impact reports for city-subsidized economic development projects

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing or adopting a standard governing the installation and location of natural gas alarms, and establishing requirements for natural gas alarms to be listed in accordance with the department standard.
obligations.citation: NYC Admin. Code § 28-315.2.4 and § 28-315.2.4.1; NYC Building Code § 908.13
obligations.quote: pursuant to rules promulgated by the commissioner of buildings or by the commissioner in consultation with the department of buildings and the fire department
affected_groups: occupants of class B multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York and the New York city building code, in relation to deadlines for installing natural gas detectors and to repeal section 908.10 of the building code relating thereto

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a determination of the market availability of battery-powered natural gas alarms, indicating whether at least 4 distinct manufacturers of compliant battery-powered natural gas alarms have been identified.
obligations.quote: No later than July 1, 2026, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a determination of the market availability of battery-powered natural gas alarms.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York and the New York city building code, in relation to deadlines for installing natural gas detectors and to repeal section 908.10 of the building code relating thereto

obligations.action_summary: If market availability determination indicates fewer than 4 distinct manufacturers of battery-powered natural gas alarms, extend by rule the installation deadline to January 1, 2029.
obligations.quote: If such determination indicates less than 4 such manufacturers, the commissioner shall by rule extend the date by which such alarms must be installed in accordance with section 28-315.2.4 to January 1, 2029.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York and the New York city building code, in relation to deadlines for installing natural gas detectors and to repeal section 908.10 of the building code relating thereto

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Remove or cause to be removed any vehicle, box, barrel, bale of merchandise, or other movable property or article or thing whatsoever found upon any street in accordance with regulations adopted by the commissioner.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall remove[,] or cause to be removed any vehicle, box, barrel, bale of merchandise, or other movable property or article or thing whatsoever found upon any street, in accordance with regulations adopted by the [board of estimate] commissioner.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Within 24 hours of identifying or receiving a report that a vehicle is abandoned, determine if such vehicle is an abandoned vehicle as described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law.
obligations.quote: Within 24 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report, determine if such vehicle is an abandoned vehicle described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law
obligations.deadline_text: Within 24 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Within 72 hours of identifying or receiving a report that a vehicle is abandoned, remove or cause to be removed such vehicle from the street if it is an abandoned vehicle as described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law and the vehicle identification number is not ascertainable.
obligations.quote: Within 72 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report, remove or cause to be removed such vehicle from such street, provided that such vehicle is an abandoned vehicle described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law and the vehicle identification number of such vehicle is not ascertainable by such department.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 72 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website information regarding the use of indoor basketball courts, including how to access indoor basketball courts under the jurisdiction of the department of education that may be used by basketball leagues on days when weather does not allow for the use of outdoor basketball courts.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on its website information regarding the use of indoor basketball courts, including, but not limited to, how to access, in accordance with department of education policy, indoor basketball courts under the jurisdiction of the department of education
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.actor_raw: The department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study on how to improve access to indoor basketball courts on days when the weather does not allow for the use of outdoor basketball courts, including analysis of the permit application process and feasibility of allowing public use on non-school days.
obligations.quote: The department of parks and recreation, in consultation with the department of education, shall conduct a study on how to improve access to indoor basketball courts, as defined in subdivision a of section 18-168
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.actor_raw: The department of parks and recreation
obligations.action_summary: Post the study on improving access to indoor basketball courts on the website of the department.
obligations.quote: The department of parks and recreation shall post such study on the website of such department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor and speaker of the council identifying at least 15 playgrounds that the department may open to public access after school on weekdays when school is in session, and from 8:00 a.m. to dusk on weekends and non-school weekdays, prioritizing environmental justice areas.
obligations.quote: the department of education, in consultation with the department and the school construction authority, shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report about playgrounds to which the department of education may provide access to the public after school on weekdays when school is in session, and from 8:00 a.m. to dusk on weekends and on weekdays when school is not in session
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 75 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an annual report to expand access to school playgrounds

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Prepare an annual report on providers of immigration assistance services including complaints, inspections, violations, investigation efforts, law enforcement collaboration, fraud trends, outreach events, and community education activities.
obligations.quote: The department shall prepare an annual report relating to providers of immigration services. Such report may be provided in a tabular format and shall include the following: 1. Complaints received related to providers of immigration assistance services, and the subject and source of such complaint; 2. Inspections conducted by the department, whether the inspection resulted in a violation, and the type of violation issued; 3. A description of the department's efforts to proactively investigate providers of immigration assistance services; 4. A description of the department's efforts to collaborate with other law enforcement agencies on investigation, enforcement, and community education efforts; 5. A description of changing trends in the provision of services and common fraudulent schemes; 6. Outreach events related to fraud prevention hosted or attended by department staff and for each such event, the number of staff hours dedicated to the event, the number of staff in attendance, the date, time, borough, council district, and zip code of the event; and 7. A description of the community outreach and education conducted by the department, including but not limited to the duration, languages, and costs relating to such outreach and education efforts.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than July 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Publish the annual immigration services report on the department's website.
obligations.quote: Such report shall be published on the department's website and submitted to the mayor, the speaker of the city council, and the public advocate no later than July 1 of each year
obligations.deadline_text: no later than July 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Engage in community outreach and education efforts to raise awareness about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services, complaint mechanisms, immigration-related legal assistance, and city services.
obligations.quote: the department shall engage in community outreach and education efforts to raise awareness about topics including but not limited to common fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services and the department's complaint mechanisms and services.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Create and distribute outreach materials identifying common fraudulent schemes and providing information about how to avoid them.
obligations.quote: Outreach materials shall identify common fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services and provide information about how to avoid common fraudulent schemes.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Conduct community outreach and education efforts via targeted media channels including internet and subway advertisements, and post and distribute outreach materials in public places including IDNYC registration sites, emergency response centers, asylum seeker resource centers, public schools, and city shelters.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct community outreach and education efforts via targeted media channels, including but not limited to internet and subway advertisements. Outreach materials shall be posted and distributed in public places, including but not limited to IDNYC registration sites, humanitarian emergency response and relief centers, asylum seeker resource navigation centers, public schools, and shelters or other facilities administered by city agencies for the provision of social services.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Make outreach materials available in all designated citywide languages and all temporary languages identified by the city.
obligations.quote: Outreach materials shall be available in all designated citywide languages, as defined in section 23-1101, and all temporary languages identified pursuant to section 23-1105.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to outreach about fraudulent schemes committed by providers of immigration assistance services
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Establish a program to implement curbside overnight parking areas for commercial vehicles within each industrial business zone where feasible.
obligations.quote: The department shall establish a program to implement a curbside overnight parking area for the exclusive use of commercial vehicles within each industrial business zone where the department determines such a program is feasible.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of curbside overnight truck parking in industrial business zones and to provide for the repeal thereof

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Allow commercial vehicles to park for at least 10 continuous hours in overnight parking areas, with hours of operation between 6:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m.
obligations.quote: allow commercial vehicles to park for at least 10 continuous hours, except that these overnight parking areas shall not be active between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of curbside overnight truck parking in industrial business zones and to provide for the repeal thereof
