obligations.action_summary: Include in annual reports information about written commitments to provide community benefits to community-based organizations or other persons for residents of neighborhoods or areas affected by the project, including the date of commitment, the recipient, and a summary of benefits committed.
obligations.quote: Whether, during such fiscal year, the contracted entity has committed in writing to a community-based organization or other person to provide community benefits for residents of a neighborhood or area of the city affected by the project, and if so: (1) The date of such written commitment; (2) The community-based organization or other person to which the contracted entity has made such commitment; and (3) A summary of the community benefits the contracted entity has committed to provide.
affected_groups: residents of neighborhoods affected by projects
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring an annual report by a contracted entity to include information about agreements to provide community benefits

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor and speaker of the council concerning a community hiring program promoting employment opportunities for low-income persons or persons living in low-income communities.
obligations.quote: Each covered contract executed on or after the effective date of the local law that added this section shall require a contracted entity to submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, on or before January 31 of each year, a report about a community hiring program
obligations.deadline_text: on or before January 31 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a contracted entity to publish an annual report concerning community hiring

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Post the annual community hiring report on the contracted entity's website.
obligations.quote: The contracted entity shall also post such report on the website of such contracted entity.
obligations.deadline_text: on or before January 31 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a contracted entity to publish an annual report concerning community hiring

obligations.actor_raw: the office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Conduct an annual review of all forms issued by designated agencies that collect demographic information and are completed by persons seeking services, to identify which forms are eligible for updating.
obligations.quote: Beginning no later than six months after the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision, and annually thereafter, the office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor, shall conduct a review of all forms issued by the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning no later than six months after the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision, and annually thereafter
affected_groups: persons seeking services from city agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation requiring city agencies to provide an "X" option for gender on certain forms
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: the office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council a list of all forms reviewed, all forms eligible for updating, explanations for forms not eligible, and indication of which forms shall be updated.
obligations.quote: The office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor, shall submit to the council within 60 days of such review, a list of all forms reviewed and all forms eligible for updating, and for forms not eligible for updating an explanation of why such forms are not eligible for updating, and indicate which forms shall be updated.
obligations.deadline_text: within 60 days of such review
affected_groups: persons seeking services from city agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation requiring city agencies to provide an "X" option for gender on certain forms
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.agency: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Update all forms identified as eligible for updating to invite responses about sexual orientation, gender identity, and gender pronouns, including an "X" option for gender identity where practicable.
obligations.quote: All forms identified as eligible for updating during the review required pursuant to this paragraph shall be updated to invite responses to questions about sexual orientation, gender identity and the gender pronoun or pronouns that an individual identifies with and that others should use when talking to or about that individual no later than five years from the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision. Any such update shall, where practicable, include "X" as an option when gender identity information is collected.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than five years from the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision
affected_groups: persons seeking services from city agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation requiring city agencies to provide an "X" option for gender on certain forms
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.agency: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Provide forms not eligible for updating in conjunction with the standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form established by the charter.
obligations.quote: All forms not eligible for updating shall be provided in conjunction with the standardized, anonymous and voluntary demographics information survey form as established by paragraph 1 of subdivision k of this section.
affected_groups: persons seeking services from city agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation requiring city agencies to provide an "X" option for gender on certain forms
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.action_summary: Prohibit covered helicopters from conducting non-essential flights to or from the heliport, except as directed by an aviation control tower or air traffic control center or in emergency circumstances.
obligations.quote: The operator of any heliport shall prohibit covered helicopters from conducting non-essential flights to or from any such heliport, except as otherwise directed by an aviation control tower or air traffic control center or in emergency circumstances where such operation is necessary to protect life, property or the public health and safety.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating helicopter operations at city owned heliports to reduce noise

obligations.action_summary: Follow the procedure outlined in 49 U.S.C. § 47524(b) and 14 CFR Part 36, Subpart C before implementing the non-essential flight restrictions, and do not implement such restrictions until 180 days after the publishing and public comment period have commenced.
obligations.quote: Prior to implementing the restrictions set forth in subdivision b of this section, the airport operator shall follow the procedure outlined in subsection (b) of section 47524 of title 49 of the United States code and subpart C of part 36 of title 14 of the code of federal regulations.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating helicopter operations at city owned heliports to reduce noise

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Require in each covered contract executed on or after the effective date that the contracted entity submit to the mayor and speaker of the city council a report detailing the percentage of non-essential flights by covered helicopters during the previous calendar year.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall require that, no later than April 1 of each year, the contracted entity submit to the mayor and the speaker of the city council a report detailing the percentage of flights by covered helicopters to or from a heliport that were non-essential flights during the previous calendar year.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than April 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating helicopter operations at city owned heliports to reduce noise

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post on its website and update three times per year detailed information about each non-benchmark capital project, including project description, location, agency responsibility, design, phases, status, delays, community board presentations, funding, contractor information, and cost overruns.
obligations.quote: For each non-benchmark project, the department shall post on its website, and update three times per year, at least the following information
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the commissioner of transportation to create an online capital project tracker

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the department's website an annual update regarding changes to the streets master plan, bicycle lane network coverage index, benchmark status, dataset, benchmark project descriptions, and beginning February 1, 2028, the bicycle connectivity index and description of traffic infrastructure installation in underserved neighborhood tabulation areas.
obligations.quote: By February 1, 2023 and by each February 1 thereafter, the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website an update regarding any changes to the plan from the previous year, the bicycle lane network coverage index, and the status of the implementation of each benchmark identified in such plan
obligations.deadline_text: By February 1, 2023 and by each February 1 thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post on its website and update three times per year a comprehensive description, benchmark linkage, agency responsibility, project liaison contact, design checklist link, timeline, completion progress representation, monthly status updates, delay descriptions, community board presentation information, funding details, contractor and procurement information, and cost overrun information for each benchmark project.
obligations.quote: For each benchmark project, the department shall post on its website, and update three times per year, except where indicated otherwise, at least the following information
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.action_summary: Provide to persons submitting tree pruning complaints or service requests a link to the map required by section 18-157(c)(5), a link to the department of parks and recreation website page with tree pruning information and maps of completed and scheduled activities, and information or resources about a volunteer tree pruning training and certification program.
obligations.quote: The 311 customer service center, in consultation with the department of parks and recreation, shall provide to any person who submits a complaint or request for service relating to the pruning of any tree under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation: 1. A link to the map required by paragraph 5 of subdivision c of section 18-157; 2. A link to a page of the website of the department of parks and recreation that includes information about tree pruning and a map showing completed and scheduled tree pruning activities by such department; and 3. Information or resources about a program to train and certify volunteers in the pruning of trees.
affected_groups: residents submitting tree pruning complaints or requests
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the 311 customer service center to provide certain resources in response to tree pruning-related requests

obligations.action_summary: Develop guidance for facilitating safe evacuation before flash flood emergencies, including information on avoiding flash flood dangers, when and how to safely evacuate flood-prone locations, and existing public or private refuge facilities.
obligations.quote: The office shall develop guidance for facilitating safe evacuation before flash flood emergencies. Such guidance shall include but need not be limited to: (i) information on how residents may avoid the dangers of flash flooding events; (ii) guidance on how and when to safely evacuate a location prone to flash flooding prior to a flash flood event, and (iii) existing public or private facilities suitable for individuals seeking refuge in anticipation of a flash flood event.
obligations.deadline_text: within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Include guidance for facilitating safe evacuation before flash flood emergencies in the office's annual report.
obligations.quote: Such guidance shall be included in the office's annual report within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section.
obligations.deadline_text: within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Establish an outreach program to increase registration for Notify NYC alerts and coordinate efforts across agencies to increase public awareness of appropriate responses to flash flood risks, including evacuation planning, through distribution of emergency preparedness materials and information in-person, mass mail, guidance for building and property owners, and other appropriate means.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall establish an outreach program to increase registration for Notify NYC alerts and to coordinate efforts across agencies to increase public awareness regarding the appropriate responses by members of the public to flash flood risks, including evacuation planning established pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Include in annual report details of the outreach program, including the locations selected for outreach.
obligations.quote: Within 1 year of the enactment of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter, the office shall include in their annual report the details of the outreach program established by subdivision c, including the locations selected for outreach.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 1 year of the enactment of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Develop criteria, including a rating system, for the prioritization for maintenance of any tree under the department's jurisdiction that is adjacent to a building or other structure.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop criteria, including a rating system, for the prioritization for maintenance of any tree that is: (i) under the jurisdiction of the commissioner; and (ii) adjacent to a building or other structure.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prioritization of maintenance of trees adjacent to buildings and structures

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website the criteria developed and information about the development of such criteria.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on its website the criteria developed in subdivision a and information about the development of such criteria.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prioritization of maintenance of trees adjacent to buildings and structures

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: File a strategic planning report with the mayor, speaker, public advocate, borough presidents, and community boards establishing and maintaining a citywide public bathroom network that meets or exceeds a target metric of 2,120 public bathrooms, of which at least half shall be publicly owned.
obligations.quote: the relevant agency shall file with the mayor, the speaker of the council, the public advocate, each borough president, and each community board a strategic planning report to establish and maintain a citywide public bathroom network.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 1, 2026, and every fourth year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a long-term citywide bathroom strategy and to make other technical changes
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Post or update on its website and make compatible for access on a mobile device a map of existing and planned public bathrooms with specified information including hours of operation, repair status, accessibility, fees, maintenance responsibility, expected opening dates, and facility features.
obligations.quote: an agency or office designated by the mayor shall post or update on its website and make compatible for access on a mobile device a map of existing and planned public bathrooms.
obligations.deadline_text: Upon the submission of the report required by subdivision b of this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a long-term citywide bathroom strategy and to make other technical changes
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.action_summary: Waive civil service examination fees for high school students who provide verifiable identification and for first-time applicants.
obligations.quote: The department may waive the fee for a civil service examination for any individual who meets one of the following conditions at the time of filing for the examination: 1. The individual is a high school student who provides a verifiable form of identification; or 2. The individual has not previously filed for a civil service examination administered by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to civil service examination fee waivers for high school students and first time applicants
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.action_summary: Propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website at least 90 days prior to the use of any new and distinct surveillance technology.
obligations.quote: The department shall propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website, at least 90 days prior to the use of any new and distinct surveillance technology.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Update an existing impact and use policy to describe a new but not distinct surveillance technology that has the same function but substantially differs in form or has a different manufacturer or product name.
obligations.quote: The department shall update an existing impact and use policy to describe a new, but not distinct, surveillance technology, which has the same function but substantially differs in form or has a different manufacturer or product name.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Identify the manufacturer and product name of each surveillance technology addressed by the impact and use policy in the policy document itself, or provide a particularized public explanation if disclosure would endanger safety or interfere with an active investigation.
obligations.quote: A surveillance technology impact and use policy shall identify the manufacturer and product name of each surveillance technology that is addressed by the impact and use policy, including the specific capability and component of the surveillance technology that is addressed by such policy if such product is listed in more than one such policy, provided that where disclosure of such manufacturer or product name would endanger the safety of the public or officers or interfere with an active investigation, and where such information is not already publicly known, the department shall not publicly disclose such manufacturer or product name, or both, to the extent such disclosure would pose such a risk.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website within 180 days of the effective date of the local law that originally added this section.
obligations.quote: For existing surveillance technology as of the effective date of the local law that added this section, the department shall propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website within 180 days of such effective date.
obligations.deadline_text: within 180 days of such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide an addendum to the existing surveillance technology impact and use policy when acquiring enhancements to surveillance technology or using such technology for a purpose or manner not previously disclosed, unless the change involves only routine patches, firmware or software updates, or hardware lifecycle replacements.
obligations.quote: When the department seeks to acquire or acquires enhancements to surveillance technology or uses such surveillance technology for a purpose or in a manner not previously disclosed through the surveillance technology impact and use policy, the department shall provide an addendum to the existing surveillance technology impact and use policy describing such enhancement or additional use.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Consider public comments and provide the final surveillance technology impact and use policy to the speaker and the mayor, and post it on the department's website no more than 45 days after the close of the public comment period.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall consider public comments and provide the final surveillance technology impact and use policy to the speaker and the mayor, and shall post it on the department's website no more than 45 days after the close of the public comment period established by subdivision e of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: no more than 45 days after the close of the public comment period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Create an internal tracking system documenting each instance in which the department provides external entities with data collected using surveillance technology, including the name of the entity and the date the data was provided.
obligations.quote: Such tracking system shall document each instance in which the department provides an external entity with data collected by the department using a surveillance technology, including the name of the entity and the date that such data was provided.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 270 days of the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Develop an internal tracking system listing each local, state, or federal government agency that has direct access to data collected using surveillance technology and the extent and dates of such access.
obligations.quote: the department shall develop an internal tracking system listing each local, state, or federal government agency that has direct access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology and the extent of the data to which the agency has direct access and for which dates the agency has direct access.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 270 days of the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Develop a policy regarding the circumstances under which any local, state, or federal government agency has access to data collected using surveillance technology, including when data can or must be shared, criteria for sharing, and which data goes to which agencies under which circumstances.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop a policy regarding the circumstances under which any local, state, or federal government agency has access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Identify in the intergovernmental data sharing policy the local, state, or federal government agencies that the department knows participate in any task force that has access to surveillance data.
obligations.quote: Such policy shall identify the local, state or federal government agencies that the department knows participate in any task force that has access to such data, provided that such policy need not specify the policy of the entity that maintains such data for such task force that governs the sharing of such data with such agencies.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Identify in the intergovernmental data sharing policy whether the department has actual knowledge that law enforcement agencies with access to surveillance data share such data with United States immigration and customs enforcement or United States customs and border protection, and identify measures taken to minimize the risk of such data being used for civil immigration enforcement.
obligations.quote: Such policy shall identify whether the department has any actual knowledge that law enforcement agencies with access to such data share such data with United States immigration and customs enforcement or United States customs and border protection and under which circumstances. Such policy shall also identify which measures, if any, the department takes to minimize the risk of such data being used for civil immigration enforcement.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a review of evidence of physical safety hazards posed by surveillance technologies used by the department within 270 days of the effective date and annually thereafter, and include any identified physical hazards in the surveillance technology impact and use policy.
obligations.quote: Within 270 days of the local law that added this section and annually thereafter, the department shall conduct a review of evidence of physical safety hazards posed by surveillance technologies used by the department, including but not limited to evaluations by experts in the field, and shall include any identified physical hazards in the surveillance technology impact and use policy.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 270 days of the local law that added this section and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.actor_raw: the New York city police department
obligations.action_summary: Update and publish new surveillance technology impact and use policies to bring existing impact and use policies into compliance with this local law, including policies for surveillance technologies that were not new at enactment but would have resulted in additional disclosures had this law been in effect.
obligations.quote: within 270 days of the effective date of this local law, the New York city police department shall update and publish new surveillance technology impact and use policies to bring existing impact and use policies into compliance with this local law, including by updating and publishing new surveillance technology impact and use policies to disclose information on surveillance technologies that were not new at the time of the enactment of this local law but which would have resulted in additional disclosures had this local law been in effect at the time that such surveillance technologies were new.
obligations.deadline_text: within 270 days of the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Create and post on its website a written policy establishing procedures for the department's use of facial recognition technologies, including descriptions of use, restrictions on access and use, and data retention policies.
obligations.quote: The department shall create and post on its website a written policy that establishes procedures for the department's use of facial recognition technologies.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a police department policy for using facial recognition technology and regular audits to ensure compliance

obligations.action_summary: Ensure the facial recognition policy includes guidelines requiring documentation of any modifications made to images used for comparison analysis, including descriptions and dates of modifications, and maintenance of such documentation and copies of all modified images.
obligations.quote: The policy established pursuant to subdivision a of this section shall include guidelines related to the modification of the original image used for comparison analysis by facial recognition technology.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a police department policy for using facial recognition technology and regular audits to ensure compliance

obligations.action_summary: Conduct an annual audit of its use of facial recognition technology documenting the total number of comparison requests, instances of application disaggregated by matches and rejections, instances for felony and misdemeanor investigations, and publish the audit on the department's website and provide it to the department of investigation.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct an annual audit of its use of facial recognition technology. Such audit shall be documented and provided to the department of investigation and published on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a police department policy for using facial recognition technology and regular audits to ensure compliance

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access upon request to an itemized list of all surveillance technologies used by the department, including specifications of functionality, types of data collected, and which department unit maintains control of information collected.
obligations.quote: Upon request, the department shall provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access to the following information: an itemized list of all surveillance technologies used by the department, including specifications of the functionality of each such technology, the types of data collected by each such technology, and which department unit maintains control of information collected by each such technology
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access upon request to all access and retention policies for data collected by surveillance technologies used by the department, including those in contracts with procurement entities.
obligations.quote: any access and retention policies for data collected by surveillance technologies used by the department, including any access and retention policies included in contracts with entities from which the department procures such surveillance technologies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation semiannually with a list of all surveillance technologies acquired or discontinued during the prior six months and all access and retention policies for data collected by such surveillance technologies in executed procurement contracts.
obligations.quote: the department shall provide the commissioner of investigation with a list of all surveillance technologies that were acquired by the department, or which the department discontinued using, during the prior six months, and all access and retention policies for data collected by such surveillance technologies included in any executed contracts with entities from which the department procured such surveillance technology during the prior six months
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2025, and semiannually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide access to benefits and services to every person with HIV who requests assistance.
obligations.quote: There shall be a division [of AIDS services] within the New York city department of social services[. Such division shall] to provide access to benefits and services, as defined in section 21-128(a)(1) [of this chapter], to every person [with clinical/symptomatic HIV illness, as determined by the New York state department of health AIDS institute, or with AIDS, as defined by the federal centers for disease control and prevention,] with HIV who requests assistance
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Direct staff of the division to provide intensive case management with specified caseworker-to-client ratios and transportation and nutrition allowances to persons with HIV satisfying medicaid income eligibility requirements.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall direct staff of the division [of AIDS services] established pursuant to section 21-126 to provide to persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness, as determined by the New York state department of health AIDS institute, or persons with AIDS, as defined by the federal centers for disease control and prevention,] HIV who satisfy the income eligibility requirements for medicaid as set forth in section 1396 et. seq. of title 42 of the United States code: (i) intensive case management with an average ratio which shall not exceed [one] 1 caseworker or supervisor to [twenty-five] 25 family cases, and with an overall average ratio for all cases which shall not exceed [one] 1 caseworker or supervisor to [thirty-four] 34 cases; and (ii) transportation and nutrition allowances.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Establish criteria within 30 days of effective date pursuant to which an applicant shall be entitled to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of establishing eligibility and applying for benefits and services.
obligations.quote: Within [thirty] 30 days of the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall establish criteria pursuant to which an applicant shall be entitled to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of establishing eligibility and applying for benefits and services.
obligations.deadline_text: Within [thirty] 30 days of the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every person with HIV who applies for benefits and services with a receipt on the day of application or submission of documents, including date, description of information received, and statement of completeness.
obligations.quote: Upon written or oral application to the division for benefits and services or submission of documents required to establish eligibility for benefits and services by a person with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV, such person shall immediately be provided with a receipt which shall include, but not be limited to, the date, a description of the information received, and a statement as to whether any application for such benefits and services is complete or incomplete, and if incomplete, such receipt shall identify any information or documents needed in order for the application to be deemed complete.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every homeless client determined eligible for services with an application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing and information regarding financial assistance and housing options on the day eligibility is determined.
obligations.quote: Unless the client shall decline, the division shall provide the following to every homeless client of the division on the day the client is determined to be eligible for services as a client of the division: [(i)] (1) an application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing; and [(ii)] (2) information regarding financial assistance available to assist eligible clients in obtaining housing and regarding available housing options.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Ensure every client receives assistance needed to complete the application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing within 10 business days of the day the client is determined eligible for division services.

obligations.deadline_text: within 10 business days of the day on which the client is determined to be eligible for services as a client of the division
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every client eligible for non-emergency housing with a referral to an available medically appropriate non-emergency housing option within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or completion of physical documentation, whichever is sooner.
obligations.quote: Within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or of completion of the physical documentation required from the client for the application for non-emergency housing, whichever is sooner, the division must provide every client who is eligible for non-emergency housing a referral to an available medically appropriate non-emergency housing option, which takes into consideration the medical, educational and familial needs and social circumstances of the client, to the extent such option is available.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or of completion of the physical documentation required from the client for the application for non-emergency housing, whichever is sooner
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide a referral to another medically appropriate non-emergency housing option for any client who remains homeless or in emergency housing for over 45 days after housing referral requirements have been met.
obligations.quote: For any client who remains homeless or in emergency housing for over 45 days after the requirements of subparagraph (c) of this paragraph or the requirements of this subparagraph have been met, the division shall provide a referral to another medically appropriate non-emergency housing option, to the extent such option is available.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a draft policy and procedures manual for division staff within 60 days of effective date, including guidelines on confidentiality, medical/psychological needs, application procedures, eligibility standards, mandated time periods for benefits and services, and advocacy resources.
obligations.quote: [Not] No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall prepare a draft policy and procedures manual for division staff. Such policy and procedures manual shall include, but not be limited to, strict guidelines on maintaining the confidentiality of the identity of and information relating to all applicants and recipients, instructional materials relating to the medical and psychological needs of persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV, application procedures, eligibility standards, mandated time periods for the provision of each benefit and service available to applicants and recipients and advocacy resources available to persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Update the list of advocacy resources in the policy and procedures manual on a semi-annual basis.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.deadline_text: Within [thirty] 30 days following the preparation of such draft policy and procedure manual
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a final policy and procedures manual within 30 days after conclusion of the public hearing and thereafter review and revise on an annual basis.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall prepare a final policy and procedures manual within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing and shall thereafter review and where appropriate, revise such policy and procedures manual on an annual basis.
obligations.deadline_text: within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide for semi-annual training, using such policy and procedures manual, for all division staff.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Publish a proposed rule establishing a bill of rights for persons with HIV within 60 days of effective date, including benefits and services, timetables, file examination rights, home/hospital visit rights, hearing process, and anti-discrimination remedies.
obligations.quote: [Not] No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall publish a proposed rule establishing a bill of rights for persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV. Such draft bill of rights shall include, but not be limited to, an explanation of the benefits and services for which persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV may be eligible; timetables within which such benefits and services shall be provided to eligible persons; an explanation of an applicant's and recipient's right to examine [his or her] such applicant's and recipient's file and the procedure for disputing any information contained therein; an explanation of an applicant's and recipient's right to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of applying for or maintaining benefits or services; an explanation of the process for requesting a division conference or New York state fair hearing; and a summary of the rights and remedies for the redress of discrimination as provided for in title [eight of this code] 8.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Hold at least one noticed public hearing at an accessible site within 60 days following publication of the proposed bill of rights rule, allowing advocates, service providers, persons with HIV, and the public to comment.
obligations.quote: Within [sixty] 60 days following the publication of such proposed rule, and prior to the publication of a final rule, the commissioner shall hold no fewer than [one] 1 noticed public hearing at a site accessible to [the disabled] individuals with disabilities at which advocates, service providers, persons who have tested positive for HIV, and any other member of the public shall be given an opportunity to comment on such draft bill of rights.
obligations.deadline_text: Within [sixty] 60 days following the publication of such proposed rule
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Publish a final bill of rights rule within 30 days after conclusion of the public hearing and thereafter review and revise on an annual basis.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall publish a final rule within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing and shall thereafter review, and where appropriate, revise such bill of rights on an annual basis.
obligations.deadline_text: within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Post the bill of rights conspicuously in all division offices open to the public and make available for distribution in English, Spanish, and any other languages deemed appropriate.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.deadline_text: No later than [ninety] 90 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.quote: The commissioner shall submit written, quarterly reports to the mayor and the speaker of the council [that]no later than 60 days after the last day of the time period covered by the report and shall, at a minimum, provide the following information:

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.deadline_text: Within [one] 1 year of the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision

obligations.action_summary: Study the feasibility of creating or designating older adult information points within existing older adult centers, including identifying potential locations in each borough, considerations for locating such points, assistance and resources that could be provided, potential benefits, potential constraints on establishment, and estimates of older adults served and geographic coverage for each point.
obligations.quote: The department shall study the feasibility of creating older adult information points or designating older adult information points within existing older adult centers. Such study shall: 1. Identify potential locations in each borough for the creation of older adult information points; 2. Identify considerations for locating older adult information points, such as the accessibility of the proposed location and proximity to older adult centers, naturally occurring retirement communities, neighborhood naturally occurring retirement communities, commercial districts, and mass transit; 3. Identify assistance and resources that could be provided to older adults at older adult information points, such as assistance with applications for services and benefits and information on services and programming provided through the department and older adult centers; 4. Assess the potential benefits of establishing older adult information points; 5. Assess potential constraints on the establishment of older adult information points, including the resources needed to establish and staff each such facility; and 6. For each older adult information point, (i) estimate how many older adults would be served and (ii) list the boroughs, council districts, and neighborhoods that would be served.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a study and report on the feasibility of creating older adult information points

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report on the findings of the study, stating the date of publication and, if feasibility is determined, explaining the reasons for the determination.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report on the findings of the study conducted pursuant to subdivision b of section one of this local law. Such report shall state the date of publication. If the department determines through the study that the creation of older adult information points would be feasible or infeasible, the department shall include a statement in the report explaining its reasons for either such determination.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a study and report on the feasibility of creating older adult information points

obligations.action_summary: Within 1 year of new federal emergency management agency flood insurance rate maps issuance, consider whether the coastal flood risk area should be updated and adopt any such updated coastal flood risk area by rule and post the updated map.

obligations.deadline_text: Within 1 year of the issuance of new effective flood insurance rate maps

obligations.quote: No later than one hundred twenty days after the date of sale, the department of housing preservation and development shall submit to the speaker of the council a rental watchlist report that provides, for each property inspected pursuant to paragraph three of this subdivision: (i) the borough, block, lot number, and address for such property, (ii) the number of apartment units and the owner of record for such property, and (iii) a description of all housing maintenance code violations issued for such property, if any.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than one hundred twenty days after the date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.deadline_text: Not less than ninety days preceding the date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: Not later than ninety days, sixty days, thirty days and ten days prior to the date of sale of a tax lien or tax liens, the department of finance shall submit to the council a list, disaggregated by council district, of all properties noticed for sale pursuant to paragraph 1 of subdivision b of this section containing the following information for each property on such list: (a) the street address and the borough, block, and lot of such property; (b) the property owners of record; (c) the community board and community board district within which such property is located; (d) the amount that, if paid, would render the tax lien or tax liens on such property ineligible to be sold in accordance with section 11-319 of this chapter; and (e) the sum of the tax lien or tax liens on such property, disaggregated by the amount of the lien arising from the nonpayment of property taxes, the amount of any lien arising from the nonpayment of water and sewer charges, provided that the department of environmental protection has provided such information to the department of finance, the amount of any lien arising from emergency repair program charges, and the amount of any other lien that contributes to the sum of the tax lien or tax liens on the property.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than ninety days, sixty days, thirty days and ten days prior to the date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council no later than 120 days after the tax lien sale a list of all properties noticed for sale with a description of their disposition, including reasons for removal from sale.
obligations.quote: No later than one hundred twenty days after the [tax lien] date of sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a list of all properties, identified by block and lot, noticed for sale pursuant to subdivision b of this section. Such list shall also include a description of the disposition of such properties that shall include, but not be limited to, [whether an owner entered into a payment plan with the city pursuant to section 11-322 or 11-322.1 of this chapter, whether an owner satisfied the tax lien or liens, whether ownership of the property was transferred, provided that such information is available to the city, or whether the property was distressed, as defined in subdivision four of section 11-401 of this title, or removed from the sale pursuant to the discretion of the commissioner of the department of housing preservation and development] the sum of the tax lien or tax liens noticed for sale, disaggregated by the groups of properties described in subparagraphs (i) and (ii) of paragraph 1 of subdivision h of this section; the reasons provided for removal of any tax lien from a tax lien sale, based on records maintained by the department of finance, including but not limited to, payment, entry into installment agreement, and removal pursuant to section 11-412.3 of this title.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than one hundred twenty days after the [tax lien] date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: the commissioner of finance, in consultation with the commissioner of housing preservation and development and the commissioner of environmental protection, may conduct outreach sessions in the district of such council member, provided, however, that, the commissioner of finance shall conduct such outreach sessions in the ten council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to paragraph one of subdivision b of this section, and provided, further, however, that, such commissioner shall conduct additional outreach sessions in the five council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to such paragraph.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

Such report shall include: (i) the number of installment agreements begun by property owners or, as defined in subdivision b of section 11-322 of this chapter, other eligible persons, acting on behalf of property owners at each outreach session; (ii) the number of property tax exemption applications begun at each outreach session; (iii) the total number of attendees at each outreach session; (iv) the number of outreach sessions at which a financial counselor was available; (v) the number of property owners, or other eligible persons acting on behalf of property owners, who consulted a financial counselor at each outreach session at which a financial counselor was available; and (vi) the results of such surveys. Such report and the results of each outreach session shall be disaggregated by council district.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: Beginning July first, two thousand twenty-four, the commissioner of housing preservation and development, in consultation with the commissioner of finance and the commissioner of environmental protection, shall make good faith efforts to establish a procedure to contact the owner of record of any class one property or class two property that is a residential condominium or residential cooperative that has been included in the notice of sale required pursuant to subdivision a of this section, and any other person who has registered pursuant to section 11-309 of this chapter or who has provided notice to the commissioner of finance pursuant to section 11-416 or section 11-417 of this title in relation to such property, to inform them of relevant homeownership counseling and support services that the city, or a not-for-profit organization identified by the commissioner of housing preservation and development, provides and to assist in submitting any application for any exemption, credit or other benefit that would operate to exclude the property from a tax lien sale.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July first, two thousand twenty-four

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

Such rules may include a time period within which the department will respond to a request, by an owner of a property or a dwelling unit, that such tax lien or tax liens be removed, a time period within which an owner could appeal a denial of such request, and a time period within which such department will respond to such appeal.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development

obligations.quote: The department shall develop forms in which: 1. the owner of a property shall certify: (i) their election to subject the tax lien or tax liens on such property to the summary foreclosure action set forth in section 11-412.5 of this chapter; (ii) that such election has been made after consultation with an attorney; (iii) their election to forego the option to interpose an answer to such action; and (iv) their decision to forego any further option to pay all unpaid tax lien or tax liens on such property together with interest thereon;
affected_groups: property owners of class one properties

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: Two duplicate originals of the notice of the summary foreclosure action, prepared pursuant to subdivision a of this section, verified by the commissioner of finance or a subordinate designated by the commissioner, shall be filed in the office of the clerk of the county in which the property is situated.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.deadline_text: forthwith
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Publish on its website the declaration and agreement of trust, purchase agreements, servicing agreements, paying agent and custody agreement, indentures, bonds, bond purchase agreements, and certificate of trust for any trust created for tax lien sale purposes no later than August 1, 2024.
obligations.quote: For each trust created by the city or in which the city has an ownership or residual interest for the purposes of a negotiated sale pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision b of section 11-319 of the administrative code of the city of New York that was established on or before July 1, 2024, the department of finance shall, no later than August 1, 2024, publish on its website the following documents: 1. The declaration and agreement of trust, as such declaration and agreement may have been amended or restated; 2. Any purchase agreements, servicing agreements, paying agent and custody agreement, copies of any indenture or bonds, and bond purchase agreements, as each of such documents may have been amended or restated; and 3. The certificate of trust filed with the secretary of state of New York.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than August 1, 2024

obligations.deadline_text: no later than 30 days after the effective date of each such document

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Hold an initial meeting no later than September 15, 2024 and thereafter meet at least monthly to review, evaluate, and make recommendations regarding tax lien sale trusts and related legislative amendments.
obligations.quote: No later than September 15, 2024, the task force shall hold its initial meeting and thereafter shall meet at least monthly, except as otherwise determined by such task force, to review, evaluate and make recommendations for legislative amendments and changes in administrative policy in relation to the task force subjects of inquiry and such other matters as the task force deems appropriate.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 15, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.deadline_text: No later than May 1, 2025
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 15, 2025
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Mail bills for taxes, charges and assessments to all owners who have notified the department in writing or electronically of their mailing address, or to the owner of record at the property address if no mailing address is provided.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall mail bills for taxes, charges and assessments to all owners [who have filed owner's registration cards as herein provided] who have notified the commissioner of finance in writing or electronically of the owner's mailing address for communications from the commissioner, at the address so provided, or, if no mailing address has been so provided, to the owner of record at the property address, if any, appearing in the latest assessment roll, but the failure of the commissioner of finance so to mail such bill shall not invalidate or otherwise affect the tax, charge or assessment represented thereby nor prevent the accruing of any interest or penalty imposed for the non-payment thereof, nor prevent or stay proceedings under this chapter, nor [effect] affect the title of the plaintiff or any purchaser under such proceedings.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Mail notice of foreclosure and any other process to all owners who have notified the department in writing or electronically of their mailing address whenever a property is included in a list of delinquent taxes.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall also mail notice of foreclosure and any other process required by this chapter to all owners who have [filed owner's registration cards] notified the commissioner of finance in writing or electronically of the owner's mailing address for communications from the commissioner, at the address so provided, whenever [the parcels as to which such cards were filed are] a property is included in a list of delinquent taxes filed pursuant to this chapter. The failure to receive such notice or process as herein provided shall not affect the validity of any action or proceeding brought pursuant to this chapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Mail notice of foreclosure and any other process to each person who has notified the department in writing or electronically of an interest in real property and requested notice at a designated address, whenever a property with that person's interest is included in a list of delinquent taxes.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall mail a notice of foreclosure and any other process required by this chapter to each person [who has filed an in rem card] who is not entitled to have tax bills mailed to such person by the commissioner of finance, but who has notified the commissioner of finance in writing or electronically that he or she has an interest in real property, including the interest of a mortgagee, lienor or encumbrancer, and who has requested the commissioner of finance to mail a notice to him or her at a designated mailing address, at the address so provided, whenever the [parcels to which such cards refer are] property in which the person has an interest is included in a list of delinquent taxes filed pursuant to this chapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.action_summary: Establish a proactive inspection program to identify buildings where unlicensed or unpermitted work may be occurring, or where maintenance, façade, structural, or other issues could affect building or neighboring site integrity.

obligations.action_summary: Use predictive analytics to weigh factors that may indicate potential safety or other issues and evaluate such factors to conduct inspections at buildings where evaluation indicates potential for hazardous conditions.
obligations.quote: The department shall use predictive analytics to weigh the factors identified in items 1 through 8 of this section that may indicate potential safety or other issues. obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a proactive inspection program for buildings

obligations.action_summary: Conduct inspections as necessary to verify the progress of corrective measures outlined in corrective action plans.
