obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence
obligations.action_summary: Distribute outreach and education materials to family justice centers, domestic violence shelters, facilities operated by the New York city health and hospitals corporation, and community-based organizations.
obligations.quote: The office shall distribute such materials to family justice centers, domestic violence shelters, facilities operated by the New York city health and hospitals corporation, and community-based organizations
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a program to assist with door and window repair and security for survivors of domestic and gender-based violence
obligations.committee: Committee on Women and Gender Equity

obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence
obligations.action_summary: Conduct community outreach and education efforts in high traffic areas including, but not limited to, transit hubs.
obligations.quote: The office shall also conduct community outreach and education efforts in high traffic areas including, but not limited to, transit hubs
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a program to assist with door and window repair and security for survivors of domestic and gender-based violence
obligations.committee: Committee on Women and Gender Equity

obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence
obligations.action_summary: Make outreach and education materials available on the office's website.
obligations.quote: Such materials shall also be made available on the office's website
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a program to assist with door and window repair and security for survivors of domestic and gender-based violence
obligations.committee: Committee on Women and Gender Equity

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Provide eligible residents with a pre-populated senior citizen rent increase exemption program application form within 90 days of receiving their annual income affidavit.
obligations.quote: No later than 90 days after the supervising agency receives a resident's annual income affidavit, the supervising agency shall provide such resident with an application form for the senior citizen rent increase exemption program that contains all applicable data electronically populated
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 90 days after the supervising agency receives a resident's annual income affidavit
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to provision of senior citizen rent increase exemption application forms pre-populated with applicable data to eligible persons living in city-supervised Mitchell-Lama housing

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Provide residents with an explanatory letter accompanying the pre-populated application form that describes the senior citizen rent increase exemption program, the purpose of the form, and instructions for reviewing, completing, and submitting it, including relevant contact information.
obligations.quote: the supervising agency shall provide a letter to such resident with such application form that explains the features of the senior citizen rent increase exemption program; the purpose of such application form; and information on how to review, complete, modify as necessary, and return such application form
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 90 days after the supervising agency receives a resident's annual income affidavit
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to provision of senior citizen rent increase exemption application forms pre-populated with applicable data to eligible persons living in city-supervised Mitchell-Lama housing

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Digitize the information contained in each annual income affidavit submitted by residents to enable pre-population of senior citizen rent increase exemption application forms.
obligations.quote: the supervising agency shall digitize the information contained in each annual income affidavit submitted to such supervising agency
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to provision of senior citizen rent increase exemption application forms pre-populated with applicable data to eligible persons living in city-supervised Mitchell-Lama housing

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor, public advocate, and speaker of the council, and post on its website a quarterly report on investigative encounters conducted by the department, including total numbers of level I, II, and III encounters, disaggregated by precinct and by demographics, reason, basis, outcomes, use of force, and encounter level progression.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor, the public advocate and the speaker of the council and post on its website a report for the previous quarter regarding investigative encounters conducted by the department
obligations.deadline_text: Within 30 days of the quarter ending September 30, 2024, and thereafter within 30 days of the end of each quarter
affected_groups: members of the public involved in investigative encounters
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the police department to report on police-civilian investigative encounters

obligations.action_summary: Store investigative encounter information permanently and maintain it in an accessible, machine-readable format on the department's website, including comparisons to prior four reporting periods.
obligations.quote: The information required pursuant to this section shall be stored permanently and shall be accessible from the department's website. The information shall be provided in a format that permits automated processing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the police department to report on police-civilian investigative encounters

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from placing incarcerated persons in solitary confinement except for de-escalation confinement or during emergency lock-ins, and only then within the time and circumstance limits specified.
obligations.quote: The department shall not place an incarcerated person in a cell, other than at night for sleeping for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period or during the day for count not to exceed two hours in any 24-hour period, unless for the purpose of de-escalation confinement or during emergency lock-ins.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure de-escalation confinement spaces meet minimum standards specified in NYC Rules title 40 sections 1-03 and 1-04 regarding personal hygiene and space requirements.
obligations.quote: Spaces used for de-escalation confinement must, at a minimum, have the features specified in sections 1-03 and 1-04 of title 40 of the rules of the city of New York and be maintained in accordance with the personal hygiene and space requirements set forth in such sections
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Conduct regular monitoring and continuous crisis intervention for persons in de-escalation confinement, with staff attempting de-escalation and working toward release.
obligations.quote: Department staff must regularly monitor a person in de-escalation confinement and engage in continuous crisis intervention and de-escalation to support the person's health and well-being, attempt de-escalation, work toward a person's release from de-escalation confinement and determine whether it is necessary to continue to hold such person in such confinement
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Conduct visual and aural observation of each person in de-escalation confinement every 15 minutes, refer health concerns to medical or mental health staff, and bring any person needing medical care to the medical clinic.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct visual and aural observation of each person in de-escalation confinement every 15 minutes, shall refer any health concerns to medical or mental health staff, and shall bring any person displaying any indications of any need for medical documentation, observation, or treatment to the medical clinic.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide each person in de-escalation confinement access to a tablet or device allowing phone calls outside the facility and to medical staff within the facility.
obligations.quote: Throughout de-escalation confinement, a person shall have access to a tablet or device that allows such person to make phone calls outside of the facility and to medical staff in the facility
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Remove a person from de-escalation confinement immediately when they have sufficiently gained control and no longer pose significant risk of imminent serious physical injury.
obligations.quote: A person shall be removed from de-escalation confinement immediately following when such person has sufficiently gained control and no longer poses a significant risk of imminent serious physical injury to themselves or others
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Enforce the maximum duration limits for de-escalation confinement: no more than four hours immediately following the incident, no more than four hours total in any 24-hour period, and no more than 12 hours in any seven-day period.
obligations.quote: The maximum duration a person can be held in de-escalation confinement shall not exceed four hours immediately following the incident precipitating such person's placement in such confinement. Under no circumstances may the department place a person in de-escalation confinement for more than four hours total in any 24-hour period, or more than 12 hours in any seven-day period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from placing incarcerated persons in locked decontamination showers or any other locked space that does not meet the minimum features and personal hygiene standards specified in NYC Rules title 40 sections 1-03 and 1-04.
obligations.quote: The department shall not place any incarcerated person in a locked decontamination shower nor in any other locked space in any facility that does not have, at a minimum, the features specified in sections 1-03 and 1-04 of title 40 of the rules of the city of New York and maintained in accordance with the personal hygiene and space requirements as set forth in such sections.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Eliminate locked decontamination showers and ensure any other locked spaces comply with minimum feature and maintenance standards specified in NYC Rules sections 40 RCNY § 1-03 and § 1-04.
obligations.quote: The department shall not maintain any locked decontamination showers. Any other locked spaces in any facility for holding incarcerated people must at least have the features specified in and maintained in accordance with the personal hygiene and space requirements set forth in 40 RCNY § 1-03 and § 1-04.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Prepare an incident report for each instance an incarcerated person is placed in de-escalation confinement, documenting the reason isolation was necessary and the length of time in confinement.
obligations.quote: For each instance an incarcerated person is placed in de-escalation confinement as described in subdivision c of this section, the department shall prepare an incident report that includes a detailed description of why isolation was necessary to de-escalate an immediate conflict and the length of time the incarcerated person was placed in such confinement.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly incident reports on de-escalation confinement to the speaker of the council and board of correction, and post redacted reports on the department's website, beginning July 15, 2024, within 15 days of the end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning on July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide the speaker of the council and the board of correction all such reports for the preceding quarter and post all such reports on the department's website.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning on July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly data reports on de-escalation confinement disaggregated by race, age, gender identity, and mental health treatment level to the speaker of the council and board of correction, and post on the department's website, beginning July 31, 2024, within 30 days of the end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning July 31, 2024, and within 30 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide to the speaker of the council and the board of correction, and post on the department's website, a report with data for the preceding quarter on the total number of people placed in such confinement, disaggregated by race, age, gender identity and mental health treatment level, as well as the total number of people held in such confinement disaggregated by whether confinement lasted less than one hour, between one and two hours, between two and three hours, and between three and four hours.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July 31, 2024, and within 30 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from placing an incarcerated person in restraints unless an individualized determination is made that restraints are necessary to prevent imminent risk of self-injury or injury to others, and use only the least restrictive form for no longer than necessary.
obligations.quote: The department shall not place an incarcerated person in restraints unless an individualized determination is made that restraints are necessary to prevent an imminent risk of self-injury or injury to other persons. In such instances, only the least restrictive form of restraints may be used and may be used no longer than is necessary to abate such imminent harm.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from using restraints on incarcerated persons under age 22 except during facility transportation or escorted movement to out-of-cell activities where an individualized determination finds restraints necessary to prevent immediate risk of self-injury or injury to others.
obligations.quote: Restraints shall not be used on an incarcerated person under the age of 22 except in the following circumstances: (i) during transportation in and out of a facility, provided that during transportation no person shall be secured to an immovable object; and (ii) during escorted movement within a facility to and from out-of-cell activities where an individualized determination is made that restraints are necessary to prevent an immediate risk of self-injury or injury to other persons.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from unnecessarily prolonging, delaying or undermining an individual's escorted movements within a facility.
obligations.quote: The department is prohibited from engaging in attempts to unnecessarily prolong, delay or undermine an individual's escorted movements.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Hold a hearing before continuing restraint use beyond what is permitted under paragraph 1, prohibit restraint use on two consecutive days without a hearing, and conduct daily reviews to discontinue restraints once no imminent risk exists.
obligations.quote: The department shall not place an incarcerated person in restraints beyond the use of restraints described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision, or on two consecutive days, until a hearing is held to determine if the continued use of restraints is necessary for the safety of others. Such hearing shall comply with the rules of the board of correction as described in paragraph 1 of subdivision f of this section. Any continued use of restraints must be reviewed by the department on a daily basis and discontinued once there is no longer an imminent risk of self-injury or injury to other persons. Continued use of restraints may only be authorized for seven consecutive days.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from placing an incarcerated person in restrictive housing until a hearing is held and the person is found to have committed a violent grade I offense, except as provided in subdivision g.
obligations.quote: Except as provided in subdivision g of this section, the department shall not place an incarcerated person in restrictive housing until a hearing on such placement is held and the person is found to have committed a violent grade I offense.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Establish rules for restrictive housing hearings that include the right to legal representation, to present evidence and cross-examine witnesses, and other specified due process provisions.
obligations.quote: The board of correction shall establish rules for restrictive housing hearings that shall, at a minimum, include the following provisions: (i) An incarcerated person shall have the right to be represented by their legal counsel or advocate
obligations.deadline_text: before such date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide incarcerated persons and their legal counsel or advocate written notice of reasons for proposed restrictive housing placement and supporting evidence no later than 48 hours prior to the hearing.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide the incarcerated person and their legal counsel or advocate written notice of the reason for proposed placement in restrictive housing and any supporting evidence for such placement, no later than 48 hours prior to the restrictive housing hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide legal counsel or advocate adequate time to prepare for restrictive housing hearings and grant reasonable requests for adjournments.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide the legal counsel or advocate adequate time to prepare for such hearings and shall grant reasonable requests for adjournments
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Take reasonable steps to provide interpreters in an incarcerated person's native language if the person does not understand or is unable to communicate in English during restrictive housing hearings.
obligations.quote: The department shall take reasonable steps to provide such interpreter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure all restrictive housing dispositions are reached within five business days after hearing conclusion, documented in writing with findings and required information.
obligations.quote: A restrictive housing disposition shall be reached within five business days after the conclusion of the hearing. Such disposition must be supported by substantial evidence, shall be documented in writing, and must contain the following information: a finding of guilty or not guilty, a summary of each witness's testimony and whether their testimony was credited or rejected with the reasons thereof, the evidence relied upon by the hearing officer in reaching their finding, and the sanction imposed, if any
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide a written copy of the hearing disposition to the incarcerated person and their counsel or advocate within 24 hours of determination.
obligations.quote: A written copy of the hearing disposition shall be provided to the incarcerated person and their counsel or advocate within 24 hours of the determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Obtain written approval from the Commissioner, a Deputy Commissioner, or equivalent senior leadership before placing a person in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing, including documentation of basis for reasonable belief of a violent grade I offense and specific risk posed.
obligations.quote: Such placement shall only occur upon written approval of the Commissioner or a Deputy Commissioner, or another equivalent member of department senior leadership over the operations of security. Such written approval shall include: the basis for a reasonable belief that the incarcerated person has committed a violent grade I offense, and whether such person has caused serious physical injury or poses a specific and significant risk of imminent serious physical injury to staff or other incarcerated persons.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a restrictive housing hearing as soon as reasonably practicable following pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing placement, and no later than five days unless the person seeks postponement.
obligations.quote: A restrictive housing hearing shall occur as soon as reasonably practicable following placement in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing, and must occur within five days of such placement, unless the person placed in such restrictive housing seeks a postponement of such hearing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Deduct time spent in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing from any sentence of restrictive housing if a person is found guilty at a hearing, and count such time toward time limits in restrictive housing.
obligations.quote: If a person is found guilty at a restrictive housing hearing, time spent in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing prior to such hearing determination shall be deducted from any sentence of restrictive housing and such time shall count toward the time limits in restrictive housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing complies with all requirements for restrictive housing including those in subdivision h.
obligations.quote: Pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing shall comply with all requirements for restrictive housing, including but not limited to those established in subdivision h of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Conduct regular monitoring and continuous crisis intervention during the first day of pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing placement, attempting de-escalation and working toward release.
obligations.quote: During the first day of placement in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing, department staff must regularly monitor the person and engage in continuous crisis intervention and attempt de-escalation, work toward a person's release from pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing and determine whether it is necessary to continue to hold the person in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from placing an incarcerated person in restrictive housing for longer than necessary and for no more than a total of 60 days in any 12 month period.
obligations.quote: The department shall not place an incarcerated person in restrictive housing for longer than necessary and for no more than a total of 60 days in any 12 month period.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Meaningfully review restrictive housing placement within 15 days to determine if the person continues to present a specific, significant and imminent threat, and if not discharged, provide written reasons and recommended programs or services.
obligations.quote: Within 15 days of placement of an incarcerated person in restrictive housing, the department shall meaningfully review such placement to determine whether the incarcerated person continues to present a specific, significant and imminent threat to the safety and security of other persons if housed outside restrictive housing. If an individual is not discharged from restrictive housing after review, the department shall provide in writing to the incarcerated person: (i) the reasons for the determination that such person must remain in restrictive housing and (ii) any recommended program, treatment, service, or corrective action.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide incarcerated persons in restrictive housing access to recommended programs, treatment and services.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide the incarcerated person access to such available programs, treatment and services.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Discharge an incarcerated person from restrictive housing if they have not engaged in behavior presenting a specific, significant, and imminent threat during the preceding 15 days, and discharge all persons within 30 days of initial placement.
obligations.quote: The department shall discharge an incarcerated person from restrictive housing if such person has not engaged in behavior that presents a specific, significant, and imminent threat to the safety and security of themselves or other persons during the preceding 15 days. In all circumstances, the department shall discharge an incarcerated person from restrictive housing within 30 days after their initial placement in such housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide persons in restrictive housing with at least seven hours per day of out-of-cell congregate programming or activities with groups in shared space, or comparable individual programming if they voluntarily decline congregate participation.
obligations.quote: A person placed in restrictive housing must have interaction with other people and access to congregate programming and amenities comparable to those housed outside restrictive housing, including access to at least seven hours per day of out-of-cell congregate programming or activities with groups of people in a group setting all in the same shared space without physical barriers separating such people that is conducive to meaningful and regular social interaction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Require written or videotaped documentation of any decision by a person in restrictive housing to voluntarily decline participation in congregate programming.
obligations.quote: A decision to voluntarily decline to participate in congregate programming must be done in writing or by videotape.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide persons in restrictive housing with programming that addresses unique needs, including core educational and other programming comparable to general population, evidence-based therapeutic interventions, and restorative justice programs.
obligations.quote: The department shall utilize programming that addresses the unique needs of those in restrictive housing. The department shall provide persons in restrictive housing with access to core educational and other programming comparable to core programs in the general population. The department shall also provide persons in restrictive housing access to evidence-based therapeutic interventions and restorative justice programs aimed at addressing the conduct resulting in their placement in restrictive housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure programs in restrictive housing are individualized, trauma-informed, include positive incentive behavior modification models, and follow best practices for violence interruption.
obligations.quote: Such programs shall be individualized and trauma-informed, include positive incentive behavior modification models, and follow best practices for violence interruption.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Train staff that routinely interact with incarcerated persons in de-escalation techniques, conflict resolution, use of force policy, and related topics.
obligations.quote: Staff that routinely interact with incarcerated persons must be trained in de-escalation techniques, conflict resolution, the use of force policy, and related topics to address the unique needs of those in restrictive housing units.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Use positive incentives to encourage good behavior in restrictive housing units and use disciplinary sanctions only as a last resort in response to behavior presenting a serious and evident danger after other measures have not alleviated such behavior.
obligations.quote: The department shall use positive incentives to encourage good behavior in restrictive housing units and may use disciplinary sanctions only as a last resort in response to behavior presenting a serious and evident danger to oneself or others after other measures have not alleviated such behavior.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure housing for medical or mental health support, transgender or gender non-conforming persons, voluntary protective custody, and school attendance purposes complies with specified subdivisions and paragraphs.
obligations.quote: All housing for medical or mental health support provided to persons recommended to receive such support by the entity providing and,or overseeing correctional medical and mental health, including placement in a contagious disease unit, housing for people who are transgender or gender non-conforming, housing for voluntary protective custody, and housing for purposes of school attendance, shall comply with subdivisions (b), (c), (e), (i), (j) and (k) of this section and paragraphs 4, 5, and 6 of this subdivision.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: For contagious disease units, hold persons for only as limited a time as medically necessary as exclusively determined by health care staff, in the least restrictive medically appropriate environment.
obligations.quote: For purposes of contagious disease units, after a referral from health care staff, a person may be held in a medical unit overseen by health care staff, for as limited a time as medically necessary as exclusively determined by health care staff, in the least restrictive environment that is medically appropriate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide individuals in contagious disease units with comparable access to phone calls, emails, visits, and programming as incarcerated persons in general population, consistent with medical and mental health treatment.
obligations.quote: Individuals in a contagious disease unit must have comparable access as individuals incarcerated in the general population to phone calls, emails, visits, and programming done in a manner consistent with the medical and mental health treatment being received, such as at a physical distance determined appropriate by medical or mental health staff.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Prepare incident reports for each instance a disciplinary charge resulting in restrictive housing is dismissed or an incarcerated person is found not guilty, documenting the charge and reasons for dismissal or acquittal.
obligations.quote: For each instance a disciplinary charge that could result in restrictive housing is dismissed or an incarcerated individual is found not guilty of the disciplinary charge, the department shall prepare an incident report that includes a description of the disciplinary charge and the reasons for the dismissal or not guilty determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Prepare incident reports for each instance an incarcerated person is placed in restrictive housing, documenting the behavior resulting in placement and why restrictive housing was necessary.
obligations.quote: For each instance an incarcerated person is placed in restrictive housing, the department shall prepare an incident report that includes a detailed description of the behavior that resulted in placement in restrictive housing and why restrictive housing was necessary to address such behavior, including if a person was placed in pre-hearing temporary restrictive housing and the reasons why the situation met the requirements in paragraph 1 of subdivision g of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Prepare incident reports for each instance confinement in restrictive housing is continued after a 15-day review, documenting why the person was not discharged and what programs or services are required before discharge.
obligations.quote: For each instance in which confinement in restrictive housing is continued after a 15-day review of an incarcerated person's placement in restrictive housing, the department shall prepare an incident report as to why the person was not discharged, including a detailed description of how the person continued to present a specific, significant and imminent threat to the safety and security of the facility if housed outside restrictive housing and what program, treatment, service, and/or corrective action was required before discharge.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly incident reports on restrictive housing to the speaker of the council and board of correction, and post redacted reports on the department's website, beginning July 15, 2024, within 15 days of the end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning on July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide the speaker of the council and the board of correction all such reports for the prior quarter and post all such reports on the department's website.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning on July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly data reports on restrictive housing disaggregated by race, age, gender identity, mental health treatment level, length of confinement, and hearing disposition outcomes to the speaker of the council and board of correction, and post on the website, beginning July 31, 2024, within 30 days of end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning July 31, 2024, and within 30 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide to the speaker of the council and the board of correction, and post on the department's website, a report with data for the preceding quarter on the total number of people placed in restrictive housing during that time period, disaggregated by race, age, gender identity, mental health treatment level and length of time in restrictive housing, and data on all disposition outcomes of all restrictive housing hearing during such time period, disaggregated by charge, race, age, gender identity and mental health treatment level.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July 31, 2024, and within 30 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure all incarcerated persons have access to at least 14 out-of-cell hours every day except while in de-escalation confinement or during emergency lock-ins.
obligations.quote: All incarcerated persons must have access to at least 14 out-of-cell hours every day except while in de-escalation confinement pursuant to subdivision c of this section and during emergency lock-ins pursuant to subdivision j of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Permit incarcerated persons to congregate with others and move about their housing area freely during out-of-cell time and provide access to education and programming.
obligations.quote: Incarcerated persons may congregate with others and move about their housing area freely during out-of-cell time and have access to education and programming pursuant to section 9-110 of the administrative code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Impose emergency lock-ins only when the Commissioner or equivalent senior leadership determines it necessary to de-escalate an emergency posing specific, significant and imminent harm, as a last resort, limited to the narrowest area and fewest people possible.
obligations.quote: Emergency lock-ins may only be used when the Commissioner, a Deputy Commissioner, or another equivalent member of department senior leadership with responsibility for the operations of security for a facility determines that such lock-in is necessary to de-escalate an emergency that poses a threat of specific, significant and imminent harm to incarcerated persons or staff.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Use emergency lock-ins only when there are no less restrictive means available and only as a last resort after exhausting less restrictive measures.
obligations.quote: Emergency lock-ins may only be used when there are no less restrictive means available to address an emergency circumstance and only as a last resort after exhausting less restrictive measures.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Confine emergency lock-ins to the narrowest area possible with the limited number of people possible and lift lock-ins as quickly as possible.
obligations.quote: Emergency lock-ins must be confined to as narrow an area as possible and limited number of people as possible. The department shall lift emergency lock-ins as quickly as possible.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Ensure the Commissioner or equivalent senior leadership reviews emergency lock-ins at least every hour and limits such lock-ins to no more than four hours.
obligations.quote: The Commissioner, a Deputy Commissioner, or another equivalent member of department senior leadership over the operations of security shall review such lock-ins at least every hour. Such lock-ins may not last more than four hours.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Conduct visual and aural observation of every person in an emergency lock-in every 15 minutes, refer health concerns to medical or mental health staff, and bring any person needing medical care to the medical clinic.
obligations.quote: Throughout an emergency lock-in, the department shall conduct visual and aural observation of every person locked in every fifteen (15) minutes, shall refer any health concerns to medical or mental health staff, and shall bring any person displaying any indications of any need for medical documentation, observation, or treatment to the medical clinic.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide each person in an emergency lock-in access to a tablet or device allowing phone calls outside the facility and to medical staff, except during department-wide or facility-wide emergency lock-ins.
obligations.quote: Throughout an emergency lock-in, other than in a department-wide emergency lock-in or a facility emergency lock-in, each person locked in shall have access to a tablet or other device that allows the person to make phone calls both outside of the facility and to medical staff in the facility.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Immediately provide notice to the public on its website when an emergency lock-in is imposed, including information on restrictions to visits, phone calls, counsel visits or court appearances.
obligations.quote: The department shall immediately provide notice to the public on its website of an emergency lock-in, including information on any restrictions on visits, phone calls, counsel visits or court appearances.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Prepare an incident report for each emergency lock-in, documenting the reason for the lock-in, exhaustion of less restrictive measures, number of people held, length, areas affected, impact on medical and mental health services and programs, and staff diverted.
obligations.quote: For each instance an emergency lock-in is imposed, the department shall prepare an incident report that includes: (a) A description of why the lock-in was necessary to investigate or de-escalate an emergency, including the ways in which it posed a threat of specific, significant and imminent harm; (b) A description of how other less restrictive measures were exhausted; (c) The number of people held in lock-in; (d) The length of lock-in; (e) The areas affected and the reasons such areas were subject to the emergency lock-in; (f) The medical and mental health services affected, the number of scheduled medical and or mental health appointments missed and requests that were denied; (g) Whether visits, counsel visits or court appearances were affected; (h) What programs, if any, were affected; (i) All actions taken during the lock-in to resolve and address the lock-in; and (j) The number of staff diverted for the lock-in.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly incident reports on emergency lock-ins to the speaker of the council and board of correction, and post redacted reports on the department's website, beginning July 15, 2024, within 15 days of the end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide the speaker of the council and the board of correction all such reports for the preceding quarter and shall post all such reports on the department's website with any identifying information redacted.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide quarterly data reports on emergency lock-ins disaggregated by race, age, gender identity, mental health treatment level, and length of time in cell confinement to the speaker of the council and board of correction, beginning July 15, 2024, within 15 days of end of each quarter.
obligations.quote: Beginning July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter, the department shall provide to the speaker of the council and the board of correction a report on the total number of lock-ins occurring during the preceding quarter, the areas affected by each such lock-in, the length of each such lock-in and number of incarcerated people subject to each such lock-in, disaggregated by race, age, gender identity, mental health treatment level and length of time in cell confinement.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning July 15, 2024, and within 15 days of the end of each subsequent quarter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Provide incarcerated persons under age 22 with trauma-informed, age-appropriate programming and services on a consistent, regular basis.
obligations.quote: Incarcerated persons under the age of 22 shall receive access to trauma-informed, age-appropriate programming and services on a consistent, regular basis.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Take any actions necessary for implementation of this local law, including promulgation of rules relating to procedures and penalties, before the 180-day effective date.
obligations.quote: The board of correction shall take any actions necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules relating to procedures and penalties necessary to effectuate this section before such date.
obligations.deadline_text: before such date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to banning solitary confinement in city jails and establishing standards for the use of restrictive housing and emergency lock-ins

obligations.action_summary: Maintain and operate an online resource tool enabling veterans and household members to request assistance with accessing resources and obtaining services for veterans.
obligations.quote: The department shall maintain and operate an online resource tool to enable a veteran or a member of their household to request assistance with accessing resources and obtaining services for veterans
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an online resource tool and pamphlet for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Provide a link to the online resource tool on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide a link to the online resource tool described in subdivision b of this section on the website of the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an online resource tool and pamphlet for veterans

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Ensure that a link to the online resource tool is provided on any online platform through which the city disseminates information on social services and benefits.
obligations.quote: The city shall ensure that a link to such online resource tool is provided on any online platform through which the city disseminates information on social services and benefits.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an online resource tool and pamphlet for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Develop a pamphlet providing information about resources and services provided by the department, including information about the online resource tool, the veteran resource guide, and the locations of veteran resource centers.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop a pamphlet that provides information about resources and services provided by the department. Such pamphlet shall include, but need not be limited to, information about the online resource tool
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an online resource tool and pamphlet for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Distribute copies of the pamphlet to agencies that provide social services, council member district offices, and community board offices.
obligations.quote: The department shall distribute copies of such pamphlet to agencies that provide social services, council member district offices, and community board offices.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an online resource tool and pamphlet for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report on mental health services provided by city agencies to veterans, identifying each agency and detailing the number of veterans served, methods of communication, and service descriptions.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor and post on the website of the department a report on mental health services provided by agencies to veterans
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 15, 2024, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the commissioner of veterans' services to submit an annual report on the provision of mental health services by city agencies to veterans

obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach and engagement regarding the availability of mental health resources for veterans, including veteran crisis hotlines and mental health resources in the veteran resource guide.
obligations.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the office of community mental health and any agencies identified by the commissioner, shall conduct outreach and engagement regarding the availability of mental health resources for veterans.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to community outreach and engagement on mental health resources for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Utilize social media, internet, radio, print media, or digital kiosks to conduct outreach and advise veterans as to how to obtain additional information about mental health resources for veterans.
obligations.quote: In conducting such outreach and engagement, the department shall utilize social media, internet, radio, print media, or digital kiosks, and shall advise veterans as to how to obtain additional information about mental health resources for veterans.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to community outreach and engagement on mental health resources for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Include on its website a form that allows non-profit organizations or other entities that provide mental health services to veterans to submit information about such services.
obligations.quote: The department shall include on its website a form that allows non-profit organizations or other entities that provide mental health services to veterans to submit information about such services to the department.
affected_groups: non-profit organizations providing mental health services
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to community outreach and engagement on mental health resources for veterans

obligations.action_summary: Include on applications for services a question about whether the applicant or household member has served in the armed forces, national guard, or reserves, and an option for affirmative responders to consent to contact regarding veteran services and resources.
obligations.quote: Any agency that requests demographic information from any person applying for services, including services provided by such agency directly or by contract, shall include on any application for such services: 1. A question about whether such person or any member of their household has served in the armed forces, national guard, or reserves of the United States
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the collection of demographic data on veterans

obligations.action_summary: Include in the annual report required by section 31-109 the total number of persons who responded affirmatively to veteran service questions on applications, disaggregated by agency, type of service sought, and council district.
obligations.quote: No later than December 15, 2024, and annually thereafter, the department shall include in the annual report required pursuant to section 31-109 the total number of persons who responded affirmatively to questions included in any application for services from any city agency
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 15, 2024, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the collection of demographic data on veterans

obligations.action_summary: Provide a letter of incarceration to every person discharged from a New York City correctional facility, specifying the date the person entered and the date such person was released from the custody of the department.
obligations.quote: Upon release, the department of correction shall provide a letter of incarceration to every person discharged from a New York city correctional facility, regardless of whether such person was held pre-trial or was subject to an order of commitment that provided that such incarcerated individual remain in the custody of the department. Such letter shall specify both the date the person entered and the date such person was released from the custody of the department.
affected_groups: individuals being released from New York City correctional facilities
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to provide a letter of incarceration to all individuals as they leave the department's custody

obligations.citation: Section 1 of the local law, adding NYC Admin. Code § 16-403
obligations.quote: Any sports venue that violates this section or any rule promulgated pursuant thereto shall be liable for a civil penalty
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to allowing reusable beverage containers in sports venues

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council, the public advocate, and the mayor, and publish on the department's website in machine-readable format, a quarterly report on removals conducted during the prior month, including details on removal type, location, initiation source, personnel, affected individuals, and costs.
obligations.quote: No later than 1 month after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and quarterly thereafter, the commissioner, in consultation with the police commissioner, the commissioner of sanitation, and the commissioner of parks and recreation, shall submit to the speaker of the council, the public advocate, and the mayor, and publish on the department's website, in a machine readable format, a report on removals conducted during the prior month.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 month after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and quarterly thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring reports on removals involving individuals experiencing homelessness and the outcomes for those individuals

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council, the public advocate, and the mayor, and publish on the department's website in machine-readable format, a quarterly report on same-day outcomes for individuals experiencing homelessness involved in removals during the prior month, including data on housing offers, services, detentions, and arrests.
obligations.quote: No later than 1 month after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and quarterly thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the speaker of the council, the public advocate, and the mayor and publish on the department's website, in a machine readable format, a report on the same-day outcomes for individuals experiencing homelessness involved in a removal during the prior month.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 month after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and quarterly thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring reports on removals involving individuals experiencing homelessness and the outcomes for those individuals

obligations.action_summary: Include a data dictionary in the reports required by subdivisions b and c of section 21-152.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring reports on removals involving individuals experiencing homelessness and the outcomes for those individuals

obligations.quote: a third-party device, including an electronic display, touchscreen, or similar device, that is approved by the commission, attached to the interior of a for-hire vehicle
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to advertising on the interior of for-hire vehicles

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to advertising on the interior of for-hire vehicles

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to advertising on the interior of for-hire vehicles

obligations.action_summary: Upon receipt of a complaint about specified conditions in an unoccupied dwelling unit that may cause a hazardous condition in an occupied unit, notify the owner to schedule an inspection within 21 days and conduct the inspection.
obligations.quote: the department shall notify the owner of such multiple dwelling to schedule an inspection of such unoccupied dwelling unit by the department within 21 days of such complaint
obligations.deadline_text: within 21 days of such complaint
affected_groups: occupants of occupied dwelling units in multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring inspection of unoccupied dwelling units

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Issue a notice of violation for any hazardous or immediately hazardous condition observed in an unoccupied dwelling unit inspected pursuant to the inspection requirements.
obligations.quote: The department shall issue a notice of violation for any hazardous or immediately hazardous condition observed in an unoccupied dwelling unit inspected pursuant to subdivision a of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring inspection of unoccupied dwelling units

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Maintain a publicly accessible interface on the department's website that lists violations issued for unoccupied dwelling unit conditions.
obligations.quote: The department shall maintain a publicly accessible interface on the website of the department that lists violations issued pursuant to subdivision c of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring inspection of unoccupied dwelling units

obligations.action_summary: File with the city clerk the amended district plan containing the change in the method of assessment for the Westchester Square business improvement district.
