obligations.deadline_text: Immediately upon adoption of this local law
affected_groups: Westchester Square business improvement district property owners
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to amending the district plan of the Westchester Square business improvement district to change the method of assessment upon which the district charge is based

obligations.actor_raw: the departments and a contracted entity
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and make publicly available on the city's website an industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.quote: the departments and a contracted entity, in consultation with the department of citywide administrative services, the department of transportation, the office of long-term planning and sustainability, and any other agency as determined by the departments and a contracted entity, shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and make publicly available on the city's website, an industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2025, and no later than December 31 of every eighth year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an industrial development strategic plan

obligations.actor_raw: the departments and a contracted entity
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and make publicly available on the city's website a draft industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.quote: No later than July 1 of any year the industrial development strategic plan is required to be submitted pursuant to subdivision b, the departments and a contracted entity shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and make publicly available on the city's website a draft industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1 of any year the industrial development strategic plan is required to be submitted
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an industrial development strategic plan

obligations.actor_raw: the departments and a contracted entity
obligations.action_summary: Hold no less than one public hearing in each borough to solicit public comment on the draft industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.quote: Following submission and posting online of such draft industrial strategic plan, the departments and a contracted entity shall hold no less than one public hearing in each borough to solicit public comment prior to submission of the industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to submission of the industrial development strategic plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an industrial development strategic plan

obligations.actor_raw: the departments and a contracted entity
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the city council a progress report on the industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.quote: No later than December 31, 2027, and no later than December 31 every 2 years thereafter, other than any such year in which an industrial development strategic plan is required to be submitted pursuant to subdivision b, the departments and a contracted entity shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the city council a progress report on the industrial development strategic plan.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2027, and no later than December 31 every 2 years thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an industrial development strategic plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Redesign the city truck route network to enhance safety, increase visibility, reduce traffic congestion, reduce vehicle miles traveled, or otherwise facilitate vehicular traffic.
obligations.quote: The department shall redesign the city truck route network and make any changes to such network that the department determines would enhance safety, increase visibility, reduce traffic congestion, reduce vehicle miles traveled, or otherwise facilitate the conduct of vehicular traffic within the city truck route network
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to redesigning the city truck route network

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Publish on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a report on the redesign of the city truck route network, including reasons for proposed changes, freight patterns, industry trends, and recommendations for truck route improvements.
obligations.quote: No later than September 15, 2024, the department shall publish on its website, and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor, a report on the redesign of the city truck route network described in subdivision b, including the reasons for any proposed changes.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 15, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to redesigning the city truck route network

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Make changes to the city truck route network including updating or replacing signage on roadways to enhance safety, increase driver visibility, reduce traffic congestion, reduce vehicle miles traveled, or otherwise facilitate vehicular traffic.
obligations.quote: the department shall make changes to the city truck route network that the department has determined would enhance safety, increase driver visibility, reduce traffic congestion, reduce vehicle miles traveled, or otherwise facilitate the conduct of vehicular traffic within the city truck route network, including but not limited to updating or replacing signage on roadways or portions of roadways
obligations.deadline_text: no later than September 15, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to redesigning the city truck route network

obligations.action_summary: Establish an advisory commission on LGBTQIA+ older adults and aging.
obligations.quote: The department for the aging shall establish an advisory commission on LGBTQIA+ older adults and aging.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing a commission on lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual, or any other diverse sexual orientation or gender identity older adults within the department for the aging, and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Appoint at least 9 members to the commission on LGBTQIA+ older adults and aging, including representatives from specified sectors and organizations.
obligations.quote: All commission members required by this section shall be appointed no later than 180 days after the effective date of this local law.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 180 days after the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing a commission on lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual, or any other diverse sexual orientation or gender identity older adults within the department for the aging, and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Remove commission members only for cause and upon notice and hearing, and fill vacancies in the same manner as original appointments.
obligations.quote: No member of the commission may be removed except for cause and upon notice and hearing by the commissioner for the aging. Any vacancy shall be filled in the same manner as the original appointment.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing a commission on lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual, or any other diverse sexual orientation or gender identity older adults within the department for the aging, and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Publish the commission's reports on the department's website within 10 days after submission to the mayor, commissioner, and council speaker.
obligations.quote: The commissioner for the aging shall publish the report required by this section on the website of the department for the aging no later than 10 days after such reports are submitted to the mayor, the commissioner for the aging, and the speaker of the council.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 10 days after such reports are submitted
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing a commission on lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual, or any other diverse sexual orientation or gender identity older adults within the department for the aging, and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study on the timing and duration of the city's procurement process for covered human services contracts, including identification of procurement methods, description of process steps, and evaluation of time needed to complete each step.
obligations.quote: The city chief procurement officer shall, no later than July 1, 2024, conduct a study on the timing and duration of the city's procurement process, including the time to complete the steps of such process, for covered contracts.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than July 1, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a study, report and rulemaking regarding procurement process time schedules

obligations.action_summary: Submit a report on the procurement process study to the mayor, speaker of the council, and procurement policy board, including recommendations for rulemaking on procurement time schedules.
obligations.quote: No later than October 1, 2024, the city chief procurement officer shall submit a report on the study required by subdivision b of this section to the mayor, the speaker of the council and the procurement policy board.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than October 1, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a study, report and rulemaking regarding procurement process time schedules

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules setting forth time schedules for completing procurement process steps for covered human services contracts.
obligations.quote: The procurement policy board shall review the report submitted pursuant to subdivision c of this section, and, pursuant to section 1043 of the charter, no later than October 1, 2025, promulgate rules setting forth time schedules for completing the steps
obligations.deadline_text: no later than October 1, 2025
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a study, report and rulemaking regarding procurement process time schedules

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor, speaker of the council, and procurement policy board on the completion of procurement method steps by agencies and vendors within established time schedules.
obligations.quote: No later than October 1, 2026, and no later than October 1 of each year thereafter, the city chief procurement officer shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council and the procurement policy board a report on the completion of procurement method steps
obligations.deadline_text: No later than October 1, 2026, and no later than October 1 of each year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a study, report and rulemaking regarding procurement process time schedules

obligations.action_summary: Submit a fair housing plan to the mayor and speaker of the council and post it on its website, including analysis of citywide fair housing data and policy goals and strategies to affirmatively further fair housing.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall submit a fair housing plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post such plan on its website. Such plan shall include, but need not be limited to:
obligations.deadline_text: no later than October 1, 2025 and every 5 years thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a citywide assessment of the total number of housing units, affordable housing units, deeply affordable housing units, and housing serving formerly homeless households needed to provide housing opportunity for all socio-economic levels.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall conduct a citywide assessment of the total number of housing units, affordable housing units, deeply affordable housing units, and housing serving formerly homeless households that such agency determines is needed
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the date required for the submission of a fair housing plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Submit citywide 5-year housing production targets for total housing units, affordable housing units, deeply affordable housing units, housing serving formerly homeless households, and preservation of housing units to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on its website: 1. A 5-year citywide housing production target for each of the following housing types
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the submission of a fair housing plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Submit community district-level 5-year housing production targets for total housing units, affordable housing units, deeply affordable housing units, and housing serving formerly homeless households to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website.
obligations.quote: For each community district, 5-year housing production targets for the following housing types identified in paragraph 1 of this subdivision: total housing units; affordable housing units; deeply affordable housing units; and housing serving formerly homeless households.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the submission of a fair housing plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Submit a strategic equity framework assessing obstacles to and identifying goals and strategies for furthering fair housing citywide and across community districts to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on its website a strategic equity framework that assesses obstacles to and identifies goals and strategies for furthering fair housing citywide and across community districts.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the submission of a fair housing plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Release a preliminary version of the fair housing plan at least 30 days before submission of the final plan.
obligations.quote: The administrating agency shall release a preliminary version of the plan required by subdivision b available at least 30 days before the submission of such final plan.
obligations.deadline_text: at least 30 days before the submission of such final plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Meet with the public to address borough-specific considerations in developing the fair housing plan, with at least one meeting after the release of the preliminary plan.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall meet with the public prior to the submission of such final plan to address borough-specific considerations, provided that at least one such meeting shall occur after the release of the preliminary plan.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to the submission of such final plan
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Release preliminary versions of the long-term housing needs assessment, housing production targets, and strategic equity framework at least 30 days before submission and meet with the public after release and before final submission.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall release preliminary versions at least 30 days before the submission of such final assessment, targets, and framework and meet with the public after the release of the preliminary versions and before the submission of the final assessment, targets, and framework.
obligations.deadline_text: at least 30 days before the submission of such final assessment, targets, and framework
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual update on the city's progress relating to the goals and strategies identified in the fair housing plan to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website, except in years when a plan or other required report is due.
obligations.quote: the administrating agency shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on its website an annual update on the city's progress relating to the goals and strategies identified pursuant to subdivision b of this section, except that no such annual update shall be due in any year for which a plan pursuant to subdivision b or a report pursuant to subdivisions c, d, or e of this section is due.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than October 1, 2026, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to a fair housing plan, and to repeal local law number 133 for the year 2018, relating to affordable housing plans

obligations.action_summary: Determine the comparable successor survey to the National Science Foundation's Survey of Industry Research and Development for purposes of defining qualified emerging technology companies.

obligations.quote: or any comparable successor survey as determined by the department, and whose total annual product sales are ten million dollars or less.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a biotechnology credit against the general corporation tax, the unincorporated business tax, and the corporate tax of 2015.

obligations.action_summary: Determine the comparable successor survey to the National Science Foundation's Survey of Industry Research and Development for purposes of defining qualified emerging technology companies in the unincorporated business tax context.
obligations.citation: Section 2 of the local law (amending NYC Admin. Code § 11-604(21)(a)(1))
obligations.quote: or any comparable successor survey as determined by the department, and whose total annual product sales are ten million dollars or less.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
obligations.action_summary: Designate duly licensed physicians, physician assistants, or nurse practitioners to conduct physical condition examinations of taxi driver license applicants.
obligations.quote: Each applicant for a driver's license under the provisions of this chapter, other than a commuter van driver's license, shall be examined as to such applicant's physical condition by a duly licensed physician, physician assistant, or nurse practitioner, designated by the commission
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to authorizing physician assistants and nurse practitioners to conduct medical exams of taxi driver license applicants

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Create guidance for medical professionals on detection of sickle cell trait through genetic screening and management and treatment of sickle cell disease.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall create guidance on the following topics to educate medical professionals who work within the city: (a) The detection of sickle cell trait through pre- and post-conception genetic screening; and (b) The management and treatment of sickle cell disease.
affected_groups: individuals at risk for sickle cell trait and disease
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Include in sickle cell guidance benefits of screenings prior to pregnancy, education on non-discriminatory pain assessment approaches including implicit racial bias effects, and education about history of medical discrimination and race-based medical experimentation.
obligations.quote: The guidance created pursuant to this subdivision shall include the benefits of recommending screenings to individuals prior to pregnancy and education on non-discriminatory approaches to assess patient pain, including instruction on the effects of implicit racial bias in the provision of pain management and methods to remediate such effects and ensure patients receive effective pain management care, as well as education about the history of medical discrimination, race-based medical experimentation, and the effects of such discrimination on patients and their medical decision making.
affected_groups: individuals at risk for sickle cell trait and disease
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Post sickle cell guidance on the department's website, distribute to medical providers and practices in the city, and publicize to at-risk populations through public awareness campaigns.
obligations.quote: The guidance created pursuant to this subdivision shall be posted on the department's website, distributed to medical providers and practices in the city, and publicized to at-risk populations through public awareness campaigns.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Ensure that sickle cell trait pre- and post-conception genetic screening is offered to individuals who fall into an at-risk population or for whom such screening is medically appropriate or recommended.
obligations.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the New York city health and hospitals corporation, shall ensure that sickle cell trait pre- and post-conception genetic screening shall be offered to individuals who fall into an at-risk population, as determined by current medical research, or for whom such genetic screening is otherwise medically appropriate or recommended.
affected_groups: individuals for whom genetic screening is medically appropriate
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the speaker of the council summarizing available data on sickle cell trait and disease in the city and the department's efforts to educate practitioners and at-risk populations about genetic screening availability.
obligations.quote: No later than June 1, 2025, and annually thereafter, the department shall submit to the speaker of the council a report summarizing the available data regarding the presence of sickle cell trait and sickle cell disease in the city, to the extent such data can be released in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. Such report shall also include a summary of the department's efforts to educate practitioners and at-risk populations about the availability of pre- and post-conception genetic screening.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than June 1, 2025, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Provide information related to sickle cell trait and disease on the department's website, including importance of genetic screening for at-risk populations and locations of providers where screening is available, in English and designated citywide languages.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide information related to sickle cell trait and disease on the department's website, including information regarding the importance of genetic screening for the sickle cell trait for at-risk populations, and the locations of medical providers, practices, and facilities where such individuals can receive such screenings, in English and in the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing guidance to improve health outcomes for individuals affected by sickle cell disease

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Suspend alternate side of the street parking rules on Tisha B'Av and all other specified holidays.
obligations.quote: All alternate side of the street parking rules shall be suspended on the following holidays: Christmas, Yom Kippur, Rosh Hashanah, Ash Wednesday, Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Ascension Thursday, Feast of the Assumption, Feast of All Saints, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, first two days of Succoth, Shemini Atzareth, Simchas Torah, Shevuoth, Purim, Orthodox Holy Thursday, Orthodox Good Friday, first two and last two days of Passover, the Muslim holidays of Eid Ul-Fitr and Eid Ul-Adha, the day before Lunar New Year, Lunar New Year, the Hindu festival of Diwali on the day that Lakshmi Puja is observed, Three Kings' Day, Tisha B'Av, and all state and national holidays.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to suspending alternate side parking regulations on Tisha B'Av

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Provide information about workers' rights under federal, state, and local law on the city website in English, designated citywide languages, and temporary languages, indicating which rights apply regardless of immigration status and including information about the right to organize.

obligations.deadline_text: No later than March 1, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a workers' bill of rights and outreach to immigrant workers.

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor's office of immigrant affairs
obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach regarding workers' rights information to employees, prospective employees, and independent contractors, including contact information for immigration legal hotline, asylum help center, immigration legal services, workplace immigration enforcement guidance, and temporary protected status eligibility information.
obligations.quote: the mayor's office of immigrant affairs, in coordination with the department and community and labor organizations deemed appropriate by the department, shall conduct outreach regarding the information described in subdivision a of this section to employees, prospective employees, and independent contractors in the city
obligations.deadline_text: No later than March 1, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a workers' bill of rights and outreach to immigrant workers.

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor's office of immigrant affairs
obligations.action_summary: Create outreach materials in English, designated citywide languages, and temporary languages to be distributed via internet, print media, subway advertisements, LinkNYC kiosks, IDNYC registration sites, humanitarian response centers, emergency shelters, respite centers, and asylum seeker resource navigation centers.
obligations.quote: The mayor's office of immigrant affairs shall create such outreach materials in English, the designated citywide languages, and temporary languages.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a workers' bill of rights and outreach to immigrant workers.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation

obligations.quote: The department shall issue and implement a master plan for the use of streets, sidewalks, and pedestrian spaces every five years.

obligations.action_summary: Beginning with the master plan issued December 1, 2026, identify all underserved neighborhood tabulation areas and describe future investments in each such area so it will no longer be an underserved neighborhood tabulation area.

obligations.deadline_text: Beginning with the master plan issued December 1, 2026
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to adding an investment roadmap to the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit the master plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post the plan on the department's website.
obligations.quote: By December 1, 2021 and by December 1 of every fifth year thereafter, the department shall submit such plan to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post such plan on the department's website.
obligations.deadline_text: By December 1, 2021 and by December 1 of every fifth year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to adding an investment roadmap to the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website an annual update regarding changes to the plan from the previous year, the bicycle lane network coverage index, and the status of implementation of each benchmark identified in such plan, including a data set containing geographic feature boundaries.

obligations.deadline_text: By February 1, 2023 and by each February 1 thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to adding an investment roadmap to the streets master plan

obligations.deadline_text: beginning February 1, 2028
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to adding an investment roadmap to the streets master plan

obligations.quote: Provide on the office's website in a simplified and publicly accessible format, information on the publicly available price of common hospital procedures. Such information shall be based on any publicly available information relating to the price of hospital procedures, including disclosures required pursuant to state and federal law, and shall be formatted in a way to allow for price comparisons between hospitals for such common procedures
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of healthcare accountability

obligations.action_summary: Convene key stakeholders in healthcare, including representatives of hospitals, healthcare providers, health plans, and self-insured entities, to examine the costs of healthcare services in the city.
obligations.quote: Convene key stakeholders in healthcare, including, but not limited to, representatives of hospitals, healthcare providers, health plans, and self-insured entities, to examine the costs of healthcare services in the city
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of healthcare accountability

obligations.action_summary: Collect and make available upon request each hospital's United States internal revenue service form 990, Schedule H, audited financial statements, and annual cost reports as required by federal law and centers for medicare and medicaid services.
obligations.quote: Collect and make available, upon request, each hospital's United States internal revenue service form 990, Schedule H as required pursuant to section 501(r) of the internal revenue service code, audited financial statements as required pursuant to section 6033(b)(15)(b) of the internal revenue service code, and annual cost reports as required by centers for medicare and medicaid services.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of healthcare accountability

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the attorney general of the state of New York, and post conspicuously on the office's website, an annual report detailing the pricing practices of hospital systems in the city.
obligations.quote: No later than 1 year after the effective date of the local law that added this section and by January 1 annually thereafter, the director shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the attorney general of the state of New York, and shall post conspicuously on the office's website, a report detailing the pricing practices of hospital systems in the city.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the effective date of the local law that added this section and by January 1 annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of healthcare accountability

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing the calculation of greenhouse gas emissions for campus-style electric systems and buildings not connected to the utility distribution system.
obligations.quote: The department, in consultation with the office of long term planning and sustainability, shall promulgate rules governing the calculation of greenhouse gas emissions for campus-style electric systems that share on-site generation but make use of the utility distribution system and for buildings that are not connected to the utility distribution system.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Determine the electricity grid marginal emissions factor for natural gas powered fuel cells and promulgate rules regarding such factor and emissions attributable to other energy sources.
obligations.quote: The amount of greenhouse gas emissions attributable to natural gas powered fuel cells shall be credited compared to the electricity grid marginal emissions factor that will be determined by the commissioner and promulgated into rules of the department.
affected_groups: covered building owners with fuel cell systems
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.actor_raw: the office of long term planning and sustainability
obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office of Climate and Environmental Justice
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study on the feasibility of a citywide trading scheme for greenhouse gas emissions from buildings and submit a report with findings and implementation plan.
obligations.quote: The office of long term planning and sustainability shall conduct a study on the feasibility of a citywide trading scheme for greenhouse gas emissions from buildings and submit a report and implementation plan with the findings of such study to the mayor and the speaker of the council no later than January 1, 2021.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than January 1, 2021
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Establish by rule alternative pathways for individuals applying for limited hoisting machine operator licenses for articulating boom cranes, mini cranes, or other limited licenses within two years of the provision's effective date.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may, by rule, establish alternative pathways for individuals who, on or before the date that is two years after the effective date of this provision, apply for a limited license for articulating boom cranes, a limited license for mini cranes, or other limited license established by rule.
obligations.deadline_text: on or before the date that is two years after the effective date of this provision
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Audit no less than 25 percent of construction documents for multiple dwellings with specified affordability and regulatory status on a monthly basis.
obligations.quote: On a monthly basis, the commissioner shall audit no less than 25 percent of construction documents which are for multiple dwellings where 25 percent or more of the dwelling units are occupied and such multiple dwelling, in whole or in part, either (i) are subject to rent regulation, (ii) are being rehabilitated or maintained as affordable housing through a department of housing preservation and development program, (iii) are subject to a city regulatory agreement mandating the creation or preservation of a certain number of affordable units, (iv) contain affordable housing units created, sponsored or preserved through other city programs or initiatives, or (v) where the department knows or has reason to know, are the subject of a rent overcharge application which is in the process of being investigated by the New York State division of housing and community renewal.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.actor_raw: an approved agency on behalf of the owner or the department
obligations.action_summary: Perform final inspection for permitted work that does not require issuance of a certificate of occupancy, either through an approved agency on behalf of the owner or directly by the department as directed by the commissioner.
obligations.quote: In all cases where the permitted work does not require the issuance of a certificate of occupancy, the final inspection shall be performed by an approved agency on behalf of the owner or by the department as directed by the commissioner.
obligations.deadline_text: The applicant shall take all reasonable and necessary steps to ensure that the final inspection is performed within one year after the expiration of the last permit.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Perform final inspection for permitted work in R-2 occupancies listed on the Department of Housing Preservation and Development's website and charge a fee for such inspection.
obligations.quote: Final inspection shall be performed by the department for permitted work in R-2 occupancies if the building is listed on the department of housing preservation and development's website pursuant to paragraph 6 of subdivision m of section 27-2115 of the administrative code. The department shall charge a fee for such inspection.
obligations.deadline_text: within one year after the expiration of the last permit
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Not approve construction documents for construction or alteration in special flood hazard areas unless the application complies with the requirements of appendix G of the New York City Building Code.
obligations.quote: Within coastal special flood hazard areas and special flood hazard areas, the commissioner shall not approve construction documents for construction or alteration of buildings or structures, including alterations pursuant to section 28-101.4.3 of this code, or for any other activity regulated by section G201 of appendix G of the New York city building code, unless the application complies with the requirements of appendix G of the New York city building code.
affected_groups: property owners in flood hazard areas
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Ensure that streets are suitably improved in accordance with standards prescribed by the Department of Transportation as required by state law.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall ensure that streets are suitably improved in accordance with the standards prescribed by the department of transportation as required by subdivision 2 of section 36 of the New York state general city law and shall otherwise carry out the provisions of such subdivision.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Maintain records of final inspections for a period of six years after sign-off or such other period as required by the commissioner and make records available to the department upon request.
obligations.quote: Records of final inspections made by approved agencies shall be maintained by such persons for a period of six years after sign-off or for such other period as the commissioner shall require and shall be made available to the department upon request.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Limit by rule the amount of deduction authorized for renewable energy credits, considering availability, environmental justice impacts, and other relevant factors.
obligations.quote: The department shall by rule limit the amount of a deduction authorized pursuant to section 28-320.6.1. In determining such limit, the department shall consider items 1 through 3 of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules ensuring that greenhouse gas offsets exhibit environmental integrity principles including additionality, in consultation with the Office of Long-Term Planning and Sustainability.
obligations.quote: Such greenhouse gas offsets must exhibit environmental integrity principles, including additionality, in accordance with rules promulgated by the department in consultation with the office of long term planning and sustainability.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Consult the advisory board on environmental justice before promulgating rules regarding greenhouse gas offset standards.
obligations.quote: Prior to the department promulgation of rules pursuant to this section, the department shall consult the advisory board on environmental justice as established by section 3-1006 of the administrative code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.actor_raw: the rules of the New York city department of environmental protection
obligations.action_summary: Contain a provision requiring temporary structures for asbestos abatement activities to be noncombustible or flame resistant in compliance with specified standards.
obligations.quote: The rules of the New York city department of environmental protection relating to materials used in the construction of temporary structures for asbestos abatement activities shall contain a provision requiring such structures to be noncombustible or flame resistant in compliance with reference standard NFPA 255-06 or NFPA 701-99, as such standards may be modified by local law or by the department of buildings pursuant to applicable rules.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city plumbing code, the New York city building code, the New York city mechanical code and the New York city fuel gas code, in relation to technical corrections, clarifications and modifications to provisions of the New York city construction codes

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and post on the department's website an annual report on District 75 programs including student enrollment data disaggregated by multiple demographics and the process and criteria used to determine locations of District 75 programs.
obligations.quote: No later than August 30, 2023, and annually thereafter, the department shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report regarding information on all district 75 programs for the prior school year.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than August 30, 2023, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of education to report on the number of District 75 students and the criteria used to determine the location of District 75 schools

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Establish a jail population review program that conducts reviews of covered persons to identify opportunities for early case resolution or pretrial release with appropriate conditions.
obligations.quote: the office shall establish a jail population review program that shall conduct a review of covered persons to identify opportunities for early case resolution or pretrial release with any appropriate conditions
obligations.deadline_text: No later than October 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Implement a citywide jail population review program across all boroughs.
obligations.quote: the office shall implement a citywide program by July 1, 2024
obligations.deadline_text: by July 1, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Establish criteria for determining whether a case presents opportunities for early case resolution or pretrial release and review each covered person based on such criteria.
obligations.quote: The jail population review program shall (i) establish criteria for determining whether a case presents opportunities for early case resolution or pretrial release with any appropriate conditions and (ii) review each covered person based on such criteria
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Provide all material information collected during the review to the covered person's attorney as early as practicable.
obligations.quote: The office shall provide, as early as practicable, all the material information collected during the review to the covered person's attorney
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Establish confidentiality protocols for the jail population review program to ensure that all information is collected, maintained, and disclosed in accordance with applicable law and policies.
obligations.quote: The office shall establish confidentiality protocols for the jail population review program to ensure that all information collected to conduct the individualized review required by this section is collected, maintained, and disclosed in accordance with applicable law and policies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.agency: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.agency_full: the office of the criminal justice coordinator
obligations.action_summary: Publish on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a biannual report within 60 days of January 1 and July 1 of each year containing specified information about covered persons reviewed and released.
obligations.quote: The office shall publish on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a biannual report submitted within 60 days of January 1 and July 1 of each year
obligations.deadline_text: within 60 days of January 1 and July 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a comprehensive jail population review program

obligations.action_summary: Create and maintain a website where schools may list surplus school supplies for claiming by other schools.
obligations.quote: The department shall create and maintain a website where schools may list surplus school supplies for the purpose of allowing such surplus supplies to be claimed for use by other schools.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of education to create a website for schools to list surplus school supplies to be claimed for use by other schools

obligations.action_summary: Post on the department's website a document with guidelines and information on establishing afterschool programs, including chancellors regulations, staff hiring and payment protocols, insurance guidelines, IRS guidelines, explanations of relevant laws, best practices for curriculum integration, and contact information for departmental assistance.
obligations.quote: The chancellor shall post on the department's website a document with guidelines and information on establishing afterschool programs. The document shall include, but not be limited to: a. A list of chancellor's regulations for afterschool programs; b. Protocols explaining the guidelines by which afterschool programs may hire and pay staff and contractors, including department employees; c. Insurance guidelines for afterschool programs; d. Internal revenue service guidelines for operators of afterschool programs; e. A brief list and explanation of significant federal, state, and local laws regulating afterschool programs; f. Best practices and options for successfully integrating afterschool programming with school curricula, common core state standards, and curricula for students receiving additional instructional services; and g. Contact information for the department employee or designee who can provide assistance in the creation of afterschool programs.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of education to provide information on establishing afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post such report on its website based on data from the prior calendar year, including data on pregnant persons in custody, pregnancy outcomes, maternal mortalities, and prenatal and postnatal care.
obligations.quote: correctional health services, in consultation with the relevant agencies, shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post such report on its website based on data from the prior calendar year.
obligations.deadline_text: By no later than 90 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to reporting on medical care and outcomes for incarcerated pregnant persons in the custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Report information on medical care and outcomes for incarcerated pregnant persons in a manner that does not jeopardize the confidentiality of an incarcerated pregnant person.
obligations.quote: The service shall report information required by subdivision b of this section in a manner that does not jeopardize the confidentiality of an incarcerated pregnant person.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to reporting on medical care and outcomes for incarcerated pregnant persons in the custody of the department of correction

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Invalidate any statement of registration or amendment that has been found to contain false information.
obligations.quote: The department shall invalidate any statement required under this article that has been found to contain false information.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing penalties for violations issued by the department of housing preservation and development and certifying correction of violations in multiple dwellings

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: By January 15, 2025 or the first business day thereafter, and each calendar year thereafter, compile and post on its website a list of 100 multiple dwellings that have more than 20 hazardous or immediately hazardous violations certified as corrected in the previous calendar year with at least four falsely certified.
obligations.quote: by the later of either January 15, 2025, or the first business day thereafter, and each calendar year thereafter, the department shall compile and post on its website a list of 100 multiple dwellings for which the department has determined that: (A) more than 20 hazardous violations or immediately hazardous violations have been certified as corrected during the previous calendar year, other than a violation issued pursuant to section 27-2017.4 of this code, and (B) at least four of such hazardous or immediately hazardous violations that have been certified as corrected during such calendar year were falsely certified as corrected
obligations.deadline_text: by the later of either January 15, 2025, or the first business day thereafter, and each calendar year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing penalties for violations issued by the department of housing preservation and development and certifying correction of violations in multiple dwellings

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules excluding any immediately hazardous or hazardous violation from calculation in the number of violations certified as corrected when the owner has taken steps toward correcting the condition but compliance may not have been achieved.
obligations.quote: The department may promulgate rules excluding any immediately hazardous or hazardous violation from calculation in the number of violations certified as corrected for purposes of compiling the list described in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph when the nature of the condition of any such violation is such that the owner has taken steps toward correcting such condition but compliance may not have been achieved.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to 180 days after it becomes law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing penalties for violations issued by the department of housing preservation and development and certifying correction of violations in multiple dwellings

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of housing preservation and development
obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Take measures necessary for implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules.
obligations.quote: the commissioner of housing preservation and development shall take such measures as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such date.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to 180 days after it becomes law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing penalties for violations issued by the department of housing preservation and development and certifying correction of violations in multiple dwellings

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Select 50 class A multiple dwellings to be subject to heat sensor installation and inspection requirements every year.
obligations.quote: No later than July 1, 2024, and every year thereafter, the department shall select 50 class A multiple dwellings that shall be subject to the requirements of this subdivision.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2024, and every year thereafter
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing criteria for selecting class A multiple dwellings subject to heat sensor requirements, including violation history and heat complaints.
obligations.quote: The department shall select such class A multiple dwellings pursuant to criteria set forth in rules of the department, which shall include, but need not be limited to: (i) the number of violations of subdivision a of section 27-2029 over the preceding two years, and (ii) whether the department has received heat complaints from more than one dwelling unit in such class A multiple dwelling.
affected_groups: property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Conduct inspections of each selected class A multiple dwelling at least twice each month during heat season for compliance with heat and temperature reporting device requirements.
obligations.quote: Annually, for the duration of heat season, the department shall conduct inspections of each class A multiple dwelling selected pursuant to this subdivision at least twice each month, without receipt of complaints, for compliance with the requirements of this section, section 27-2028 and subdivision a of section 27-2029, consistent with applicable law and in accordance with rules of the department.
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Inspect during heat season inspections to ensure internet capable temperature reporting devices are installed in accordance with department rules.
obligations.quote: In the course of such inspections, the department shall also inspect to ensure the device is installed in accordance with subparagraph (b) of paragraph 3 of this subdivision.
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing procedures for property owner notification of heat sensor requirements, installation deadlines, tenant rights, and device placement options.
obligations.quote: Notify all tenants, at a time and manner described in rules promulgated by the department, regarding the requirements of this section, including installation of such devices, instructions on how to access the information collected by such devices, and the tenant's right of refusal, and the tenant's right to request that such device be installed in a living room of the tenant's choice within the dwelling in accordance with subparagraph (b) of this paragraph
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Prescribe by rule the records property owners must maintain relating to installation, maintenance, and heat data collection from internet capable temperature reporting devices.
obligations.quote: Maintain such records as the commissioner shall prescribe by rule relating to the installation and maintenance of such internet capable temperature reporting devices and collection of heat data from such devices, and make such records available to the commissioner upon request, consistent with applicable law and in accordance with rules of the department
affected_groups: property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Establish by rule procedures for property owners to document and report reasonable efforts to gain access to tenant dwelling units for heat sensor installation.
obligations.quote: Maintain a record of reasonable efforts, in accordance with procedures prescribed by rule of the department, to gain access to a tenant's dwelling unit to install an internet capable temperature reporting device where the owner has been unable to gain such access and such tenant has not refused the installation of such device pursuant to paragraph 7 of this subdivision
affected_groups: property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Post notices in designated citywide languages in prominent places of selected multiple dwellings informing tenants of heat sensor requirements, inspection frequency, opt-out rights, and heat complaint procedures.
obligations.quote: Upon selection of a multiple dwelling pursuant to paragraph 1 of this subdivision, the department shall post a notice in each of the designated citywide languages in section 23-1101 in a prominent place of such multiple dwelling, notifying tenants of the requirements of this section, a tenant's option to refuse the installation of such device in their dwelling unit, the requirement of twice monthly inspections by the department, and a tenant's option to call 311 to file a complaint relating to inadequate heat and to check the department's website for the issuance of heat violations.
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Monitor that required notices are posted throughout the time period that each multiple dwelling is subject to inspection under the heat sensor program.
obligations.quote: The department shall monitor that such notice is posted throughout the time period that such multiple dwelling is subject to inspection by the department pursuant to paragraph 2 of this subdivision.
affected_groups: tenants in class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Establish by rule a discharge process allowing property owners to be relieved of heat sensor requirements upon meeting specified compliance criteria.
obligations.quote: An owner of a multiple dwelling selected pursuant to this subdivision who has not complied with the requirements of paragraph 3 of this subdivision but is otherwise eligible for discharge pursuant to subparagraph (a) of this paragraph may be discharged from the requirements of this section upon payment of a penalty of $500 as the department shall provide by rule for each violation of this section.
affected_groups: property owners of class A multiple dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding the heat sensors program

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor and speaker of the council by August 1 of each year documenting heat sensor program implementation, selected dwellings, violations, complaints, and temperature data analysis.
obligations.quote: On or before August 1 of each year, the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report containing, at a minimum: 1. Information about the implementation of the requirements of this section; 2. A list of the class A multiple dwellings selected in the most recent selection cycle pursuant to subdivision b of this section; 3. The number of heat complaints from each of the two immediately preceding heat seasons associated with each class A multiple dwelling on such list; 4. The number of violations of section 27-2028 and subdivision a of section 27-2029 issued in each of the two immediately preceding heat seasons to each class A multiple dwelling on such list; 5. Where such information is available to the department, whether the owner of a class A multiple dwelling on such list corrected the condition that resulted in any violation of section 27-2028 or subdivision a of section 27-2029; 6. An evaluation of information that was collected from internet capable temperature reporting devices installed pursuant to this section; 7. obligations.quote: LEED green building rating system. The term "LEED green building rating system" means a version of the leadership in energy and environmental design (LEED) building rating system published by the United States green building council that is not less stringent than the selected green building rating system, or another standard not less stringent than the selected green building rating system which has been developed by or for the city consisting of practices and technologies derived from the LEED rating system that are reasonable and appropriate for building in New York city and approved by the mayor.
