obligations.action_summary: Require that statements made in connection with rebate applications be made under oath and contain a specified certification declaration.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall require that statements made in connection with any application filed pursuant to this section be made under oath. Such application shall contain the following declaration: "I certify that all information contained in this application is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that willful making of any false statement of material fact herein will subject me to the provisions of law relevant to the making and filing of false instruments and will render this application null and void."
affected_groups: owners of eligible properties applying for rebates
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Deny a rebate application or revoke a granted rebate if the property does not serve as the owner's primary residence, title has been transferred to a non-family member, or the property is otherwise ineligible.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall deny an application for a rebate or revoke any rebate granted pursuant to this section if it appears that: (i) the property does not serve as the primary residence of the owner who has applied for such rebate or who received the real property tax exemption pursuant to section 425 of the real property tax law or a school tax relief credit pursuant to subsection (eee) of section 606 of the tax law for such property for the fiscal year commencing on July 1, 2022; (ii) prior to the granting of the rebate authorized by this section, title to the property has been transferred to a new owner other than to an immediate family member for whom the property serves as the primary residence until, at a minimum, the date on which such rebate is granted, provided that the commissioner of finance has been notified of any such transfer to an immediate family member in connection with the application authorized by subdivision 6 of this section; or (iii) the property is otherwise no longer eligible for the rebate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Send notice of revocation to affected owners by mail or electronic means no later than June 30, 2023.
obligations.quote: Upon determining that a rebate granted pursuant to this section shall be revoked, the commissioner of finance shall send a notice so stating to the affected owner. Such notice shall be sent by mail or by electronic means no later than June 30, 2023.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than June 30, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Send notice of denial of rebate to owners who received a STAR exemption or credit and are determined ineligible.
obligations.quote: To the extent the commissioner of finance determines that such an owner is not entitled to the rebate authorized by this section, the commissioner shall send to such owner a notice of denial of the rebate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: May grant a waiver of the electronic filing requirement upon showing by an applicant that such filing is not practicable due to lack of access to or ability to use required technology.
obligations.quote: Upon a showing by an applicant that filing an application by electronic means is not practicable for reasons including but not limited to lack of access to, or ability to use, the technology needed to file by electronic means, the commissioner of finance may grant a waiver of the requirement to file such application by electronic means.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: May provide a credit against annual tax of an eligible property equal to the rebate amount when an owner requests reissuance of a rebate check, provided no such credit is provided later than two years from the date the rebate is granted.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance may provide a credit against the annual tax of an eligible property in the amount of the rebate when an owner of an eligible property requests that a check in the amount of the rebate be re-issued to such owner, except that no such credit shall be provided later than two years from the date the rebate is granted.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Recover erroneous rebates within six years of granting by deducting the amount from any refunds otherwise payable and imposing a tax lien on the property if balance remains unpaid.
obligations.quote: If the commissioner of finance determines that an owner received an erroneous rebate, the commissioner of finance shall recover such erroneous rebate, within six years of the granting of such rebate, by deducting the amount of such erroneous rebate from any refund otherwise payable to the owner of such property, and any balance of the amount of such erroneous rebate remaining unpaid shall constitute a tax lien on the property of such owner as of the due and payable date provided on the tax bill mailed by the commissioner of finance containing such amount.
obligations.deadline_text: within six years of the granting of such rebate
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Determine material misstatements in rebate applications within three years of granting and impose a penalty tax of $500 on the property in addition to recovery of any erroneous rebate.
obligations.quote: If the commissioner of finance determines, within three years from the granting of a rebate authorized by this section, that there was a material misstatement in an application filed pursuant to this section and that such misstatement provided the basis for the granting of a rebate under this section, the commissioner of finance shall proceed to impose a penalty tax against the property of $500 in addition to recovering the amount of any erroneous rebate under subdivision 12 of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: within three years from the granting of a rebate authorized by this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: Give notice of possible imposition of penalty tax and allow owners to seek administrative and judicial review.
obligations.quote: Each owner shall be given notice of the possible imposition of a penalty tax, and shall be entitled to seek administrative and judicial review of such action in the manner provided by law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a rebate against real property taxes for certain owners of real property

obligations.action_summary: May request proof of residency and information relating to qualified gross income from any owner seeking to receive a rebate.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to offering discharge upgrade assistance and extending city veteran benefits to service members who were discharged because of their LGBTQ status

obligations.action_summary: Issue a certificate of eligibility to any discharged LGBTQ veteran upon request as proof of eligibility for city services and benefits.
obligations.quote: Upon request, the department shall issue a certificate of eligibility to a discharged LGBTQ veteran as proof of their eligibility to receive certain services and benefits for veterans.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to offering discharge upgrade assistance and extending city veteran benefits to service members who were discharged because of their LGBTQ status

obligations.action_summary: Make available on the department's website information about obtaining certificates of eligibility for discharged LGBTQ veterans and the availability of legal assistance for discharge upgrades.
obligations.quote: Make available on the department's website information about (i) obtaining certificates of eligibility for discharged LGBTQ veterans and (ii) the availability of legal assistance, to any discharged LGBTQ veteran seeking a discharge characterization upgrade
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to offering discharge upgrade assistance and extending city veteran benefits to service members who were discharged because of their LGBTQ status

obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach through email, social media, and other means to raise awareness about certificates of eligibility and the availability of legal assistance for discharged LGBTQ veterans.
obligations.quote: Conduct outreach through email, social media and other means to raise awareness about such certificates and the availability of such legal assistance.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to offering discharge upgrade assistance and extending city veteran benefits to service members who were discharged because of their LGBTQ status

obligations.action_summary: Periodically review veterans' experience with accessing discharge upgrade assistance and report any identified issues to the speaker of the council by June 1, 2022, and annually thereafter.
obligations.quote: The department shall periodically review veterans' experience with accessing the assistance required pursuant to subdivision c of this section and shall report any identified issues to the speaker of the council by June 1, 2022, and annually thereafter.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to offering discharge upgrade assistance and extending city veteran benefits to service members who were discharged because of their LGBTQ status

obligations.action_summary: Post on the department's website and submit to the speaker of the council annual information on supportive housing applicants, placements, rejections, and outcomes contained within the coordinated assessment and placement system (CAPS).
obligations.quote: the commissioner of social services shall post on the department's website and submit to the speaker of the council information on supportive housing contained within the coordinated assessment and placement system (CAPS) for the preceding fiscal year
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than September 1, 2022 and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to reporting on supportive housing

obligations.action_summary: Review relevant records and incorporate into the coordinated assessment and placement system (CAPS) any information required by the reporting obligations that is not already tracked by CAPS.
obligations.quote: the department shall, after reviewing relevant records, no later than September 1, 2023, incorporate into the coordinated assessment and placement system (CAPS) and include such information in the reports required pursuant to this section
obligations.deadline_text: no later than September 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to reporting on supportive housing

obligations.agency: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.agency_full: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.action_summary: Undertake a study of government sites for the potential development of geothermal exchange systems to serve government buildings, including identification and evaluation of potential sites based on specified criteria.
obligations.quote: The director shall undertake a study of government sites for the potential development of geothermal exchange systems to serve government buildings. Such study shall include identification and evaluation of potential government sites for development of a geothermal exchange system as part of a demonstration program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a demonstration program for geothermal exchange systems

obligations.agency: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.agency_full: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.action_summary: Select a maximum of 10 sites evaluated in the study that are indicated for development of one or more geothermal exchange systems for a demonstration program, based on determination of sites presenting greatest potential benefits.
obligations.quote: The director, in consultation with the head of the administering agency, and in compliance with sections 197-c and 197-d of the charter, if applicable, shall select a maximum of 10 sites evaluated in the study conducted pursuant to paragraph 1 of this subdivision that are indicated for the development of one or more geothermal exchange systems for a demonstration program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a demonstration program for geothermal exchange systems

obligations.action_summary: Designate in writing an office or agency to implement and administer the demonstration program and other provisions of this section, and post such designation on the administering agency's website.
obligations.quote: the mayor shall designate an office or agency to implement and administer the demonstration program and other provisions of this section, in consultation with the director. Such designation shall be made in writing and shall be posted on the administering agency's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a demonstration program for geothermal exchange systems

obligations.agency: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.agency_full: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.action_summary: Provide to the mayor and speaker of the council a detailed report containing an assessment of the demonstration program, discussion of performance and impacts of geothermal exchange systems, and information on feedback regarding provision of geothermal exchange service.
obligations.quote: the director, in consultation with the head of the administering agency, shall provide to the mayor and speaker of the council a detailed report containing an assessment of the demonstration program, discussion of performance and impacts of any geothermal exchange system created pursuant to this section and information on feedback regarding the provision of geothermal exchange service pursuant to this section.
obligations.deadline_text: On or before March 1, 2023, and on or before March 1 every two years thereafter until March 1, 2033
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a demonstration program for geothermal exchange systems

obligations.agency: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.agency_full: director of the mayor's office of long-term planning and sustainability
obligations.action_summary: If feasible and practicable, provide to the mayor and speaker of the council a detailed proposal for expanding the demonstration program to serve private customers, including recommendations for any required legislation.
obligations.quote: If the director, in consultation with the administering agency, determines that expanding the demonstration program described in this section to serve private customers is feasible and practicable, the director shall provide to the mayor and speaker of the council a detailed proposal for doing so, including recommendations for any legislation required to implement such proposal.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a demonstration program for geothermal exchange systems

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Identify each intersection immediately adjacent to a school where no traffic control device is located.
obligations.quote: No later than September 30, 2022, the department shall identify each intersection immediately adjacent to a school where no traffic control device is located.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 30, 2022
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the installation of traffic control devices at intersections adjacent to schools

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Install a traffic control device at each intersection identified as immediately adjacent to a school and lacking such a device, determining the appropriate type based on the manual on uniform traffic control devices and engineering expertise.
obligations.quote: No later than September 30, 2024, the department shall install a traffic control device at each intersection identified pursuant to the requirement set forth in subdivision b of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 30, 2024
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the installation of traffic control devices at intersections adjacent to schools

obligations.agency_full: Office of the New York City Comptroller
obligations.action_summary: Monitor city financial assistance recipients' and covered employers' compliance with labor peace agreement requirements; conduct investigations upon complaint or when violations are suspected; report findings to the mayor.
obligations.quote: The comptroller shall monitor the city financial assistance recipients' and covered employers' compliance with the requirements of this section. Whenever the comptroller has reason to believe there has been a violation of this section, or upon a verified complaint in writing from an interested party, the comptroller shall conduct an investigation to determine the facts relating thereto. Based upon such investigation, hearing and findings, the comptroller shall report the results of such investigation and hearing to the mayor.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring labor peace agreement for certain city economic development projects
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.actor_raw: the comptroller and city or city economic development entity that executed the project agreement
obligations.agency: the comptroller and city or city economic development entity that executed the project agreement
obligations.agency_full: the comptroller and city or city economic development entity that executed the project agreement
obligations.action_summary: Maintain and make available for public inspection all certifications submitted by city financial assistance recipients and covered employers regarding labor peace agreement compliance.
obligations.quote: The comptroller and city or city economic development entity that executed the project agreement shall maintain each certification submitted pursuant to this subdivision and make such certifications available for public inspection until the sixth anniversary of the conclusion of the term of the project agreement.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring labor peace agreement for certain city economic development projects
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.action_summary: Upon receipt of the comptroller's investigation report, issue orders or determinations imposing sanctions, contractual remedies, or declaring default against city financial assistance recipients or covered employers found in violation of labor peace agreement requirements.
obligations.quote: Based on the comptroller's report or any other information available to the mayor, the mayor may, after providing the city financial assistance recipient or covered employer an opportunity to cure any violations, where appropriate, issue an order, determination or other disposition.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring labor peace agreement for certain city economic development projects
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate implementing rules and regulations governing the labor peace agreement requirements; may delegate such authority to the comptroller.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall promulgate implementing rules and regulations, as appropriate and consistent with this section, and may delegate such authority to the comptroller.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such date [120 days after enactment]
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring labor peace agreement for certain city economic development projects
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
obligations.action_summary: Enforce the COVID-19 child vaccination time requirements and penalties set forth in sections 20-924(d)(vi)-(vii) and 20-924(e) of the Administrative Code.
obligations.quote: the department shall not enforce paragraph (vi) or (vii) of subdivision d of section 20-924 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section nine of this local law, or subdivision e of such section 20-924, as amended by section nine of this local law, during the 60 days after it becomes law without first providing an employer with written notice of an alleged violation and 15 days to cure such alleged violation.
obligations.deadline_text: during the 60 days after it becomes law without first providing an employer with written notice of an alleged violation and 15 days to cure such alleged violation
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to providing paid time to employees who accompany a child to receive a COVID-19 vaccination injection or care for a child with COVID-19 vaccine side effects
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer Affairs and Business Licensing

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Program each parking meter to deactivate during non-meter-rules hours and when the meter cannot produce receipts or lacks payment-tracking functionality.
obligations.quote: The department shall program each parking meter to ensure that such parking meter is unable to accept payment: 1. from the last time in a day that parking meter rules are in effect for any parking space within the blockface or parking field of such parking meter, or for any other parking space within 100 feet of such parking meter, until one hour prior to the next time meter rules take effect for any parking space within the blockface or parking field, or for any other parking space within 100 feet of such parking meter; and 2. when such parking meter is not capable of producing receipts or lacks the functionality to track parking payments.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Forward notice of new parking meter installation covering at least four contiguous blockfaces to affected council members and community boards by electronic mail.
obligations.quote: Prior to the installation of new parking meters covering at least four contiguous blockfaces, the department shall forward notice of such installation to the affected council member(s) and community board(s) by electronic mail.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Review any recommendations or comments received from affected council members and community boards prior to the installation of new parking meters.
obligations.quote: Any recommendations or comments received by the department pursuant to this subdivision shall be reviewed prior to the installation of such new parking meters.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Provide at least 30 days written notice by regular first-class mail and electronic mail to community boards and council members before making changes to parking meter rates or replacing a parking meter with a different type, and post such notice on the department's website.
obligations.quote: Prior to making changes to parking meter rates or replacing a parking meter with a different type of parking meter, the department shall provide at least 30 days written notice of such changes by regular first-class mail and electronic mail to the community board and council member in whose district the affected parking meters are or will be located and shall post such written notice on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Program the electronic parking meter system to prohibit cancellation of notices of violation for pay-and-display parking meters later than five minutes after issuance.
obligations.quote: The electronic parking meter system shall be programmed to prohibit such notice from being canceled later than five minutes after the issuance of such notice.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Program the electronic parking meter system to automatically cancel notices of violation for pay-by-plate parking meters when parking time is purchased within five minutes after notice issuance.
obligations.quote: If an agent has issued a notice of violation by electronic means for failure to pay the parking charge required at a pay-by-plate parking meter, and parking time is purchased for such vehicle for the blockface where the vehicle is located not more than five minutes after the notice of violation was issued, such notice of violation shall be canceled automatically by the electronic parking meter system.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to parking meters, and to repeal section 19-167 of such code, relating to suspending the activation of parking meters on Sundays; section 19-167.1 of such code, relating to parking at broken or missing meters or muni-meters; section 19-167.2 of such code, relating to transfer of muni-meter time; section 19-167.3 of such code, relating to deactivating muni-meters; section 19-167.4 of such code, relating to new muni-meter installation; section 19-175.3 of such code, relating to notification of changes relating to parking meters; section 19-214 of such code, relating to failure to display a muni-meter receipt; and section 19-215 of such code, relating to cancellation of certain tickets

obligations.agency_full: Department of Youth and Community Development
obligations.action_summary: Count time spent by runaway or homeless youth in runaway and homeless youth services during any 90 days of the previous two years as time spent in shelter for purposes of determining rental assistance eligibility.
obligations.quote: the department shall count the time a runaway youth or homeless youth spent in runaway and homeless youth services during any 90 days of the previous two years in place of time spent in shelter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to runaway and homeless youth eligibility for rental assistance

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Establish a methodology for determining where loading zones are necessary to enhance safety and reduce traffic congestion, considering commercial and residential density, requests from city elected officials, and members of the public, and publish such methodology on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department shall establish a methodology for determining where loading zones are necessary to enhance safety and reduce traffic congestion, considering factors including, but not limited to, commercial and residential density as well as requests from city elected officials and members of the public, and shall publish such methodology on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Install at least five loading zones annually in every neighborhood tabulation area that meets the methodology, and install at least 500 total loading zones in each of the first three years following the effective date of this local law.
obligations.quote: The department shall install at least five loading zones annually in every neighborhood tabulation area that meets this methodology, provided that, for each of the first three years following the effective date of this local law, the department installs at least 500 total loading zones.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor, and publish on its website, a report detailing the ongoing implementation of loading zone requirements and recommendations for further expanding loading zones citywide.
obligations.quote: No later than January 1, 2023, the department shall submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor, and publish on its website, a report detailing the ongoing implementation of the requirements of subdivision b of this section and any recommendations for further expanding loading zones citywide.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than January 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Provide publicly accessible information through the open data portal or the department's website regarding the location of all loading zones, and update such information on an annual or more frequent basis.
obligations.quote: No later than January 1, 2023, the department shall provide publicly accessible information, through the open data portal or the department's website, regarding the location of all loading zones. Such information shall be updated on an annual or more frequent basis.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than January 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to expanding loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Specify the particular manner in which a temporary truck loading zone for an affected street segment or intersection should be maintained when a permittee's work obstructs an existing truck loading zone.
obligations.quote: The department shall specify the particular manner in which the temporary truck loading zone for such street segment or intersection should be maintained.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to truck loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Regulate commercial parking meter areas with a parking meter, mobile payment system, parking reservation system, or other means.
obligations.quote: The department shall regulate commercial parking meter areas with a parking meter, mobile payment system, a parking reservation system, or other means as determined by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to truck loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Evaluate paid commercial parking rules and determine whether there are locations where time limits of more than three hours are appropriate based on curb access needs and delivery consolidation impacts.
obligations.quote: The department shall evaluate its paid commercial parking rules and determine whether there are locations where time limits of more than three hours are appropriate based on curb access needs and if such changes encourage delivery consolidation or reduction of truck trips.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to truck loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules and take such measures as are necessary for implementation of this local law.
obligations.quote: the department shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before such date.
obligations.deadline_text: before 180 days after it becomes law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to truck loading zones

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Release a public solicitation to learn about opportunities and challenges to using micro-distribution centers for deliveries in the city.
obligations.quote: The department shall release a public solicitation to learn about opportunities and challenges to using micro-distribution centers for deliveries in the city.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to micro-distribution centers for distributing goods via sustainable modes of transportation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a report summarizing feedback from the freight industry, challenges and opportunities for micro-distribution centers, recommendations on how the city can encourage and facilitate them, and the means and methods the city plans to pursue.
obligations.quote: the department shall post on its website, and submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor, a report that includes, at a minimum, the following information
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2022
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to micro-distribution centers for distributing goods via sustainable modes of transportation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Establish a pilot program to support the creation, operation or expansion of micro-distribution centers in order to reduce emissions and alleviate vehicle congestion on city streets.
obligations.quote: the department shall establish a pilot program to support the creation, operation or expansion of micro-distribution centers in order to reduce emissions and alleviate vehicle congestion on city streets.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than July 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to micro-distribution centers for distributing goods via sustainable modes of transportation

obligations.action_summary: Establish an office of not-for-profit organization services, which may be located in the executive office of the mayor or within another mayoral office or department.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall establish an office of not-for-profit organization services. Such office may be established in the executive office of the mayor and may be established as a separate office or within any other office of the mayor or within any department the head of which is appointed by the mayor.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or the head of such department
obligations.action_summary: Appoint an executive director to head the office of not-for-profit organization services.
obligations.quote: Such office shall be headed by an executive director who shall be appointed by the mayor or the head of such department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Serve as a liaison to not-for-profit organizations regarding city policies, procedures, regulations, contracting and funding opportunities, programs and benefits.
obligations.quote: Serve as a liaison to not-for-profit organizations in relation to city policies, procedures, regulations, contracting and funding opportunities, programs and benefits affecting the not-for-profit sector
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach to not-for-profit organizations to provide information and assistance regarding city policies, procedures, regulations, contracting and funding opportunities, and maintain a central website with such information.
obligations.quote: Conduct outreach to not-for-profit organizations to provide information and assistance to such organizations in relation to existing city policies, procedures, regulations, contracting and funding opportunities, and programs and benefits, including but not limited to maintaining a central website containing information and assistance that can be accessed by not-for-profit organizations
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Work with agencies to refer not-for-profit organizations to city services that assist in obtaining relevant exemptions, waivers, permits, registrations or approvals.
obligations.quote: Work with agencies to refer not-for-profit organizations to city services that assist such organizations in obtaining relevant exemptions, waivers, permits, registrations or approvals from agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Make referrals to relevant state agencies and other organizations providing information and assistance to individuals or groups seeking to incorporate or register as not-for-profit organizations.
obligations.quote: Make referrals to relevant state agencies and other organizations that provide information and assistance to individuals or groups who are seeking to incorporate or register as not-for-profit organizations
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Advise and assist the mayor and agencies on simplifying and streamlining interactions between not-for-profit organizations and city offices and agencies regarding applications, contracts, and regulations.
obligations.quote: Advise and assist the mayor, offices established within the executive office of the mayor, including the mayor's office of contract services, and agencies that interface with not-for-profit organizations on simplifying and streamlining interactions between not-for-profit organizations and any such offices and agencies
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Develop standing advisory committees comprised of representatives from agencies and not-for-profit organizations to identify challenges and encourage communication and collaboration.
obligations.quote: Develop standing advisory committees comprised of representatives from agencies and not-for-profit organizations representing the range of not-for-profit organizations doing business with the city, and the range of services provided
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing an office of not-for-profit organization services

obligations.action_summary: Study conditions affecting the not-for-profit sector in the city and assess its health and economic well-being.
obligations.quote: Study conditions affecting the not-for-profit sector in the city and assess its health and economic well-being
