obligations.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules addressing fire safety at production locations, establishing fire safety standards, procedures, and requirements based on location occupancy, construction, condition, and nature of production activities.
obligations.quote: The department shall promulgate rules addressing fire safety at production locations. Such rules shall establish fire safety standards, procedures and requirements in consideration of such location's occupancy, construction and condition
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city fire code, in relation to establishing fire safety provisions for film production locations and requiring production location fire safety managers for certain rigging, filming and production activities
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
obligations.action_summary: Enforce compliance with fire safety requirements at production locations, including supervision by certified fire safety managers, presence of department representatives or standby apparatus, and cessation of activities when unsafe conditions arise.
obligations.citation: NYC Fire Code § FC 325.2 and § FC 325.3
obligations.quote: The department shall promulgate rules addressing fire safety at production locations. Such rules shall establish fire safety standards, procedures and requirements in consideration of such location's occupancy, construction and condition
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city fire code, in relation to establishing fire safety provisions for film production locations and requiring production location fire safety managers for certain rigging, filming and production activities
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Include in each contract with a value exceeding $20,000,000 with a Brooklyn navy yard development entity a provision requiring that entity to submit an annual report on progress toward master plan goals.
obligations.quote: Each contract with a value in excess of $20,000,000 registered by the comptroller, on or after April 1, 2021, between the department and a Brooklyn navy yard development entity shall include a provision obligating the Brooklyn navy yard development entity to submit a report
obligations.deadline_text: on or after April 1, 2021
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to an annual report on the progress of the Brooklyn Navy Yard master plan

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study assessing the feasibility of constructing a wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island, including consideration of population projections, alternatives to wastewater treatment and disposal, facility capacity requirements, wastewater diversion potential, and combined sewer overflow capture capacity.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of environmental protection, in consultation with the commissioner of sanitation, shall conduct a study to assess the feasibility of constructing a wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island. The study shall consider population projections and possible alternatives to wastewater treatment and disposal, as well as the minimum and maximum capacity a wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island should have, how much wastewater might be able to be diverted from other facilities, and the capacity on Rikers Island for the capture of combined sewer overflow.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 36 months after this local law takes effect
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to conducting a study regarding the feasibility of constructing a new wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island

obligations.action_summary: Assess the presence of methane on Rikers Island, the potential for installation of methane recovery systems, and the use of such systems by any wastewater treatment facility, including consideration of return on investment, public-private partnerships, and potential use for electricity generation.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall also assess, in a separate review, the presence of methane on Rikers Island, the potential for the installation of methane recovery systems, and the use of such systems by any such wastewater treatment facility. Such methane assessment should consider the return on investment of municipally built and operated methane recovery systems, the potential for public-private partnerships, and the potential for the use of methane for electricity generation.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 36 months after this local law takes effect
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to conducting a study regarding the feasibility of constructing a new wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island

obligations.action_summary: Expand the website of the department of environmental protection and other online means of communication to include interactive content and solicit public comment regarding the feasibility study and methane review.
obligations.quote: the website of the department of environmental protection and other online means of communication shall be expanded to include interactive content and solicit public comment.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to conducting a study regarding the feasibility of constructing a new wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island

obligations.action_summary: Submit a report including findings and recommendations relating to the feasibility study and methane review to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the Rikers Island advisory committee, and make the report publicly available on the website of the department of environmental protection.
obligations.quote: Within 36 months after this local law takes effect, the commissioner of environmental protection shall submit a report, including findings and recommendations relating to the feasibility study and the review regarding the presence of methane, to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the Rikers Island advisory committee, and make such report publicly available on the website of the department of environmental protection.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 36 months after this local law takes effect
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to conducting a study regarding the feasibility of constructing a new wastewater treatment facility on Rikers Island

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Establish and maintain a gender and racial equity advisory board to advise the mayor and council on issues relating to gender and racial equity in hospitals and covered health care services.
obligations.quote: There shall be a gender and racial equity advisory board to advise the mayor and the council on issues relating to gender and racial equity in the provision of covered health care services and healthcare services in hospitals.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of an advisory board for gender and racial equity in hospitals

obligations.action_summary: Hold its first meeting no later than 60 days from the appointment of all public members and elect a chairperson at that meeting.
obligations.quote: The advisory board shall hold its first meeting no later than 60 days from the appointment of all its public members and at such meeting shall elect a chairperson.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 60 days from the appointment of all its public members
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of an advisory board for gender and racial equity in hospitals

obligations.action_summary: Meet quarterly, keep a record of proceedings, determine its own rules of proceeding, and call special meetings as needed with at least two weeks' notice.
obligations.quote: The advisory board shall meet quarterly and keep a record of its proceedings, and determine the rules of its own proceedings with special meetings to be called by the chairperson upon his or her own initiative or upon receipt of a written request signed by at least four members of the board.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of an advisory board for gender and racial equity in hospitals

obligations.action_summary: Submit annually to the mayor and speaker of the council, post on the department's website, and share with a trade association representing hospitals a report including the results of its review and recommendations on gender and racial equity in hospitals.
obligations.quote: No later than December 1, 2021, and annually on December 1 thereafter, the advisory board shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council; post on the department's website; and share with a trade association representing hospitals, for distribution to its members operating in New York city, a report including the results of its review and recommendations pursuant to this section.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 1, 2021, and annually on December 1 thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of an advisory board for gender and racial equity in hospitals

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Post the annual advisory board report on the department's website.
obligations.quote: the advisory board shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council; post on the department's website; and share with a trade association representing hospitals, for distribution to its members operating in New York city, a report
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 1, 2021, and annually on December 1 thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of an advisory board for gender and racial equity in hospitals

obligations.action_summary: Establish a temporary program to provide assistance to respondents of judgments resulting from applicable violations resolved by payment, including technical assistance, permit application review, and waiver of all fees for accessory sign permits.
obligations.citation: Section 2 of the local law (amending § 4 of Local Law 28 of 2019)
obligations.quote: the commissioner of buildings shall establish a temporary program to provide assistance to respondents of judgments resulting from applicable violations resolved by payment by the respondent or other payor between June 1, 2006 and the effective date of the local law that last amended this section for a two-year period.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to accessory sign violations and waiving penalties and fees for signs that are accessory to a use on the same zoning lot

obligations.action_summary: Review all permit applications relevant to installation of an accessory sign including preliminary review of compliance with zoning resolution requirements within seven days of receiving the application.
obligations.citation: Section 2 of the local law (amending § 4 of Local Law 28 of 2019)
obligations.quote: Review of all permit applications relevant to the installation of an accessory sign including a preliminary review of compliance with paragraph (a) of section 32-653 or paragraph (a) of section 42-542 of the zoning resolution, or any provision amending, replacing or supplementing such sections of the zoning resolution within seven days of receiving such application
obligations.deadline_text: within seven days of receiving such application
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to accessory sign violations and waiving penalties and fees for signs that are accessory to a use on the same zoning lot

obligations.action_summary: Direct respondents of judgments resulting from applicable violations to the Department of Small Business Services for additional business assistance.
obligations.citation: Section 3 of the local law (amending § 5 of Local Law 28 of 2019)
obligations.quote: Respondents of judgments resulting from applicable violations resolved by payment by the respondent or other payor between June 1, 2006 and the effective date of the local law that last amended this section shall be directed by the department of buildings to the department of small business services for additional business assistance, financial or otherwise.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to accessory sign violations and waiving penalties and fees for signs that are accessory to a use on the same zoning lot

obligations.action_summary: Establish a pilot sampling program to quantify levels of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in sewage at each city wastewater treatment plant, sampling at least twice per week using PCR with N1 Primer or equivalent testing method.
obligations.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of health and mental hygiene, shall establish a pilot sampling program to quantify the levels of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in sewage at each city wastewater treatment plant in accordance with this section. Such sampling program shall occur on a frequency of no less than twice per week
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating a pilot program to test sewage for SARS-CoV-2

obligations.action_summary: Collect sewage samples in an amount necessary to measure copies of SARS-CoV-2 RNA for a pilot program duration of no less than six months.
obligations.quote: the commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of health and mental hygiene, shall collect sewage samples in an amount necessary to measure the copies of SARS-CoV-2 RNA.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating a pilot program to test sewage for SARS-CoV-2

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report including sampling results disaggregated by site and date, program costs, effectiveness analysis, and recommendations regarding expansion, extension, weekly testing, sequencing methods, and permanency.
obligations.quote: No later than January 31, 2022, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report, which shall include, but not be limited to the following:
obligations.deadline_text: No later than January 31, 2022
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating a pilot program to test sewage for SARS-CoV-2

obligations.action_summary: Maintain on the city website sampling results disaggregated by site where the sample was collected, date sample was collected, and date sample was tested.
obligations.quote: The information required by paragraph 1 of subdivision d of this section shall be maintained on the website of the city.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating a pilot program to test sewage for SARS-CoV-2

obligations.action_summary: Post each agency's service level agreements on the single web portal described in section 23-502 of the administrative code.
obligations.quote: Post on the single web portal described in section 23-502 of this code each agency's service level agreements
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to publication of 311 service level agreements

obligations.action_summary: Provide a link to the service level agreements posting in a conspicuous location on the 311 customer service center's website.
obligations.quote: Provide a link to such posting in a conspicuous location on the 311 customer service center's website
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to publication of 311 service level agreements

obligations.action_summary: Create and maintain on a separate page of the 311 customer service center's website information about service level agreements.
obligations.quote: Create and maintain on a separate page of the 311 customer service center's website information about service level agreements
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to publication of 311 service level agreements

obligations.action_summary: Notify the applicable agency when a customer's request for service or complaint has not been closed within the time specified by that agency's service level agreement.
obligations.quote: The 311 customer service center shall notify the applicable agency when a customer's request for service, or complaint, referred by the 311 customer service center to such agency has not been closed within the time specified by such agency's service level agreement
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to publication of 311 service level agreements

obligations.action_summary: Annually conduct at least five campaigns in which customer satisfaction surveys are sent to individuals who have contacted the 311 customer service center in the previous six months.
obligations.quote: The 311 customer service center shall annually conduct at least five campaigns in which customer satisfaction surveys are sent to individuals who have contacted the 311 customer service center in the previous six months.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting 311 customer satisfaction surveys in designated citywide languages

obligations.actor_raw: the 311 customer service center or by an entity contracting with the city to conduct such customer satisfaction survey
obligations.action_summary: Make every customer satisfaction survey available in all designated citywide languages.
obligations.quote: Every customer satisfaction survey administered by the 311 customer service center or by an entity contracting with the city to conduct such customer satisfaction survey shall be made available in all designated citywide languages.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting 311 customer satisfaction surveys in designated citywide languages

obligations.actor_raw: the department of information technology and telecommunications
obligations.action_summary: Issue a report to the speaker of the council and the mayor including the results of each customer satisfaction survey, disaggregated by the language in which such survey was conducted.
obligations.quote: No later than July 1 of each year, the department of information technology and telecommunications shall issue a report to the speaker of the council and the mayor including the results of each survey required by subdivision b of this section, disaggregated by the language in which such survey was conducted.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting 311 customer satisfaction surveys in designated citywide languages

obligations.actor_raw: an agency appointed by the mayor
obligations.agency: an agency appointed by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: an agency appointed by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the city council a report summarizing the impact of the demonstration program established by section two of this local law.
obligations.citation: Section 1, amending § 16 of Local Law 49 of 2019
obligations.quote: an agency appointed by the mayor shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the city council a report summarizing the impact of the demonstration program
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 30 months after the date completed construction documents must be filed with the department of buildings pursuant to section ten of this local law
affected_groups: property owners in the demonstration program
residents of one- and two-family dwellings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend local law number 49 for the year 2019, relating to establishing a demonstration program to facilitate the creation and alteration of habitable apartments in basements and cellars of certain one- and two-family dwellings, in relation to extending the time limit for filing construction documents for such program

obligations.action_summary: Send a written recommendation to the council by May 13 of each year proposing interest rates to be charged for nonpayment of taxes on real property, considering prevailing commercial loan rates.
obligations.quote: By May thirteenth of each year, the banking commission shall send a written recommendation to the council of a proposed interest rate to be charged for nonpayment of taxes on real property.
obligations.deadline_text: By May thirteenth of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Include in the annual recommendation a report describing the factors considered when determining the recommendation, rationale for use of such factors, comparable city interest rates for the two previous fiscal years, and detailed disaggregated data on tax liens in searchable machine-readable format sorted by council district and property class.
obligations.quote: The banking commission's recommendation provided pursuant to subdivision e of this section shall include a report describing the factors considered when determining the recommendation and the rationale for the use of such factors. Such report shall include the interest rate charged for nonpayment of taxes on real property in comparable cities for the two previous fiscal years. Such report shall further include, in a searchable and machine-readable format, sortable by council district, real property tax class, and real property tax sub class, the following information for the current fiscal year and two previous fiscal years
obligations.deadline_text: By May thirteenth of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of finance or his or her designee
obligations.action_summary: Provide a notice relating to the lien sale process to all property owners included with the notice of value and no later than October 31 of each year to delinquent property owners, including information about homeowner actions, debt types, timelines, consequences, contact information, payment plans, exemptions, and electronic registration for outreach sessions.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance or his or her designee, shall provide a notice relating to the lien sale process to all property owners, included with the notice of value sent to property owners by the department of finance pursuant to section 1511 of the New York city charter and, in addition, no later than October thirty-first of each year, to any property owner who is delinquent in the payment of any real property taxes
obligations.deadline_text: no later than October thirty-first of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Develop a hardship declaration form and post it on the department website for property owners seeking exclusion from tax lien sales based on COVID-19-related financial hardship.
obligations.quote: "hardship declaration" means a written statement, in a form to be developed by the department of finance and posted on its website, that: (A) the owner of a covered property is the owner of ten or fewer dwelling units
affected_groups: residential property owners experiencing financial hardship
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Include in the notice required 90, 60, 30, and 10 days prior to tax lien sale a notification informing owners of properties containing dwelling units of their rights under the hardship exception, and provide access to the hardship declaration form with a link on the department website.
obligations.quote: The notice that is required to be mailed by the commissioner of finance pursuant to paragraph one of subdivision b of section 11-320 not less than ninety, sixty, thirty and ten days prior to the date of sale also shall notify owners of real property containing dwelling units of their rights pursuant to this section and that a copy of the hardship declaration can be accessed on the website of the department of finance and provide a link to such hardship declaration.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Confirm prior to the date of sale whether a property is the subject of a judicial proceeding or investigation regarding ownership due to fraudulent deed transmittal, and remove the property from the sale if the owner provides an affidavit and required documentation.
obligations.quote: If, prior to the date of sale, the department of finance confirms that a property is the subject of (i) a judicial proceeding or (ii) an investigation or a prosecution by any agency or office of the United States or any state or subdivision thereof with regard to the ownership of such property arising from the fraudulent transmittal of a deed relating to such property, the department shall remove such property from the sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.actor_raw: the department of finance and the department of environmental protection
obligations.action_summary: To the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who has registered contact information and received the 90-day lien sale notice, within a reasonably proximate time period, to inform them of the intention to sell a tax lien and provide relevant information.
obligations.quote: The department of finance and the department of environmental protection shall, to the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who (i) has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address with such departments and (ii) has received the ninety-day notice described in paragraph one of this subdivision Any such contact shall be made within a time period reasonably proximate to the mailing of such notice, shall inform such person of the intention to sell a tax lien
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: To the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who has registered contact information and received the 90-day lien sale notice, within a reasonably proximate time period, to inform them of the intention to sell a tax lien and provide relevant information.
obligations.quote: The department of finance and the department of environmental protection shall, to the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who (i) has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address with such departments and (ii) has received the ninety-day notice described in paragraph one of this subdivision Any such contact shall be made within a time period reasonably proximate to the mailing of such notice, shall inform such person of the intention to sell a tax lien
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Contact by electronic mail any person registered to receive information about outreach sessions relating to tax lien sales, providing such information within a reasonably proximate time period to the scheduled outreach session.
obligations.quote: The department of finance shall contact by electronic mail any person who has registered pursuant to subdivision a of section 11-245.8 of this title to receive information about the outreach sessions described in subdivision j of this section and provide such information within a time period reasonably proximate to the scheduled outreach session.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Conduct mandatory outreach sessions in the ten council districts with the greatest number of properties subject to 90-day lien sale notices, and additional outreach sessions in the five council districts with the greatest such numbers, covering actions property owners can take, installment agreement options, tax credits and exemptions, and other specified topics.
obligations.quote: the commissioner of finance shall conduct such outreach sessions in the ten council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to paragraph one of subdivision b of this section, and provided, further, however, that, such commissioner shall conduct additional outreach sessions in the five council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to such paragraph.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Schedule outreach sessions in the five council districts with the greatest number of lien-sale properties such that one occurs prior to the 30-day notice mailing and one occurs subsequent to such mailing.
obligations.quote: To the extent practicable, the commissioner of finance shall schedule the outreach sessions in the five council districts described in the preceding sentence such that one occurs prior to the mailing of the notice of intention to sell a tax lien that is required to be mailed thirty days prior to the date of sale pursuant to paragraph one of subdivision b of this section and one occurs subsequent to such mailing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Make a good faith effort to have a financial counselor available at outreach sessions relating to tax lien sales.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall make a good faith effort to have a financial counselor available at such outreach sessions.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: No later than 90 days after the tax lien sale, submit a report to the council detailing the number of outreach sessions by council district, installment agreements begun, tax exemption applications, total attendees, financial counselor availability, property owners consulting counselors, and survey results, disaggregated by council district.
obligations.quote: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district during the ninety-day period preceding the tax lien sale. Such report shall include: (i) the number of installment agreements begun by property owners or, as defined in subdivision b of section 11-322 of this chapter, other eligible persons, acting on behalf of property owners at each outreach session; (ii) the number of property tax exemption applications begun at each outreach session; (iii) the total number of attendees at each outreach session; (iv) the number of outreach sessions at which a financial counselor was available; (v) the number of property owners, or other eligible persons acting on behalf of property owners, who consulted a financial counselor at each outreach session at which a financial counselor was available; and (vi) the results of such surveys. Such report and the results of each outreach session shall be disaggregated by council district.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing a process for applicants to seek an exception from the requirement to provide income information from all additional property owners in cases of hardship for hardship installment agreements.
obligations.quote: The department shall promulgate rules that establish a process for an applicant to seek an exception from the requirement that income information from all additional property owners be provided in cases of hardship.
affected_groups: property owners seeking hardship installment agreements
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Establish a temporary task force to review and evaluate the provisions governing tax liens and the city's collection of delinquent real property taxes, assessments, and related charges to ensure fairness, efficiency, and effectiveness.
obligations.quote: The mayor and council shall establish a temporary task force to review and evaluate the provisions of this chapter, any actions taken pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, and such other matters as the task force deems appropriate, to ensure that the [tax lien sale process] city's collection of delinquent real property taxes, assessments, sewer rents, sewer surcharges, water rents, or any other charges that are made a lien subject to the provisions of this chapter is fair, efficient and effective.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Study the feasibility of transferring property with delinquent municipal charges or tax liens to community land trusts, land banks, mutual housing associations, or other 501(c)(3)-exempt entities as a tool for debt collection and housing preservation.
obligations.quote: the feasibility of transferring property that has delinquent real property taxes, assessments, sewer rents, sewer surcharges, water rents, or any other charges that are made a lien subject to the provisions of chapter 3 of title 11 of the administrative code of the city of new york, provided that any such liens are eligible to be sold pursuant to section 11-319 of such code, or of transferring tax liens, provided that such liens are eligible to be sold pursuant to section 11-319, to community land trusts, land banks, mutual housing associations or other entities exempt from taxation pursuant to section 501(c)(3) of the internal revenue code as a tool for the city to collect delinquent municipal charges and as a housing and community preservation tool
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Study the extent to which liens for vacant property are included in the lien sale and evaluate alternatives, including potential advantages and disadvantages of each alternative.
obligations.quote: the extent to which liens for vacant property are included in the lien sale and alternatives to such inclusion, and the potential advantages and disadvantages for each such alternative.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Hold initial meeting no later than May 1, 2021, and thereafter meet at least monthly to conduct review and study of the tax lien process and city debt collection, considering actions and recommendations to minimize nonpayment and maximize collection.
obligations.quote: No later than [September first, two thousand fifteen] May first, two thousand twenty-one, the task force shall hold its initial meeting and thereafter shall meet at least [quarterly to review and evaluate the provisions of this chapter, any actions taken pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, and such other matters as the task force deems appropriate, to ensure that the tax lien sale process is fair, efficient and effective] once per month to conduct the review and the study required by subdivisions a and a-1 of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [September first, two thousand fifteen] May first, two thousand twenty-one
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: No later than November 1, 2021, submit recommendations to the mayor and speaker of the council for administrative and legislative changes to improve fairness, efficiency, and effectiveness of city debt collection, including recommendations on transferring delinquent property to nonprofits, treatment of vacant land, and centralization of installment agreement administration.
obligations.quote: No later than [September first, two thousand sixteen] November first, two thousand twenty-one, the task force shall submit [a report] to the mayor and the speaker of the council[. Such report shall include, but need not be limited to: (i)] recommendations for administrative or legislative changes that may improve the fairness, efficiency and effectiveness of the [tax lien sale process; (ii) any findings or facts that support such recommendations, (iii) evaluation of installment agreements and consideration of prospective changes to the terms of installment agreements; (iv) the impact of the tax lien sale process on affordable housing; and (v)] city's collection of delinquent real property taxes, assessments, sewer rents, sewer surcharges, water rents, or any other charges that are made a lien subject to the provisions of this chapter
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [September first, two thousand sixteen] November first, two thousand twenty-one
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York in relation to the sale of tax liens

obligations.action_summary: Hold a public meeting no later than 30 days before submitting recommendations to present preliminary recommendations and receive public comments; make preliminary recommendations publicly available at least 10 business days prior to such meeting.
obligations.quote: No later than thirty days prior to the submission of recommendations pursuant to subdivision d of this section, the task force shall hold a public meeting to present its preliminary recommendations and receive comments relating to such preliminary recommendations. The task force's preliminary recommendations shall be made publicly available at least ten business days prior to such public meeting.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than thirty days prior to the submission of recommendations

obligations.action_summary: Determine the percentage difference in consumer price index and adjust maximum contribution limits accordingly, publishing the adjusted amounts in the City Record.
obligations.quote: the campaign finance board shall (i) determine the percentage difference between the average over a calendar year of the consumer price index for the metropolitan New York-New Jersey region published by the United States bureau of labor statistics for the twelve months preceding the beginning of such calendar year and the average over the calendar year two thousand nineteen of such consumer price index; (ii) adjust each maximum contribution applicable pursuant to paragraph (f) of subdivision one of this section by the amount of such percentage difference to the nearest fifty dollars; and (iii) publish such adjusted maximum contribution in the City Record.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than the first day of March in the year two thousand twenty-two and every fourth year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.action_summary: Review each timely disclosure report submitted by candidates prior to the filing deadline and issue a written review within 30 days, informing candidates of compliance questions and public funding eligibility concerns.
obligations.quote: The board shall review each disclosure report timely submitted by a candidate prior to the last date upon which such candidate may file a certification pursuant to paragraph (c) of subdivision one of this section, or subdivision one of section 3-717, and issue to the candidate a review within 30 days of the date upon which such disclosure report was due
obligations.deadline_text: within 30 days of the date upon which such disclosure report was due
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.action_summary: Check each contribution against the doing business database and notify the principal or authorized committee within prescribed timeframes if a contribution exceeds doing business contribution limitations or is not matchable.
obligations.quote: The board shall check each contribution against the doing business database and shall notify the principal committee within twenty days of the reporting of such contribution if a contribution exceeding the doing business contribution limitation set forth in subdivision 1-a of section 3-703 is subject to such limitations of this subchapter or if a contribution is not matchable pursuant to such subdivision. Notwithstanding any provision in this subdivision, in the six weeks preceding the covered election the board shall provide such notification to the principal or authorized committee within four business days of the reporting of such contribution to the board
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.action_summary: Make public funds payments to participating candidates within four business days after receipt of matchable contribution reports, withhold up to five percent pending final pre-election payment, and schedule payment dates on December 15, January 15, February 15, March 15, April 15, July 15, and minimum three to four additional dates before primary and general elections.
obligations.quote: the campaign finance board shall make possible payment within four business days after receipt of reports of matchable contributions, or as soon thereafter as is practicable; provided, however, that the board shall withhold up to five percent of all public funds payments to participating candidates until the final pre-election payment for any given election. The board shall schedule payment dates on December 15 of the year preceding the year of election, as well as January 15, February 15, March 15, April 15 and a minimum of three payment dates within the forty-five days prior to a covered primary election, a payment date of July 15 and a minimum of four payment dates within the ninety days prior to a covered general election, and a minimum of three payment dates within the thirty days prior to any other covered election.
obligations.deadline_text: within four business days after receipt of reports of matchable contributions, or as soon thereafter as is practicable
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.action_summary: Require filing of reports of contributions and expenditures in accordance with the schedule specified by the state board of elections for campaign receipt and expenditure statements.
obligations.quote: The board shall require the filing of reports of contributions and expenditures for purposes of determining compliance with paragraph (f) of subdivision one of section 3-703, section 3-706, subdivision 1-a of section 3-703, section 3-717, and section 3-718, in accordance with the schedule specified by the state board of elections for the filing of campaign receipt and expenditure statements.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.action_summary: Inform participating candidates who cease actively campaigning that they have ceased such activity and determine that expenditures after such cessation are not qualified expenditures.
obligations.quote: the board shall inform such participating candidate of the board's determination that such candidate has ceased actively campaigning for a covered office. Expenditures incurred prior to the date by which such candidate has ceased actively campaigning for a covered office may be considered qualified expenditures, but no expenditures incurred after the date of such a determination of the board shall be considered qualified expenditures.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a full public match campaign finance system

obligations.quote: Establish a uniform format to be utilized by all city agencies in the preparation of the quarterly reports required by subdivision i of section eight hundred fifteen. Such format shall provide for the presentation of statistical information regarding total employment, including provisional, seasonal, per-diem and part-time employees, new hiring and promotions in a manner that facilitates understanding of an agency's efforts to provide fair and effective equal opportunity employment for minority group members, women and members of other groups who are employed by, or who seek employment with, city agencies

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner, acting through the office
obligations.action_summary: Evaluate each city agency for compliance with diversity and inclusion procedures and standards, and compile evaluations in an annual report to the mayor, city council, equal employment practices commission, and city civil service commission.
obligations.quote: Ensure accountability by evaluating each city agency in accordance with the procedures and standards set by the office pursuant to paragraph 1 of this subdivision. The office shall ensure that each evaluation shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (i) a determination for each city agency of whether such agency is compliant with such procedures and standards; (ii) an analysis of whether and how such procedures and standards should be expanded or modified for the next annual reporting period, with a view towards improving upon prior benchmarks; and (iii) any other information the office deems relevant. The evaluations shall be compiled and included in the annual report to the mayor, the city council, the equal employment practices commission and the city civil service commission pursuant to paragraph 8 of this subdivision. Such report shall be made publicly available on the city's website.

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner, acting through the office
obligations.action_summary: Publish and submit an annual report by September 30 to the mayor, council, and the commission on equal employment practices regarding activities to provide fair and effective affirmative employment practices, including analysis of workforce data, agency practices, and recommendations.
obligations.quote: No later than September 30, 2020, and no later than September 30 annually thereafter, publish and submit to the mayor, council and the commission on equal employment practices a report on the activities of the department of citywide administrative services and city agencies to provide fair and effective affirmative employment practices to ensure equal employment opportunity for minority group members and women who are employed by, or who seek employment with, city agencies. Such report shall include, but not be limited to, an analysis of the city government workforce and applicants for such employment by agency, title and classification except where a civil service exam was the basis of appointment; statistics relating to hiring, salary and promotion for all city agencies disaggregated by race, gender, and civil service classification and other categories as appropriate; a description of each agency's employment practices, policies and programs; an analysis of the effectiveness of the city's efforts to provide fair and effective affirmative employment practices to ensure equal employment opportunity for minority group members and women who are employed by, or who seek employment with, city agencies; and such legislative, programmatic and budgetary recommendations for the development, implementation or improvement of such activities as the commissioner deems appropriate.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting education and outreach regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements

obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach to the public regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements through educational materials in designated citywide languages, available on the commission's website, informing transgender and gender non-conforming individuals of building owner compliance obligations and violations.
obligations.quote: The commission on human rights, in conjunction with the department of buildings, shall conduct outreach to the public at large regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements, which shall, at a minimum, include educational materials to inform transgender and gender non-conforming individuals of a building owner's required compliance with sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code and the violations and penalties that result from non-compliance with such sections. Such materials shall be available in the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101 and shall include a statement that any non-compliance with such sections may be reported to 311 and shall be posted on the commission's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting education and outreach regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements

obligations.action_summary: Conduct education and outreach to increase awareness of single-occupant toilet room requirements among business owners, including educational materials and sample signage in designated citywide languages, and make information available on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department, in conjunction with (i) the mayor's office of immigrant affairs, (ii) the commission on human rights, (iii) the department of consumer affairs, (iv) the department of health and mental hygiene, (v) the department of small business services, (vi) the department of citywide administrative services and (vii) any other office or agency designated by the mayor, shall conduct education and outreach to increase awareness of sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code, regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements. Such education and outreach shall be tailored to business owners, and shall, at a minimum, include educational materials concerning such single-occupant toilet room requirements and the related posting and signage requirements, including samples of acceptable signage. Such materials and sample signage shall be available in the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101. Information concerning such requirements shall also be made available on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting education and outreach regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, an annual report on education and outreach conducted, complaints received, violations issued, penalties imposed, and subsequent inspections.
obligations.quote: By no later than April 1, 2019, and annually thereafter until April 1, 2023, the commissioner of buildings shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, a report on: 1. The education and outreach conducted as required by section 28-103.32 including a description of how such outreach was conducted and the number of business owners reached through the outreach; 2. The number of complaints related to sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code reported to 311, disaggregated by online complaints and phone complaints; 3. The number of violations issued as a result of such complaints; 4. The total amount of penalties imposed as a result of such violations for the immediately preceding year; and 5. Whether subsequent inspections were conducted by the department to ensure future compliance with such sections of the New York city plumbing code.
obligations.deadline_text: By no later than April 1, 2019, and annually thereafter until April 1, 2023
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conducting education and outreach regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the regulation of retail dealers of tobacco products and of electronic cigarettes, the establishment of price floors and minimum package sizes for tobacco products and shisha, and the establishment of a tax on tobacco products other than cigarettes

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules to carry out provisions of stormwater construction and post-construction control subchapter, including rules regarding SWPPP content, design standards, exemptions, development thresholds, procedures and fees, training requirements, recordkeeping, compliance certifications, and maintenance standards.
obligations.quote: The department shall promulgate rules to carry out the provisions of this subchapter in accordance with the NYC MS4 permit and the NYSDEC construction general permit, including but not limited to rules that: a. Set forth the content of SWPPPs, consistent with the NYSDEC construction general permit, including identifying those development projects requiring only erosion and sediment controls during construction and those development projects requiring erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities. b. Establish design standards for erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities which shall not be less stringent than the standards set forth or incorporated by reference in the NYSDEC construction general permit. c. Establish exemptions from permit requirements, consistent with the NYC MS4 permit and the NYSDEC construction general permit. d. After completion of the lot size soil disturbance study required by the NYC MS4 permit, provide for the regulation of development activity of less than one acre, based either on total disturbance of soil or on amount of impervious surface created or replaced, where an appropriate reduction in the threshold is necessary in accordance with the NYC MS4 permit. e. Establish procedures and fees for the review of SWPPPs and the issuance and renewal of permits required by this subchapter. f. Establish training, experience and/or education requirements for qualified professionals and qualified inspectors, which shall not be less stringent than those required by the NYSDEC construction general permit. g. Establish record keeping, inspection and reporting requirements for applicants and permittees to monitor compliance with this subchapter and approved SWPPPs. h. Establish requirements for compliance certifications by contractors to be included with SWPPPs. i. Establish standards for the maintenance, inspection, repair and replacement of required erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities.
obligations.deadline_text: to be determined by the department as practicable within 45 days after NYSDEC SWMP approval and no later than 6 months after such approval

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to authorizing a cure period for certain item pricing violations

obligations.action_summary: At the request of a council member, conduct outreach sessions in the council member's district addressing actions property owners can take if a lien is sold, types of tax liens subject to sale, installment agreement information, credits and exemptions, and customer surveys; make a good faith effort to have a financial counselor available; and submit a report to the council no later than ninety days after the tax lien sale.
obligations.quote: At the request of a council member, the commissioner of finance, in consultation with the commissioner of housing preservation and development and the commissioner of environmental protection, may conduct outreach sessions in the district of such council member. The scope of such outreach sessions shall include, but need not be limited to, (i) actions property owners can take if a lien is sold on such property; (ii) the type of tax lien or tax liens that can be sold in a tax lien sale; (iii) installment agreement information, including informing attendees in such outreach sessions of their option to enter into an installment agreement for exclusion from the tax lien sale with no down payment, and their option to enter such agreement for a term not more than ten years; (iv) credits and property tax exemptions that may exclude a property from a tax lien sale; (v) distribution of a customer survey to property owners who have received notice of the intention to sell a tax lien on their property, in order to determine the circumstances that led to the creation of the lien; and [(v)] (vi) any other credit or residential real property tax exemption information, which, in the discretion of the commissioner, should be included in such outreach sessions.

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council no later than ninety days after the tax lien sale a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district, including specified metrics disaggregated by council district.
obligations.quote: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district during the ninety-day period preceding the tax lien sale. Such report shall include: (i) the number of installment agreements begun by property owners or, as defined in subdivision b of section 11-322 of this chapter, other eligible persons, acting on behalf of property owners at each outreach session; (ii) the number of property tax exemption applications begun at each outreach session; [and] (iii) the total number of attendees at each outreach session; (iv) the number of outreach sessions at which a financial counselor was available; (v) the number of property owners, or other eligible persons acting on behalf of property owners, who consulted a financial counselor at each outreach session at which a financial counselor was available; and (vi) the results of such surveys.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens and notice to property owners when property tax bills are available online

obligations.action_summary: Post online the information reported to the council pursuant to subdivisions h and i of section 11-320, without specifically identifying any property or property owner except by zip code and randomly generated identifier.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall post online the information reported to the council pursuant to subdivisions h and i of this section, provided that no information shall be posted online that specifically identifies any property or property owner, except by zip code and a randomly generated identifier.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens and notice to property owners when property tax bills are available online

obligations.action_summary: Mail a letter to a property owner or other eligible person after the first missed payment on an installment agreement, stating that the owner or eligible person is at risk of being in default, if payment has not been received within two weeks of the due date.
obligations.quote: If a property owner, or other eligible person acting on behalf of an owner, who has entered into an installment agreement with the department of finance, fails to make a payment pursuant to such agreement, then the department of finance shall, after the first missed payment, mail a letter to the property owner, or other eligible person acting on behalf of an owner, stating that such owner, or other eligible person, is at risk of being in default of such agreement. The letter shall be mailed after the first missed payment if the department has not received payment within two weeks of the due date.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens and notice to property owners when property tax bills are available online

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the council concerning the sale or sales of tax liens during the preceding year, including specified information about properties, proceeds, purchasers, servicers, redemption rates, and delinquency rates.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall submit an annual report to the council concerning the sale or sales of tax liens during the preceding year pursuant to this chapter. Such report shall include the following information regarding such sale or sales: a list of properties for which a tax lien or tax liens has or have been sold, including identification of the particular tax lien or tax liens sold; the proceeds received from the sale or sales of tax liens; identification of the purchaser of and servicer for the tax lien or tax liens sold; a report of servicer activities during the immediately preceding year; the redemption rate for tax liens that have been sold; the delinquency rate for real property taxes for the immediately preceding year; and any other information pertinent to the sale of tax liens that may be requested by the council and which is not made confidential pursuant to section 11-208.1 of the code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens and notice to property owners when property tax bills are available online

obligations.quote: In addition to such report, no later than August thirty-first, two thousand twenty, the commissioner shall provide to the council a report listing all properties on which liens have been sold during the period from January first, two thousand fifteen through December thirty-first, two thousand nineteen. obligations.deadline_text: no later than August thirty-first, two thousand twenty

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the timing of statement reviews

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the timing of statement reviews

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inquiring if a person or entity is doing business with the city

obligations.quote: The board shall give written notice and the opportunity to appear before the board to any participating, limited participating or non-participating candidate, his or her principal committee, authorized committee, committee treasurer or any other agent of such candidate, if the board has reason to believe that such has committed a violation or infraction before assessing any penalty for such action.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the adjudication of campaign finance violations

obligations.action_summary: Issue written notice of alleged violations in a timely manner pursuant to subdivision one of section 3-710 and preceding the issuance of the final audit.
obligations.quote: Any such written notice of alleged violations shall be issued in a timely manner pursuant to all of the requirements of subdivision one of section 3-710 and shall precede the issuance of the final audit required pursuant to subdivision one of section 3-710.

obligations.quote: the conflicts of interest board from every individual making a donation with a reasonable value in excess of $400 in a single calendar year to determine whether such individual is a person with business dealings with the city.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conflicts of interest and organizations affiliated with elected officials

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules determining the manner and form for annual reporting by organizations affiliated with an elected official and the accounting of expenditures on elected official communications.
obligations.quote: All organizations affiliated with an elected official shall report to the conflicts of interest board annually by August 1, in a manner determined by the conflicts of interest board by rule.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conflicts of interest and organizations affiliated with elected officials

obligations.action_summary: Maintain and regularly update a list on its website of all organizations that reported to the board and all donor information disclosed, with certain exceptions for donor privacy and safety.
obligations.quote: The conflicts of interest board shall maintain and regularly update a list on its website of all organizations that reported, and all donor information disclosed, to such board pursuant to this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conflicts of interest and organizations affiliated with elected officials

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate such rules as are necessary to ensure the implementation of Chapter 9.

obligations.deadline_text: provided that the conflicts of interest board shall promulgate rules prior to such dates as are necessary for the timely implementation of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conflicts of interest and organizations affiliated with elected officials

obligations.action_summary: Provide every inmate appearing for trial or before a grand jury with access to personal clothing prior transport, or provide new or gently used size-appropriate civilian clothing if personal clothing is unavailable or the inmate declines to wear it, unless the inmate chooses to wear the department uniform or is required to do so by court order.
obligations.quote: the department shall provide every inmate appearing for a trial or before a grand jury with access to clothing in their personal property prior to transport for such appearance, and produce all such inmates for such appearances in such clothing. If such clothing is not available, or if an inmate chooses not to wear their personal clothing, the department shall provide such inmate with new or gently used, size appropriate clothing of a kind customarily worn by persons not in the custody of the department
affected_groups: inmates appearing for trial or grand jury proceedings
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating the use of uniforms by the department of correction for court appearances
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Permit personal clothing to be delivered to an inmate during package delivery periods allowed under the rules of the city of New York or during reasonable hours the day before the inmate's scheduled trial or grand jury appearance.
obligations.quote: The department shall permit personal clothing to be delivered to an inmate during such time as packages are permitted to be delivered under title 40 of the rules of the city of New York or during reasonable hours the day before an inmate's scheduled appearance for a trial or before a grand jury.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating the use of uniforms by the department of correction for court appearances

obligations.action_summary: Offer new or gently used, weather- and size-appropriate civilian clothing to any inmate released from custody from a court, unless the inmate is wearing personal clothing.
obligations.quote: New or gently used, weather- and size-appropriate clothing of a kind customarily worn by persons not in the custody of the department shall be offered to any inmate released from the custody of the department from a court, unless the inmate is wearing the inmate's own personal clothing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating the use of uniforms by the department of correction for court appearances
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Administer and manage all trust funds received or held by the city pursuant to court judgments, decrees, orders, and applicable state laws.
obligations.quote: The department shall administer and manage all trust funds received or held by the city pursuant to a judgment, decree or order of any court or under section eleven hundred twenty-three of the surrogate's court procedure act, section ninety-nine-m of the general municipal law, sections eighty-seven and one hundred eleven-h of the social services law, sections four hundred twenty-six and four hundred thirty-two of the real property law, section two hundred four of the lien law and section five hundred fifty-three of the county law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to authorizing the waiver of fees in the collection of cash bail

obligations.action_summary: Provide for the receipt and safekeeping of all trust fund moneys held by the city and disburse them on warrants signed by the comptroller.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to authorizing the waiver of fees in the collection of cash bail
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Waive fees to which the commissioner is entitled under General Municipal Law § 99-m after consideration of budgetary impact, the purpose of bail orders, and equitable administration of justice.
obligations.quote: The department may waive the fees to which the commissioner is entitled under section ninety-nine-m of the general municipal law after consideration of the budgetary impact on the city of such a waiver, the purpose of orders of bail and the equitable administration of justice.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to authorizing the waiver of fees in the collection of cash bail
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Determine within 48 hours of an inmate's admission whether the inmate has any pending court appearances in New York City criminal court or the criminal term of New York state supreme court, other than appearances for the cases for which the inmate was admitted or that pertain solely to payment of court surcharges.
obligations.quote: the department shall, within 48 hours of admission of an inmate to the custody of the department, determine whether an inmate has any pending court appearances

obligations.action_summary: Notify the Office of Court Administration that an inmate is in Department custody upon determination of a court appearance.
obligations.quote: notify the office of court administration that such inmate is in department custody upon determination of such court appearance, pursuant to subdivision a
affected_groups: inmates in Department of Correction custody
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to transporting inmates in the custody of the department of correction to all criminal court appearances
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Provide transportation as required by the court for every inmate for all court appearances in New York City criminal court or the criminal term of New York state supreme court.
obligations.quote: provide, as required by the court, transportation for every inmate for all such court appearances
affected_groups: inmates in Department of Correction custody
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to transporting inmates in the custody of the department of correction to all criminal court appearances
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Criminal Justice Services

obligations.action_summary: Make every effort to reach an agreement with the Office of Court Administration to gain access to a database maintained by the Office of Court Administration related to court appearances scheduled in New York City criminal court or the criminal term of New York state supreme court.
obligations.quote: The department shall make every effort to reach an agreement with the office of court administration to gain access by the department to a database maintained by the office of court administration
affected_groups: inmates in Department of Correction custody
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to transporting inmates in the custody of the department of correction to all criminal court appearances
