obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the speaker of the council and post it on the department's website containing information on computer science education, including programs offered, student enrollment data, certified STEM instructors, STEM institute information, computer science initiatives, and school bandwidth.
obligations.quote: the department shall submit to the speaker of the council and post conspicuously on the department's website a report for the preceding academic year which shall include, but not be limited to, the following
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than April 30, 2017, and annually thereafter on or before April 30
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of education to report information on computer science education in New York city schools

obligations.action_summary: Review requests for modification or removal of deed restrictions in accordance with the procedures set forth in the chapter.
obligations.quote: A request for modification or removal of a deed restriction submitted to the department shall be reviewed in accordance with the procedures set forth in this chapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Obtain mayoral approval before modifying or removing any deed restriction.
obligations.quote: The department shall not modify or remove any deed restriction without the approval of the mayor, or the mayor's designee, pursuant to section 3-119.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a preliminary review of requests for modification or removal of deed restrictions following submission of an intake package.
obligations.quote: Following the submission of an intake package pursuant to subdivision a of section 25-803, the department shall conduct a preliminary review of a request that the department modify or remove a deed restriction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Notify property owners in writing that their request for modification or removal is under review upon receipt of the intake package.
obligations.quote: Upon receipt of the intake package required pursuant to subdivision a of section 25-803, the department shall notify the property owner in writing that the request for modification or removal is under review.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Send notice of review along with the intake package to the community board, council member, and borough president at the time the property owner is notified.
obligations.quote: At the time the property owner is notified in writing that the request for modification or removal is under review pursuant to paragraph 1 of this subdivision, the department shall send notice of such review, along with the intake package for such request submitted pursuant to subdivision a of section 25-803, by mail and electronic mail to the community board for the community district in which the property is located, council member representing the council district in which the property is located, and borough president representing the borough in which the property is located.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Perform a land use analysis including history of property use, deed restriction description, land use implications, and analysis of whether modification or removal furthers the best interests of the city.
obligations.quote: The department shall perform a land use analysis, which shall include a description of the history of the use of the property, the deed restriction that is the subject of the request, the land use implications of such deed restriction, and an analysis of whether such modification or removal furthers the best interests of the city pursuant to the factors set forth in subdivision a of section 25-802.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Assist the department of citywide administrative services in land use analysis by providing information concerning zoning, land use, urban design, public transit access, land use policies and initiatives, and prior land use actions.
obligations.quote: The department of city planning shall assist the department in such analysis by providing information concerning the zoning and land use of the property and surrounding area, including urban design characteristics, public transit access, any existing and planned land use policies and initiatives, and any prior land use actions affecting the property.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Inform the property owner, community board, council member, and borough president if the department determines that the proposed modification or removal does not further the best interests of the city and take no further action.
obligations.quote: if the department determines that such modification or removal does not further the best interests of the city, the department shall take no further action on such request and shall inform the property owner, community board for the community district in which the property is located, council member representing the council district in which the property is located, and borough president representing the borough in which the property is located of such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a due diligence review to determine whether there are outstanding obligations owed to the city by the property owner or proposed property owner.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct a due diligence review to determine whether there are outstanding obligations owed to the city in connection with the properties identified in the VSTA forms, or by the current property owner or any proposed property owner, which shall include but not be limited to review of the following information related to such properties, current property owner, or any proposed property owner
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Appraise the market value of the property with and without the deed restriction based on two appraisals, at least one by an independent licensed appraiser.
obligations.quote: The department shall appraise the market value of the property with and without the deed restriction based on two appraisals, at least one of which must be performed by an independent real estate appraiser licensed in the state who is not an employee of the department.
obligations.deadline_text: within 60 days prior to the date the department submits its preliminary recommendation to the committee
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Determine the method of calculation of any consideration to be proposed for the modification or removal of a deed restriction, in consultation with relevant city agencies and the law department.
obligations.quote: The method of calculation of any consideration to be proposed in connection with the modification or removal of the deed restriction shall be determined by the department in consultation with relevant city agencies and experts, including, but not limited to, the law department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Propose a consideration amount, if any, required for modification or removal of the deed restriction based on appraisals and calculation method, including reasoning for the proposed amount.
obligations.quote: Based on the appraisals and in accordance with the calculation method determined pursuant to paragraph 3 of this subdivision, the department shall propose a consideration amount, if any, that would be required for the modification or removal of the deed restriction, and shall include the department's reasoning for proposing such consideration amount.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a written summary of reasons if the department determines that an appraisal is not required pursuant to specified exemptions.
obligations.quote: If the department determines that an appraisal is not required pursuant to paragraph 5 of this subdivision, the department shall prepare a written summary of its reasons for reaching such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Consult with other city, state, or federal agencies including the department of housing preservation and development, department of city planning, department of small business services, and any agency involved in providing services at the property.
obligations.quote: Following the preliminary review and performance of any appraisals, the department shall consult with other city, state, or federal agencies as appropriate, including, but not limited to, the department of housing preservation and development, the department of city planning, the department of small business services, and any agency involved in providing services at the property
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a summary of findings based on the land use analysis, due diligence review, agency consultation, and appraisal determinations.
obligations.quote: Following such consultation, the department shall prepare a summary of findings based on the land use analysis, due diligence review, consultation conducted pursuant to this section, and, if applicable, its determination pursuant to paragraph 4 or 6 of subdivision b of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Post online and send notice of the proposed modification or removal to the community board, council member, and borough president no later than three business days after the summary is completed and at least 60 days prior to any modification or removal.
obligations.quote: No later than three business days after such summary is completed and at least 60 days prior to any modification or removal of such deed restriction, the department shall post online and send notice of the proposed modification or removal as set forth in this paragraph. Such notice shall identify the property by its address and any commonly known name and include the summary prepared pursuant to paragraph 2 of this subdivision and shall be sent by mail and electronic mail to the community board for the community district in which the property is located, council member representing the council district in which the property is located, and borough president representing the borough in which the property is located.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than three business days after such summary is completed and at least 60 days prior to any modification or removal
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Establish a process in consultation with the law department for determining whether a proposed modification or removal is subject to the uniform land use review procedure.
obligations.quote: The department, in consultation with the law department, shall establish a process for determining whether a proposed modification or removal is subject to the uniform land use review procedure set forth in section 197-c of the charter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Prepare an application for modification or removal to be reviewed pursuant to the uniform land use review procedure if the department determines the request is subject to such procedure.
obligations.quote: If, pursuant to such process, the department determines that a proposed modification or removal is subject to the uniform land use review procedure set forth in section 197-c of the charter, the department shall prepare an application for such modification or removal to be reviewed pursuant to such procedure.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Conduct at least one public hearing on the requested modification or removal at least 45 days but no more than 120 days prior to such removal or modification.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct at least one public hearing on such requested modification or removal pursuant to the procedures set forth in this subdivision. A public hearing shall occur at least 45 days but no more than 120 days prior to such removal or modification.
obligations.deadline_text: A public hearing shall occur at least 45 days but no more than 120 days prior to such removal or modification
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Publish a public notice of any hearing online and in the city record for at least seven consecutive business days commencing at least 30 days and no more than 40 days before any hearing.
obligations.quote: The department shall publish a public notice of any hearing online and in the city record for at least seven consecutive business days commencing at least 30 days and no more than 40 days before any such hearing.
obligations.deadline_text: for at least seven consecutive business days commencing at least 30 days and no more than 40 days before any such hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Send notice of any hearing by mail and electronic mail to the community board, council member, and borough president.
obligations.quote: The department shall send notice of any hearing by mail and electronic mail to the community board for the community district in which the property is located, council member representing the council district in which the property is located, and borough president representing the borough in which the property is located.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Hold any public hearing in the community district in which the property is located.
obligations.quote: Any public hearing shall be held in the community district in which the property is located.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Post online and send to the community board, council member, and borough president a public file containing copies of calendar documents and public documents including the summary no later than 20 days before any hearing.
obligations.quote: A public file containing copies of the calendar document and other public documents, including the summary prepared pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision c of this section, shall be posted online and sent to the community board for the community district in which the property is located, council member representing the council district in which the property is located, and borough president representing the borough in which the property is located no later than 20 days before any hearing.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 20 days before any hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Prepare and post online a summary of public comments received at any hearing along with responses to such comments.
obligations.quote: The department shall prepare and post online a summary of public comments received at any such hearing, along with responses to such comments, on the request for modification or removal of the deed restriction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Submit a preliminary recommendation to approve the request to the committee established pursuant to section 3-119 if the department finds the modification or removal is appropriate and furthers the best interests of the city.
obligations.quote: If, based on the information obtained pursuant to this section, the department finds that the requested modification or removal of a deed restriction is appropriate and furthers the best interests of the city, the department shall submit a preliminary recommendation to approve the request to the committee established pursuant to section 3-119.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Issue a letter to the property owner within three business days of committee approval setting forth the recommendation, required consideration, and further actions needed to obtain the requested modification or removal.
obligations.quote: If the committee approves the department's preliminary recommendation, within three business days of such approval, the department shall issue a letter to the property owner setting forth such recommendation; any required consideration, as approved or modified by the committee; and any further actions the property owner must take to obtain the requested modification or removal of the deed restriction
obligations.deadline_text: within three business days of such approval
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Cease further action if the property owner does not respond within 30 calendar days after receipt of the letter, and treat failure to respond within 60 days as a new request.
obligations.quote: If the property owner does not respond to such letter within 30 calendar days after the receipt of such letter, the department shall cease any further action with regard to the requested modification or removal until a response is received; provided, however, if a property owner fails to respond or fails to request more time to respond within 60 days following receipt of such letter, the department shall treat such response as a new request.
obligations.deadline_text: within 30 calendar days after the receipt of such letter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor a final written recommendation for approval including the intake package, appraisals, summaries, public comments, agreements, and other relevant documents if the department determines the modification or removal is appropriate and furthers the best interests of the city.
obligations.quote: If the department determines that such modification or removal is appropriate and furthers the best interests of the city, it shall submit to the mayor a final written recommendation for approval of such request. Such written recommendation shall include the intake package submitted pursuant to subdivision a of section 25-803, any appraisals conducted pursuant to subdivision b of section 25-804, the summary prepared pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision c of section 25-804, the summary of public comments prepared pursuant to paragraph 6 of subdivision e of section 25-804, any and all agreements with the property owner pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision f of section 25-804, and any other documents or information the department deems relevant.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.actor_raw: the department of housing preservation and development
obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development

obligations.quote: The department of housing preservation and development shall not modify or remove any deed restriction without the approval of the mayor or the deputy mayor for housing and economic development or the official occupying any successor position, or his or her designee.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Update the database not less than 30 days following any change to the data, post on the city's website, and publish to the open data portal in non-proprietary format with specified information.

Such database shall be posted on the city's website, shall have the ability to produce reports by query, and shall be published to the city's open data portal in a non-proprietary format that permits automated processing
obligations.deadline_text: not less than 30 days following any change to such data
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or an agency or officer designated by the mayor

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or an agency or officer designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Ensure the database contains all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1996 no later than one year following the effective date.
obligations.quote: No later than one year following the effective date of this local law, such database shall contain all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1996.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than one year following the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or an agency or officer designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Ensure the database contains all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1986 no later than two years following the effective date.
obligations.quote: No later than two years following the effective date of this local law, such database shall contain all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1986.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or an agency or officer designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Ensure the database contains all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1976 no later than three years following the effective date.
obligations.quote: No later than three years following the effective date of this local law, such database shall contain all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1976.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than three years following the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Ensure the database contains all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1966 no later than four years following the effective date.
obligations.quote: No later than four years following the effective date of this local law, such database shall contain all real property upon which a deed restriction was imposed by the department of citywide administrative services on or after January 1, 1966.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Approve or deny requests to modify or remove deed restrictions upon receipt of the department of citywide administrative services' final written recommendation.

obligations.deadline_text: Within three business days of reaching a determination of approval or denial of such request
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.action_summary: Review the department of citywide administrative services' preliminary recommendations on deed restriction modification or removal requests, issue a written determination of approval or denial with reasons, and within three business days post the determination online and send notice to DCAS, the community board, council member, and borough president.

obligations.deadline_text: Within three business days of reaching such a determination

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to modification and removal of certain deed restrictions

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to establishing a public list of commitments made by the city in connection with city planning commission decisions subject to council review

obligations.quote: The conflicts of interest board shall maintain a record of all candidates in compliance with section 12-110 of the administrative code of the city of New York. obligations.action_summary: Develop, maintain, and update the doing business database to ensure reasonable accuracy and completeness, with updates no less frequently than once a month.
obligations.quote: Such database shall be developed, maintained and updated by the office of the mayor in a manner so as to ensure its reasonable accuracy and completeness; provided, however, that in no event shall such database be updated less frequently than once a month.
affected_groups: entities doing business with the city
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring disclosure of entities that own entities that do business with the city

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring disclosure of entities that own entities that do business with the city

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring disclosure of entities that own entities that do business with the city

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prohibiting contributions from non-registered political committees to candidates who are not participating in the city's public matching program

obligations.quote: publication of a non-partisan, impartial voter guide in at least one media format providing information on candidates, ballot proposals and referenda, and the distribution of one copy of such guide to each household in which there is at least one registered voter eligible to vote in the election involved.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.action_summary: Comply with voter requests to opt out of receiving a printed copy of the voter guide to the extent feasible.
obligations.quote: A voter may opt out of receiving a printed copy of such guide and the board shall comply with this request to the extent feasible.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.action_summary: Take necessary and appropriate actions to improve public awareness of candidates and ballot proposals or referenda in all other contested elections held in the city for any city, county, state, or federal office, including publication of a non-partisan, impartial voter guide in at least one media format.
obligations.quote: The board shall also take such actions as it deems necessary and appropriate to improve public awareness of the candidates in all other contested elections held in the city of New York for any city, county, state, or federal office or ballot proposals or referenda pursuant to city, county, state, or federal law, including but not necessarily limited to the publication of a non-partisan, impartial voter guide in at least one media format providing information on such candidates, ballot proposals or referenda.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.action_summary: Report to the director of the office of management and budget if the amount of money in its budget is insufficient or likely to be insufficient for the publication and distribution of the voter guide.
obligations.quote: if the board determines that the amount of money in its budget is insufficient or likely to be insufficient for the publication and distribution of such guide, it shall report such determination to the director of the office of management and budget
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.actor_raw: the director of the office of management and budget
obligations.agency_full: Mayor's Office of Management and Budget

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.action_summary: Make available to the public on its website information regarding any proposal or referendum to be included on the ballot in elections where there are no contested elections for mayor, public advocate, borough president, comptroller or city council and no administrative action or court determination to include a ballot proposal or referendum sixty or more days prior to the election.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.action_summary: Include in printed voter guides material explaining the date and hours of polls, voter registration information, absentee ballot procedures, voting instructions, information on political subdivisions applicable to a citizen's address, and other general voting information.
obligations.quote: material explaining the date and hours during which the polls will be open for that election; when, where, and how to register to vote; when a citizen is required to reregister; when, where, and how absentee ballots are obtained and used; instructions on how to vote; information on the political subdivisions applicable to a particular citizen's address; and any other general information on voting deemed by the board to be necessary or useful to the electorate or otherwise consistent with the goals of this charter

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to allowing for flexibility with respect to the voter guide

obligations.quote: For youth placed with foster parents, such surveys shall be administered in a location other than the foster parent's home, or administered online or through a mobile application.
obligations.deadline_text: Commencing one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section
affected_groups: youth in foster care placed with foster parents
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to foster care experience surveys

obligations.action_summary: Explain the purpose of the survey to youth and not attribute survey responses to youth without their consent.
obligations.quote: ACS shall explain the purpose of such survey to youth and shall not attribute survey responses to youth without their consent.
obligations.deadline_text: Commencing one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section
affected_groups: youth in foster care ages 13 and older
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to foster care experience surveys

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website aggregated data from the surveys and any steps ACS had taken in response to the information provided in such surveys.
obligations.quote: No later than six months following the first administration of the survey, and annually thereafter, ACS shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website aggregated data from the surveys required pursuant to this section and any steps ACS had taken in response to the information provided in such surveys.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than six months following the first administration of the survey, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to foster care experience surveys

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council a report on its plan for the implementation of the survey.
obligations.quote: Not later than 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section, ACS shall submit to the speaker of the council a report on its plan for the implementation of the survey required pursuant to this section.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to foster care experience surveys

obligations.action_summary: Furnish an annual report to the speaker of the council and public advocate, and post it on ACS' website, regarding youth in foster care, including detailed data on discharge outcomes, current youth in care, and youth discharged to APPLA.
obligations.quote: Beginning no later than February 28, 2015 for the calendar year 2014 and every year thereafter, ACS shall furnish to the speaker of the council, the public advocate, and post on ACS' website a report regarding youth in foster care.
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning no later than February 28, 2015 for the calendar year 2014 and every year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to information collected and reported about youth and foster care

obligations.action_summary: Establish a procedure in consultation with the commissioner of social services and the commissioner of homeless services to determine how many youth discharged from foster care entered shelters operated by or under contract with the department of homeless services or department of social services.
obligations.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of social services and the commissioner of homeless services, shall establish a procedure to determine how many youth who were discharged from foster care entered a shelter operated by or under contract or similar agreement with the department of homeless services or the department of social services.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to information collected and reported about youth and foster care

obligations.action_summary: Establish a procedure in consultation with the commissioner of social services to determine how many youth discharged from foster care received cash assistance, supplemental nutrition assistance benefits, and/or medicaid.
obligations.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of social services, shall establish a procedure to determine how many youth who were discharged from foster care received cash assistance, supplemental nutrition assistance benefits, and/or medicaid.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to information collected and reported about youth and foster care

obligations.action_summary: Serve as chair of the interagency foster care task force and ensure members are appointed within 60 days of enactment.
obligations.quote: the commissioner of children's services, or their designee, who shall serve as chair
obligations.deadline_text: All members shall be appointed within 60 days of the enactment of this local law.
affected_groups: youth aging out of foster care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a foster care task force

obligations.action_summary: Submit a report of findings and recommendations addressing education, housing, financial literacy, health and mental health services, parenting, decreasing youth aging out of foster care, post-permanency services, and permanent family placements.
obligations.quote: Such task force shall submit a report of its findings and recommendations to the mayor and the council no later than 14 months after the effective date of the local law that added this section.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 14 months after the effective date of the local law that added this section
affected_groups: youth aging out of foster care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a foster care task force

obligations.action_summary: Submit annual reports on the implementation of recommendations to the mayor and council no later than 12 and 24 months following submission of the initial report.
obligations.quote: Annual reports on the implementation of such recommendations shall be submitted to the mayor and the council no later than 12 and 24 months following the submission of the initial report
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 12 and 24 months following the submission of the initial report
affected_groups: youth aging out of foster care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a foster care task force

obligations.action_summary: Post each report required by Section 1(d) on the administration for children's services' website.
obligations.quote: Each report required pursuant to this section shall be posted on the administration for children's services' website.
affected_groups: youth aging out of foster care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to a foster care task force

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website a five-year plan to address barriers to permanency for youth in foster care, including a case study of a statistically significant sample of children in foster care and an analysis of how ACS plans to address systemic barriers to permanency.
obligations.quote: By December 31, 2017, ACS shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website a five-year plan to address barriers to permanency for youth in foster care.
obligations.deadline_text: By December 31, 2017
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a five-year plan to address barriers to permanency

obligations.action_summary: Review and update the five-year plan annually and submit the updated version to the speaker of the council and post online one year following submission of the initial five-year report and annually thereafter.
obligations.quote: The five-year plan shall be reviewed and updated by ACS annually and the updated version shall be submitted to the speaker of the council and posted online one year following the submission of the initial five-year report and annually on such date thereafter.
obligations.deadline_text: one year following the submission of the initial five-year report and annually on such date thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a five-year plan to address barriers to permanency

obligations.action_summary: In the fifth year covered by each five-year plan, submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website a new five-year plan to address barriers to permanency for the next succeeding five-year period, and maintain the previous five-year report on ACS' website.
obligations.quote: In the fifth year covered by each such five-year plan, ACS shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website a new five-year plan to address barriers to permanency for the next succeeding five-year period not later than six months prior to the last day of such fifth year.
obligations.deadline_text: not later than six months prior to the last day of such fifth year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a five-year plan to address barriers to permanency

obligations.action_summary: Submit annual reports to the Speaker of the Council and post on its website regarding the educational continuity of children in foster care, including data on school of origin retention, attendance rates, and related metrics.
obligations.quote: Not later than February 1, 2017, and on or before December 1 annually thereafter, ACS shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on its website annual reports regarding the educational continuity of children in foster care.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than February 1, 2017, and on or before December 1 annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a report on the educational continuity of children in foster care

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and post on ACS' website an annual report for the prior calendar year containing specified information about youth in foster care and their government-issued personal identification.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall submit to the speaker of the council and post on ACS' website an annual report for the prior calendar year that includes the following information
obligations.deadline_text: no later than every January 31 thereafter
affected_groups: foster youth aged seventeen or older
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a report on obtaining government-issued identification for youth

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Prescribe the form of complaints filed by freelance workers, which shall include at minimum the worker's name and address, hiring party's name and address, contract terms, occupation, statement of alleged violations, and signed affirmation of facts.
obligations.quote: The director shall prescribe the form of the complaint, which shall include, at a minimum: 1. The name and mailing address of the freelance worker and of the hiring party alleged to have violated this chapter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Refer freelance workers to the navigation program at the time a complaint alleging a violation of the freelance worker protections chapter is received.
obligations.quote: At the time the director receives a complaint alleging a violation of this chapter, the director shall refer the freelance worker to the navigation program identified in section 20-932.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Send written notice to freelance worker and hiring party (if applicable) within 10 days of discovering lack of jurisdiction over a complaint.
obligations.quote: Where the director lacks jurisdiction over a complaint, the director shall notify the following, in writing, within 10 days of discovering the lack of jurisdiction: (a) The freelance worker; and (b) The hiring party
obligations.deadline_text: within 10 days of discovering the lack of jurisdiction
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Send written notice of complaint to hiring party within 20 days of receiving a complaint, informing the hiring party of alleged violations, available remedies, and that failure to respond creates a rebuttable presumption in any civil action.
obligations.quote: Within 20 days of receiving a complaint alleging a violation of this chapter, the director shall send the hiring party named in the complaint a written notice of complaint. Such notice shall inform the hiring party that a complaint has been filed alleging violations of this chapter, detail the remedies available to a freelance worker for violations of this chapter by a hiring party and include a copy of the complaint
obligations.deadline_text: Within 20 days of receiving a complaint alleging a violation of this chapter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Send freelance worker a copy of the hiring party's response, enclosures, materials about court actions, complaint status, and navigation program information within 20 days of receiving the hiring party's response.
obligations.quote: Within 20 days of receiving the written response, the director shall send the freelance worker a copy of: (a) The response; (b) Any enclosures submitted to the director with the response; (c) Materials informing the freelance worker that he or she may bring an action in a court of competent jurisdiction
obligations.deadline_text: Within 20 days of receiving the written response
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Mail notice of non-response to both freelance worker and hiring party by regular mail with proof of certified mailing of the notice of complaint, and may close the case upon satisfying these requirements.
obligations.quote: If the director receives no response to the notice of complaint within the time provided by paragraph 1 of this subdivision, the director shall mail a notice of non-response to both the freelance worker and the hiring party by regular mail and shall include with such notice proof that the director previously mailed the notice of complaint to the hiring party by certified mail.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Establish a navigation program that provides information and assistance relating to freelance worker protections, including assistance by natural person via phone and email, online information, and outreach and education to the public.
obligations.quote: The director shall establish a navigation program that provides information and assistance, as set forth in subdivision c of this section, relating to the provisions of this chapter. Such program shall include assistance by a natural person by phone and e-mail and shall also include online information.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Make available model contracts on the office website at no cost in English and in the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city.
obligations.quote: The director shall make available model contracts on the website of the office for use by the general public at no cost. Such model contracts shall be made available in English and in the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city as determined by the department of city planning.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Send a survey to freelance workers no later than six months after sending a hiring party's response or non-response notice, requesting information about whether claims were pursued in court or alternative dispute resolution and whether compensation was paid.
obligations.quote: No later than six months after the director sends to a freelance worker either a hiring party's response and accompanying materials or a notice of non-response pursuant to paragraph 2 or 3 of subdivision e of section 20-931, the director shall send the freelance worker a survey requesting additional information about the resolution of the freelance worker's claims.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than six months after the director sends to a freelance worker either a hiring party's response and accompanying materials or a notice of non-response
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Collect and track information about complaints alleging violations including identity of hiring party, freelance worker's occupation, violated section, contract value, hiring party response, and survey information.
obligations.quote: The director shall collect and track information about complaints alleging violations of this chapter. The information collected shall include, at minimum: 1. The identity of the hiring party alleged to have violated this chapter; 2. The freelance worker's occupation; 3. The section of this chapter that was alleged to have been violated
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council and publish on the office website a report on the effectiveness of the freelance worker protections chapter one year after its effective date and every fifth year thereafter on November 1, including complaint statistics, contract values, responses received, survey outcomes, and legislative recommendations.
obligations.quote: One year after the effective date of the local law that added this chapter, and every fifth year thereafter on November 1, the director shall submit to the council and publish on its website a report regarding the effectiveness of this chapter at improving freelance contracting and payment practices.
obligations.deadline_text: One year after the effective date of the local law that added this chapter, and every fifth year thereafter on November 1
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.agency: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.agency_full: director of the office of labor standards
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules requiring additional contract terms to ensure freelance workers and hiring parties understand their contractual obligations.
obligations.quote: The director may by rule require additional terms to ensure that the freelance worker and the hiring party understand their obligations under the contract.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.action_summary: Commence a civil action on behalf of the city where reasonable cause exists to believe that a hiring party is engaged in a pattern or practice of violations of the freelance worker protections chapter.
obligations.quote: Where reasonable cause exists to believe that a hiring party is engaged in a pattern or practice of violations of this chapter, the corporation counsel may commence a civil action on behalf of the city in a court of competent jurisdiction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for freelance workers

obligations.action_summary: Implement and administer a program of distribution of voter registration forms and provide assistance to applicants in completing voter registration forms, including the organ donor section, if requested.
obligations.citation: NYC Charter § 1057-a, as amended by Local Law 139 of 2016
obligations.quote: Such agencies shall provide assistance to applicants in completing voter registration forms, including the section of the form allowing for registration to become an organ donor, and in cases in which such an agency would provide assistance with its own form, such agency shall provide the same degree of assistance with regard to the voter registration [form] and organ donor forms as is provided with regard to the completion of its own form, if so requested.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to requiring assistance if requested for individuals signing up to be organ donors as part of the agency-based voter registration program

obligations.action_summary: Create a medical treatment report whenever an arrestee is treated by a health care provider while in custody, including the arrestee's medical condition, name, identifying information, and provider identity.
obligations.quote: Whenever an arrestee is treated by a health care provider while in the custody of the department, the department shall create a report. Such report shall include a brief description of the arrestee's medical condition, to the extent known by the department, the arrestee's name and other identifying information regarding that arrestee, including but not limited to the arrestee's New York state identification number and date of birth, when available, and identity of the health care provider.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring arrestee health screenings and the exchange of health information of inmates in the custody of the department of correction
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Developmental Disability, Alcoholism, Substance Abuse and Disability Services

obligations.action_summary: Transmit medical treatment reports to the department of health and mental hygiene or its designee whenever an arrestee is taken into the custody of the department of correction.
obligations.quote: Such report shall be transmitted to the department of health and mental hygiene or its designee whenever an arrestee is taken into the custody of the department of correction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring arrestee health screenings and the exchange of health information of inmates in the custody of the department of correction
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Developmental Disability, Alcoholism, Substance Abuse and Disability Services

obligations.action_summary: Oversee screening of every arrestee held at the central booking area of a local criminal court prior to arraignment for medical or mental health conditions that may require immediate attention.
obligations.quote: Every arrestee held at the central booking area of a local criminal court prior to their arraignment at such court shall be screened for medical or mental health conditions that may require immediate attention. The department or its designee shall oversee such screening.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring arrestee health screenings and the exchange of health information of inmates in the custody of the department of correction
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Developmental Disability, Alcoholism, Substance Abuse and Disability Services

obligations.action_summary: Establish procedures to make available medical treatment reports received from the New York city police department to any health care provider in a department of correction facility conducting a health evaluation at the time such evaluation is conducted.
obligations.quote: The department or its designee shall establish procedures to make available reports received from the New York city police department pursuant to section 14-163 to any health care provider in a department of correction facility conducting a health evaluation, at such time as a health evaluation is conducted.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring arrestee health screenings and the exchange of health information of inmates in the custody of the department of correction
obligations.committee: Committee on Mental Health, Developmental Disability, Alcoholism, Substance Abuse and Disability Services

obligations.action_summary: Establish procedures to obtain the pre-arraignment screening record and any medical records created by hospitals in connection with treatment of an arrestee who subsequently enters the custody of the department of correction, at the request of any health care provider conducting a health evaluation.
obligations.quote: The department or its designee shall establish procedures to obtain the pre-arraignment screening record created pursuant to section 17-1802 and any medical records created and maintained by any hospital in connection with treatment provided to an arrestee who subsequently enters the custody of the department of correction, at the request of any health care provider conducting a health evaluation of such inmate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring arrestee health screenings and the exchange of health information of inmates in the custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide a form for building owners to apply for exceptions to bicycle access requirements.
obligations.quote: Such owner has received a request for a bicycle access plan, and certifies that either: 1. No freight elevator in such building is available for the use described in this article because unique circumstances exist involving substantial safety risks directly related to the use of each such elevator. Such application shall include the reasons for such assertion and supporting documentation; or 2. There is sufficient secure alternate covered no-cost off-street bicycle parking or sufficient secure alternate indoor no-cost bicycle parking available on the premises or within four blocks or 1,000 feet (304.8 m), whichever is less, of such building to accommodate all tenants or subtenants of such building requesting bicycle access and that such off-street parking is accessible on a 24-hour basis. Such application shall include supporting documentation for such assertion, including proof that such alternate off-street or indoor parking is available to or under the control of such owner, lessee, manager or other person who controls the building. If an exception is sought pursuant to item 1 of this section, the department shall conduct an inspection of the building and each freight elevator and shall thereafter issue a final determination as to whether to grant an exception. If an exception is sought pursuant to item 2 of this section, the department, in consultation with the department of transportation, shall thereafter conduct an inspection of the secure alternate no-cost covered off-street bicycle parking, or secure indoor no-cost bicycle parking and the department of transportation shall thereafter issue a final determination as to whether to grant an exception.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to bicycle access in office buildings

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Submit annual report to comptroller and city council regarding use of ultra low sulfur diesel fuel and best available retrofit technology by school buses.
obligations.quote: Not later than January 1, 2007, and not later than January 1 of each year thereafter, the commissioner shall submit a report to the comptroller and the speaker of the council regarding, among other things, the use of ultra low sulfur diesel fuel and the use of the best available retrofit technology by school buses during the immediately preceding fiscal year.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than January 1, 2007, and not later than January 1 of each year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
obligations.action_summary: Develop and implement a pilot project lasting at least one year to test benefits and reliability of auxiliary power units in ambulances.
obligations.quote: Not later than January 1, 2014, the fire department shall develop and implement a pilot project for a period of not less than one year to ascertain the benefits and reliability of utilizing auxiliary power units in ambulances operated by the city of New York.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than January 1, 2014
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
obligations.action_summary: Submit report to mayor and city council detailing findings of the auxiliary power unit pilot project including emissions reduction data and cost-benefit analysis.
obligations.quote: Not later than July 1, 2015, the fire department shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council detailing the findings of such pilot project, including but not limited to data on actual reduction in vehicular emissions, and a cost-benefit analysis for equipping the entire ambulance fleet with auxiliary power units.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than July 1, 2015
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Review technology verified by EPA and California Air Resources Board and promulgate rules setting forth best available retrofit technology for heavy duty trade waste hauling vehicles.
obligations.quote: On or before June 30, 2018, the commissioner shall review the technology verified by the United States environmental protection agency and the California air resources board for reducing the emission of pollutants that achieves reductions in particulate matter emissions at the highest classification level for diesel emission control strategies that is applicable to a particular engine and application and shall promulgate rules setting forth the best available retrofit technology to be used by heavy duty trade waste hauling vehicles to which this section applies.
obligations.deadline_text: On or before June 30, 2018
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing procedures for safeguarding public health and safety and procedures for persons working at asbestos projects.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall promulgate rules establishing procedures for the safeguarding of the health and safety of the public and all, including procedures to be followed by persons who work at or in the vicinity of an asbestos project.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Authorize use of renewable fuels in heating systems if such fuel meets applicable ASTM standards and emissions are equal to or less than fuel oil grade no. 2.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may authorize the use of any renewable fuel in heating systems if he or she determines that such fuel meets an applicable ASTM International standard or other standard as determined by the commissioner, and the emissions from such fuel contain equal or lesser amounts of particulate matter, sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides than the emissions from fuel oil grade no. 2.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Ensure all no. 2, no. 4 and no. 6 heating oil purchased for city buildings contains not less than five percent biodiesel (B5) by volume, except for emergency generators.
obligations.quote: After October 1, 2014, all no. 2, no. 4 and no. 6 heating oil purchased for use in any building owned by the city shall be bioheating fuel containing not less than five percent biodiesel (B5) by volume except that the provisions of this subdivision shall not apply to the use of emergency generators.
obligations.deadline_text: After October 1, 2014
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Institute a pilot program requiring not less than five percent of city-owned buildings to use heating oil containing at least ten percent biodiesel (B10) by volume beginning October 1, 2014 through October 1, 2015.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of citywide administrative services shall institute a pilot program to use greater amounts of biodiesel in city-owned buildings. Such pilot program shall require that beginning October 1, 2014, the heating oil burned in not less than five percent of city-owned buildings shall contain at least ten percent biodiesel (B10) by volume.
obligations.deadline_text: beginning October 1, 2014
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Issue report to mayor and city council detailing findings of the B10 biodiesel pilot program including recommendations on use of ten percent biodiesel in all city buildings.
obligations.quote: within six months of the conclusion of such pilot program, the commissioner of citywide administrative services shall issue a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council detailing the findings of such pilot program, including the utility of and any impediments to the use of ten percent biodiesel (B10) by volume in city-owned buildings and any recommendations for the use of ten percent biodiesel (B10) by volume in all city-owned buildings.
obligations.deadline_text: within six months of the conclusion of such pilot program
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.actor_raw: the commissioner of citywide administrative services
obligations.action_summary: Undertake a one-year study on the feasibility of using five percent biodiesel (B5) in all buildings throughout the city and issue recommendations to the mayor and city council.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of citywide administrative services in conjunction with the office of long-term planning and sustainability shall undertake a one year study on the feasibility of the use of five percent biodiesel (B5) by volume in all buildings throughout the city. Such study shall include recommendations on whether and when the city should require the use of five percent biodiesel (B5) by volume in heating oil in all buildings and shall be issued to the mayor and the speaker of the council
obligations.deadline_text: by April 2, 2015
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Submit annual report to mayor and city council regarding waivers issued for bioheating fuel requirements and renewable biomass determinations.
obligations.quote: No later than September 1, 2013, and no later than September 1 of every year thereafter, the commissioner shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council, which shall include: (i) all waivers, findings and renewals of such findings issued pursuant to this section during the immediately preceding calendar year
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 1, 2013, and no later than September 1 of every year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Require persons who supply heating oil to buildings to annually disclose to the department information regarding fuel oil supplied by grade, location, biodiesel percentage and feedstock types.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall require persons who supply heating oil directly to buildings in the city to disclose annually to the commissioner the following information regarding fuel oil supplied: (i) the amount in gallons of each fuel oil grade supplied by such person to buildings by zip code; and (ii) the average percentage of biodiesel blended into each fuel oil grade supplied by such person within the city and the types of feedstock used in the creation of such biodiesel.
obligations.deadline_text: annually
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Submit annual report to mayor and city council on compliance with school bus age and retrofit requirements including data on age and crankcase ventilation retrofit status of every school bus.
obligations.quote: No later than December 31, 2011, and no later than December 31 of every year thereafter, the department of education shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council on compliance with this section. Such report shall include, but not be limited to, data on the age and crankcase ventilation retrofit status of every school bus pursuant to a school bus contract.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2011, and no later than December 31 of every year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.deadline_text: yearly
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, the administrative code of the city of New York, the New York city building code, and the New York city mechanical code, in relation to the New York city air pollution control code.

obligations.action_summary: Organize and conduct no fewer than five investigations of discrimination in employment using matched pairs of testers to investigate local employers, labor organizations, employment agencies, and their employees or agents.
obligations.quote: the commission on human rights shall organize and conduct no fewer than five investigations of discrimination in employment during which the commission shall use pairs of testers to investigate local employers, labor organizations or employment agencies
obligations.deadline_text: The first of the investigations shall commence on or before October 1, 2015.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing an employment discrimination testing program.

obligations.action_summary: Submit a report to the speaker of the council detailing employment discrimination investigations conducted during the prior 12-month period, including number of matched pair tests, industry identification, protected class variables, discrimination incidents by protected class, and descriptions of detected discrimination.
obligations.quote: the commission shall submit to the speaker of the council a report related to employment investigations conducted during the prior 12 month period commencing on October 1, 2015. Such report shall include, but not be limited to: (i) the number of matched pair tests completed; (ii) identification of the industry of the employer where each completed matched pair test was conducted; (iii) the protected class variable used in each matched pair test; (iv) the number of incidents of actual or perceived discrimination by protected class for each such investigation; and (v) a description of any incidents of discrimination detected
obligations.deadline_text: On or before March 1, 2017
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to establishing an employment discrimination testing program.

obligations.action_summary: Refer any incidents of actual or perceived discrimination detected during employment discrimination testing investigations to the commission's law enforcement bureau.
