obligations.action_summary: Establish the terms and conditions of a sale of a tax lien or tax liens.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of finance shall establish the terms and conditions of a sale of a tax lien or tax liens.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Provide Chinese, Korean, Russian or Spanish translations of tax lien sale notice upon written request of property owners.
obligations.quote: Upon the written request of the owner of such property, a Chinese, Korean, Russian or Spanish translation of such notice shall be provided to such owner.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Submit a quarterly property status report to the council containing information about tax liens sold and their status.
obligations.quote: On a quarterly basis, a purchaser of tax liens shall provide to the council a property status report.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Conduct outreach sessions in council districts at the request of council members, covering actions property owners can take regarding tax liens, installment agreements, and property tax exemptions.
obligations.quote: At the request of a council member, the commissioner of finance, in consultation with the commissioner of housing preservation and development and the commissioner of environmental protection, may conduct outreach sessions in the district of such council member.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district and related data within 90 days after each tax lien sale.
obligations.quote: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district during the ninety-day period preceding the tax lien sale.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules defining extenuating circumstances for purposes of installment agreement default cure provisions.
obligations.quote: Such statement shall also include a notification that if such default is not cured prior to the date of sale, such property owner shall not be eligible to enter into an installment agreement for the subject property for five years, unless there is a finding of extenuating circumstances in accordance with rules promulgated by the department that entered into the installment agreement with the property owner.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Establish a temporary task force to review and evaluate the tax lien sale process and related matters.
obligations.quote: The mayor and council shall establish a temporary task force to review and evaluate the provisions of this chapter, any actions taken pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, and such other matters as the task force deems appropriate
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.agency: Temporary task force to review the tax lien sale process
obligations.agency_full: Temporary task force to review the tax lien sale process
obligations.action_summary: Hold an initial meeting and thereafter meet at least quarterly to review and evaluate tax lien sale provisions and related matters.
obligations.quote: No later than September first, two thousand fifteen, the task force shall hold its initial meeting and thereafter shall meet at least quarterly to review and evaluate the provisions of this chapter
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September first, two thousand fifteen
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.agency: Temporary task force to review the tax lien sale process
obligations.agency_full: Temporary task force to review the tax lien sale process
obligations.action_summary: Submit a report to the mayor and speaker of the council containing recommendations for administrative or legislative changes, findings, evaluation of installment agreements, impact on affordable housing, and other relevant information.
obligations.quote: No later than September first, two thousand sixteen, the task force shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September first, two thousand sixteen
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the sale of tax liens.

obligations.action_summary: Notify parents of current students and current employees of any public school that has been the subject of a reportable environmental inspection or environmental report.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the parents of current students and the current employees of any public school that has been the subject of a reportable environmental inspection or environmental report.
obligations.deadline_text: within ten days of receipt of the results that trigger such notification requirement; provided that if such results are received during a scheduled school vacation period exceeding five days, such notification shall occur no later than ten days following the end of such period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of New York, in relation to requiring the reporting of environmental data regarding schools

obligations.action_summary: Make reasonable efforts to notify parents of former students and former employees of any school for which notification is required.
obligations.quote: The department shall also make reasonable efforts to notify the parents of former students and former employees of any school for which notification is required pursuant to this subdivision.
obligations.deadline_text: within ten days of receipt of the results that trigger such notification requirement; provided that if such results are received during a scheduled school vacation period exceeding five days, such notification shall occur no later than ten days following the end of such period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of New York, in relation to requiring the reporting of environmental data regarding schools

obligations.action_summary: Notify directors of all afterschool programs under the department's jurisdiction that utilize school buildings or property for which notification is required.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the directors of all afterschool programs under the jurisdiction of the department, including but not limited to, any athletic programs, known to utilize any school building or other school property for which notification is required pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: within ten days of receipt of the results that trigger such notification requirement; provided that if such results are received during a scheduled school vacation period exceeding five days, such notification shall occur no later than ten days following the end of such period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of New York, in relation to requiring the reporting of environmental data regarding schools

obligations.action_summary: Notify all local elected officials, community education councils, and local community boards representing the district of any school for which notification is required.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify all local elected officials, community education councils and local community boards representing the district of any school for which notification is required pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: within ten days of receipt of the results that trigger such notification requirement; provided that if such results are received during a scheduled school vacation period exceeding five days, such notification shall occur no later than ten days following the end of such period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of New York, in relation to requiring the reporting of environmental data regarding schools

obligations.action_summary: Post a conspicuous link to any environmental report or reportable environmental inspection on the department's website, searchable by school, community school district, council district, and borough.

Such reports or reportable inspections shall be searchable by school, community school district, council district and borough.

obligations.actor_raw: the director of the office for the aging
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate and maintain rules and regulations establishing program standards and participant rights for social adult day care.
obligations.citation: Section 1 and § 21-204(a) of the Administrative Code
obligations.quote: "Social adult day care" has the same meaning as set forth in section two hundred fifteen of the elder law and any regulations promulgated by the director of the office for the aging pursuant to such section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Prescribe registration forms and maintain a registration system for social adult day care entities.
obligations.quote: Registration shall include registrant's name, address, corporate structure and ownership, and other information as the department may require and shall be filed on forms to be prescribed by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Adopt rules establishing civil penalties for violations of social adult day care standards and specifying which violations are subject to penalty.
obligations.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing civil penalties of not less than two hundred fifty dollars per day and not more than five hundred dollars per day to be assessed against social adult day cares for violations of subdivision a and any regulations promulgated thereunder.
obligations.deadline_text: 12 months after its enactment into law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Designate an ombudsperson to receive and investigate complaints regarding social adult day care facilities.
obligations.quote: The department shall designate an ombudsperson whose duties shall include, but not be limited to: (i) establishing a system to receive comments and complaints with respect to any social adult day care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Request a list from the state department of health at least once annually of providers operating social adult day cares within the city.
obligations.quote: requesting a list from the state department of health at least once annually of providers operating social adult day cares within the city of New York and the street address of each such social adult day care
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Investigate complaints and information regarding social adult day care facilities for violations of program standards and participant rights.
obligations.quote: investigating complaints received pursuant to subparagraph (i) of this paragraph or based on any information known to the department related to a social adult day care that may be in violation of the provisions of subdivision a of this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Make available on its website the contact information of the ombudsperson.
obligations.quote: The department shall make available on its website the contact information of the ombudsperson as well as a statement indicating that any person may contact such ombudsperson with a comment or complaint regarding any social adult day care.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Provide a written annual report to the council regarding social adult day cares, including total number of facilities, complaints, investigations, notices of violation, and recommendations.
obligations.quote: Not later than January 1, 2016 and annually thereafter, the ombudsperson shall provide a written report to the council regarding social adult day cares.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than January 1, 2016 and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Designate one or more city agencies to issue notices of violation for social adult day care violations and provide written notice to the council of such designation.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall designate one or more city agencies to issue notices of violation pursuant to subdivision c of section 21-204 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section two of this local law and provide written notice to the council of such designation within 30 days of the enactment of this local law.
obligations.deadline_text: within 30 days of the enactment of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.action_summary: Take all necessary action, including promulgation of rules, prior to the 180-day effective date of this local law.
obligations.quote: the department shall take all necessary action, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating social adult day care.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules setting forth the form and manner of written certification of microchipping compliance that pet shops, animal rescue groups, and non-profit rescue groups must provide to purchasers.
obligations.quote: written certification of compliance with paragraphs one and two of this subdivision, signed by such purchaser as acknowledgement of receipt, in a form and manner set forth in rules promulgated by the department
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to microchipping animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Take such measures as are necessary for implementation of the microchipping requirements, including promulgation of rules.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall take such measures as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to microchipping animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing the form and manner for veterinarians to provide certificates stating the date sterilization was performed on dogs and cats.
obligations.quote: Such veterinarian shall provide to the pet shop a certificate, in such form and manner as determined by rules promulgated by the department, stating the date on which such sterilization was performed.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the spaying, neutering and licensing of animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing the maintenance and availability of pet shop records of sales, sterilization procedures, veterinarian letters and certificates.
obligations.quote: Every pet shop, in accordance with rules promulgated by the department, shall maintain records of all sales of dogs and cats, sterilization procedures performed at the request of the pet shop, and veterinarian letters and certificates received, and shall retain such records, letters and certificates for a period of five years. Such records, letters, and certificates shall be made available to the department according to rules promulgated by the department.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the spaying, neutering and licensing of animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Take measures necessary for implementation of the local law, including promulgation of all required rules.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall take such measures as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the spaying, neutering and licensing of animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Furnish forms for pet shops to report monthly on all dogs sold and adopted, including licensing application status and purchaser/adopter information.
obligations.quote: Every pet shop shall, on at least a monthly basis, report to the department on a form furnished by the department all dogs which have been sold and adopted
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the spaying, neutering and licensing of animals sold in pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules and prescribe forms necessary to carry out the pet shop permit and regulatory provisions of this local law.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules and prescribe such forms as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this subchapter.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective dates
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Issue, renew, suspend, or revoke pet shop permits in accordance with the application, conditions, and violation standards established in this subchapter.
obligations.quote: No person shall operate a pet shop without a permit issued by the commissioner pursuant to this subchapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Develop and furnish application forms for pet shop permits and renewals as required by applicants.
obligations.quote: An application for a permit required pursuant to section 17-372 of this title or for the renewal of such a permit shall be made and submitted on forms furnished by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of pet shop source certifications by electronic means.
obligations.quote: The department may promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of such certifications by use of electronic means.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Inspect and review records maintained by pet shops pursuant to section 17-1704 of this title.
obligations.quote: The department may inspect the records maintained pursuant to section 17-1704 of this title.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Order cessation of pet shop operations when the department determines a business is being operated without the required permit.
obligations.quote: When the department determines that a business or activity regulated by this subchapter is being operated or conducted without the permit required by this section, the commissioner or his or her designee may order the person operating the business or conducting the activity to cease and desist from such business or activity.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Enforce cease-and-desist orders through measures including sealing and padlocking premises after providing opportunity for hearing.
obligations.quote: If the business or activity ordered to cease and desist continues without the required permit, the commissioner or his or her designee may, after providing an opportunity for the person operating such business or conducting such activity to be heard at the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner, take any measure authorized by applicable law to enforce an order to cease and desist. Such measures may include, but are not limited to, ordering and arranging for the premises to be sealed and padlocked.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Enforce cease-and-desist orders in exigent circumstances without prior hearing, followed by prompt post-enforcement hearing.
obligations.quote: If the commissioner determines that exigent circumstances exist such that the continued operation of the business or activity would pose an danger to the public or the health and welfare of the animals in the custody of the business, the commissioner may take any measure authorized by applicable law to enforce an order to cease and desist, subject to a prompt post-enforcement hearing at the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Deny issuance or renewal of a pet shop permit if department records show uncorrected violations or unpaid fines, penalties, or forfeitures.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall not issue or renew a permit unless department records show there are no finally determined uncorrected violations or unpaid outstanding fines, penalties or forfeitures imposed by any court, administrative tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings or administrative tribunal established in accordance with the administrative code or the charter, which are due and payable by the applicant or the permittee.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Deny issuance of a new permit to any person listed on the animal abuse registry created pursuant to chapter sixteen of this title.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall not issue a new permit or renewal of an existing permit to any person listed on the animal abuse registry created pursuant to chapter sixteen of this title.
affected_groups: persons convicted of animal abuse crimes
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Deny a new permit for a change of business ownership unless the applicant provides proof of an arm's length transaction.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall not issue a new permit to any entity based on a sale or change of ownership of a permitted business or activity regulated by laws or rules enforced by the department, where department or other records show any finally determined uncorrected violations or unpaid fines and penalties, unless the applicant submits proof satisfactory to the department that the transfer of the business was the result of an arm's length transaction.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Suspend or revoke a pet shop permit upon willful or continued violation of title seventeen, rules, health code, acceptance of bribes, submission of forged documents, or poor moral character.
obligations.quote: the commissioner, after due notice and an opportunity to be heard by the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner, may suspend or revoke a pet shop permit upon the occurrence of any one or more of the following conditions:
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Suspend a permit without prior hearing in exigent circumstances where continued operation poses danger to the public or animal health and welfare, subject to prompt post-suspension hearing.
obligations.quote: Notwithstanding subdivision a of this section, if the commissioner determines that exigent circumstances exist such that the continued operation of a permittee's pet shop would pose a danger to the public or the health and welfare of the animals in the permittee's custody, the commissioner may suspend such permittee's permit subject to a prompt post-suspension hearing before the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Issue an order revoking, further suspending, or reinstating a pet shop permit following a hearing, adopting all or part of the tribunal report and recommendations.
obligations.quote: Following a hearing required pursuant to this section and the receipt of a copy of the report and recommendations of the tribunal before which such hearing was held, the commissioner may take such action as may be necessary, adopting all or part of the report and recommendations, and may issue an order revoking the permit, further suspending the permit, or reinstating the permit subject to whatever conditions the commissioner deems necessary for the continued safe operation of the permitted business.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Seize revoked permits that are not surrendered by the permittee.
obligations.quote: Permits or licenses that are not surrendered in accordance with this section may be seized by any authorized employee or agent of the department or officer of the police department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Seize animals in pet shops operating without a required permit.
obligations.quote: The commissioner or his or her designee may seize any animal in a pet shop operating without a permit required pursuant to section 17-372 of this subchapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Provide appropriate disposition of seized animals, including impoundment at animal shelters or non-profit rescues.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide for the appropriate disposition of each animal seized pursuant to this section. Such disposition may include impoundment at an animal shelter or non-profit rescue as such terms are defined in section 17-1701 of chapter seventeen of this title.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Impose a fee on pet shop owners representing expenses incurred in impounding seized animals.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may impose upon the owner of a pet shop from which an animal is seized pursuant to this section a fee representing expenses incurred in connection with impounding such animal.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of pet shop recordkeeping and certification by electronic means.
obligations.quote: Consistent with the New York state technology law, the department may promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of such records and documentation by use of electronic means.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Prescribe a standardized form for the written statement containing required information for purchasers of cats and dogs.
obligations.quote: Every pet shop shall deliver to the purchaser of a cat or dog, at the time of sale, or to the prospective purchaser of a cat or dog upon request, in a standardized form prescribed by the commissioner, a written statement containing the following information:
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules regarding reimbursement for copying expenses of United States Department of Agriculture inspection reports provided to prospective purchasers.
obligations.quote: At the request of such prospective purchaser, such pet shop shall provide physical copies of such inspection reports, provided however, that such pet shop may require reimbursement for copying expenses pursuant to rules promulgated by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Determine which recordkeeping by pet shops shall be required in accordance with rules promulgated by the department.
obligations.quote: Such other records and documentation as deemed necessary by the commissioner in accordance with rules promulgated by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Seize animals offered for sale in pet shops in violation of the prohibited sales requirements of section 17-1702.
obligations.quote: The commissioner or his or her designee may seize any animal offered for sale in a pet shop where the sale of such animal is prohibited by section 17-1702 of this chapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Provide appropriate disposition of seized animals in violation of prohibited sales standards, including impoundment at animal shelters or non-profit rescues.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide for the appropriate disposition of each animal seized pursuant to this section. Such disposition may include impoundment at an animal shelter or non-profit rescue group.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Impose a fee on pet shop owners representing expenses incurred in impounding animals seized for violation of prohibited sales standards.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may impose upon the owner of a pet shop from which an animal is seized pursuant to this section a fee representing expenses incurred in connection with the cost of impounding such animal.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary to carry out the provisions of chapter 17 and to ensure the health and safety of animals in pet shops.
obligations.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter and to ensure the health and safety of any animal in a pet shop.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective dates
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

obligations.action_summary: Take all actions necessary to implement this local law, including promulgation of rules, on or before the effective date.
obligations.quote: the commissioner of buildings may take all actions necessary to implement this local law, including the promulgation of rules, on or before such effective date
obligations.deadline_text: on or before such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

obligations.action_summary: Examine construction documents and determine whether they comply with the New York City Energy Conservation Code and other pertinent laws and regulations.
obligations.quote: the department shall examine or cause to be examined the accompanying construction documents and shall ascertain by such examinations whether the construction indicated and described is in accordance with the requirements of this code
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

obligations.action_summary: Perform or cause to be performed progress inspections and final inspections as required by the New York City Energy Conservation Code and department rules.
obligations.quote: inspections required by this code or by the department during the progress of work may be performed on behalf of the owner by an approved agency. All inspections shall be performed at the sole cost and expense of the owner
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

obligations.action_summary: Require submittal of an evaluation report for prefabricated construction assemblies with concealed mechanical work before issuance of a work permit.
obligations.quote: the department shall require the submittal of an evaluation report by the manufacturer or approved agency on each prefabricated construction assembly, indicating the complete details of the mechanical system
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

obligations.action_summary: Approve or disapprove alternate materials, methods of construction, designs or insulating systems that meet the intent of the code and achieve equivalent or greater energy savings.
obligations.quote: such material, method of construction, design or insulating system has been approved by the commissioner as (1) meeting the intent of this code, (2) achieving energy savings that are equivalent to or greater than would be achieved using prescribed materials
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

obligations.action_summary: Allow temporary connection of installations to energy sources for testing or operation under temporary certificates of occupancy.

obligations.quote: By such date, the department of education shall submit a report to the speaker of the council that describes the results of the evaluation conducted pursuant to this subdivision, including, but not limited to, a list of the school buildings where the installation of door alarms has been deemed to be an appropriate safety measure and a timeline for such installation.
obligations.deadline_text: By such date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to door alarms in school buildings.

obligations.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the speaker of the council regarding training on student safety protocols for department personnel.
obligations.quote: Not later than May thirtieth, two thousand fifteen, and annually thereafter, the department of education shall submit to the speaker of the council a report regarding training on student safety protocols for department of education personnel.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than May thirtieth, two thousand fifteen, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to door alarms in school buildings.

obligations.action_summary: Designate an agency to administer the New York City identity card program.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall designate an agency to administer the New York city identity card program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Promulgate all rules necessary to effectuate the purposes of the New York City identity card program.
obligations.quote: The administering agency shall promulgate all rules necessary to effectuate the purposes of this subchapter.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Designate access sites, including at least one site in each of the five boroughs, where applications for the card shall be made available for pick-up and submission.
obligations.quote: The administering agency shall designate access sites, including at least one site located within each of the five boroughs of the city of New York, where applications for such card shall be made available for pick-up and submission.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Make applications for the New York City identity card available online.
obligations.quote: The administering agency shall also make applications available online.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Destroy copies of records provided by applicants to prove identity or residency that have been retained more than two years, once every quarter.
obligations.quote: Once every quarter the city shall destroy copies of records provided by applicants to prove identity or residency for a New York city identity card that have been retained more than two years, except where such records are required by law to be preserved as evidence for purposes of litigation.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Review data collected in the quarterly report and make a determination regarding the continuing need to retain records in order to effectively administer the program.
obligations.quote: On or before December 31, 2016, the administering agency shall review data collected in the report described in subdivision h of this section and make a determination regarding the continuing need to retain records pursuant to paragraph one of this subdivision in order to effectively administer the New York city identity card program and shall make any appropriate modifications to the policy for retention of records related to the New York city identity card program.
obligations.deadline_text: On or before December 31, 2016
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Destroy records provided by applicants to prove identity or residency if the administering agency fails to make a determination by December 31, 2016, or determines records retention is no longer necessary.
obligations.quote: In the event that: (i) the administering agency fails to make a determination on or before December 31, 2016 pursuant to paragraph (2) of this subdivision, or (ii) the administering agency determines that records retention is no longer necessary, then the city shall not retain originals or copies of records provided by an applicant to prove identity or residency for a New York city identity card for longer than the time needed to review the application, and any such records in the city's possession prior to such date shall be destroyed on or before December 31, 2016 or, in the case of an application pending on such date, as soon as practicable after a final determination has been made regarding the application.
obligations.deadline_text: on or before December 31, 2016
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Accept the New York City identity card as proof of identity and residency for access to city services, unless prohibited by law or additional documentation is required.
obligations.quote: All city agencies shall accept such card as proof of identity and residency for access to city services unless (i) such acceptance is prohibited by federal or state law, (ii) additional documentation is required to obtain the benefits of a federal or state program, or (iii) the agency has reasonable grounds to believe that the card is counterfeit, altered, or improperly issued, or the individual presenting the card is not the individual to whom the card was issued.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Seek to encourage eligible persons to apply for the card and expand the benefits associated with the card, including promoting acceptance by banks and other public and private institutions.
obligations.quote: The city shall seek to encourage eligible persons to apply for the card and expand the benefits associated with the card, including, at a minimum, by promoting acceptance of the card by banks and other public and private institutions.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Identify and implement measures, including staff training, community outreach, and language assistance tools, to address the needs of limited English proficient individuals.
obligations.quote: The administering agency, in consultation with the mayor's office of immigrant affairs, shall identify and implement measures, including but not limited to staff training, community outreach, and language assistance tools, to address the needs of limited English proficient individuals in the administration of the New York city identity card program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
obligations.action_summary: Prepare and submit to the mayor and speaker of the city council a comprehensive report on the New York City identity card program including application numbers, issuance statistics, agency requests for information, fraud incidents, and outreach efforts.
obligations.quote: The administering agency shall prepare and submit to the mayor and the speaker of the city council a report on the New York city identity card program that includes the following information: (1) the number of applications received by the city for the New York city identity card disaggregated by applicant borough of residency; (2) the number of New York city identity cards issued; (3) the number of New York city identity cards issued to minors; (4) the number of requests made by city agencies for information collected about applicants for the New York city identity card disaggregated by requesting agency; (5) the number of times the administering agency shared documents submitted by applicants to establish eligibility for the New York city identity card with other city agencies disaggregated by agency; (6) the number of denials made to requesting agencies for information collected about applicants for the New York city identity card; (7) the number of New York city identity card applicants whose information was disclosed to law enforcement, disaggregated by whether such disclosure was pursuant to a judicial warrant or judicial subpoena; (8) the number of occurrences of fraud or other criminal activity related to issuance of the New York city identity card; (9) the city's efforts to conduct outreach to prospective applicants relating to the New York city identity card program; (10) the city's efforts to promote acceptance of the New York city identity card by banks and other public and private institutions; (11) the types of services, other than city services, for which the New York city identity card is permitted as acceptable proof of identity and residency; and (12) any other metric the administering agency deems appropriate, including but not limited to additional measures of fraudulent or other criminal activity related to the New York city identity card program.
obligations.deadline_text: on March 31, 2015 and every three months thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a New York city identity card program.

obligations.action_summary: Waive application, permit, and inspection fees for work officially approved and funded under the Build It Back program on residential property and residential portions of mixed-use buildings.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall waive fees, which would otherwise be required to be paid to the department by this code, the electrical code or the rules of the department, in connection with applications, permits and inspections for work that is officially approved and funded under the Build It Back program.

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the council and post on the department's website an annual report on all co-located schools including demographic and academic performance information.
obligations.quote: Not later than the thirtieth day of August of the year 2015 and annually thereafter, the department shall submit to the council and post on the department's website a report regarding information on all co-located schools
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than the thirtieth day of August of the year 2015 and annually thereafter

obligations.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
obligations.action_summary: Provide a quarterly report to the council on the number of crashes involving commission-licensed vehicles, disaggregated by vehicle type and whether critical injury or death resulted.
obligations.quote: the commission shall for the prior quarter provide a report to the council and shall post on its website, the number of crashes involving a vehicle licensed by the commission. Such report shall disaggregate such crashes by the type of commission licensed vehicle and by whether critical injury or death resulted from such crashes.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the New York city taxi and limousine commission's critical drivers and persistent violators programs.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the New York city taxi and limousine commission's critical drivers and persistent violators programs.

obligations.action_summary: Review the results of the police department's investigation and the fitness of the driver to operate a licensed vehicle following any crash involving a licensed driver operating a licensed vehicle where critical injury or death resulted.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to taxi and limousine commission review of crashes.

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing summary suspensions and revocations of driver licenses for serious crashes involving critical injury or death.
obligations.quote: the taxi and limousine commission shall take all necessary action, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date.
obligations.deadline_text: prior to such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to traffic violations and serious crashes.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Study arterial streets and make recommendations on how such streets may be designed to minimize the risk of traffic crashes and critical injury or death resulting from such crashes.
obligations.quote: the department shall study arterial streets as defined herein and make recommendations as to how such streets may be designed to minimize the risk of traffic crashes and to minimize the risk of critical injury or death resulting from such crashes.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to safer arterial streets.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Establish not less than seven neighborhood slow zones annually, each containing not less than five blocks, in which speed limits of twenty miles per hour apply.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall establish not less than seven neighborhood slow zones, which shall contain not less than five blocks per zone, annually in the years 2014 and 2015.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Provide to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, an annual report listing the location of all neighborhood slow zones and reviewing their effectiveness in minimizing traffic crashes, critical injuries, or death.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall provide to the mayor and speaker of the council, and shall post on the department's website, a report listing the location of all neighborhood slow zones. This report shall include, but not be limited to, a review of whether such zones have minimized the risk of traffic crashes, critical injuries or death
obligations.deadline_text: Commencing on or before February 1, 2015, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Establish speed limits of not less than fifteen nor more than twenty miles per hour at fifty school locations annually, for a distance not to exceed one thousand three hundred twenty feet on highways passing school buildings, entrances, or exits.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall establish speed limits of not less than fifteen nor more than twenty miles per hour at fifty school locations annually, for a distance not to exceed one thousand three hundred twenty feet, on highways passing any school building, entrance or exit of a school abutting on the highway.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Inform the mayor and speaker of the council in writing if speed limits will be established at fewer than fifty school locations within a year, including the reason for such determination.
obligations.quote: Should the commissioner determine that such speed limits will be established at fewer than fifty school locations within a year, the commissioner shall inform the mayor and the speaker of the council in writing of such determination and the reason therefore.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Inform the mayor and speaker of the council in writing when, after evaluating every school in the city, the commissioner determines not to establish any further speed limits near schools, and continue to evaluate the need to establish such speed limits after such notice.
obligations.quote: After evaluating every school in the city for the establishment of such speed limits, the commissioner may determine not to establish any further such speed limits and shall inform the mayor and the speaker of the council in writing and shall continue to evaluate the need to establish such speed limits after such notice is given.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Provide to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, an annual list of all locations where speed limits have been established near schools.

obligations.deadline_text: Commencing on or before February 1, 2015, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing neighborhood slow zones and speed limits near schools.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a review of guidelines and best practices with regard to work zone safety on bridges under the department's jurisdiction.

obligations.deadline_text: upon completion
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to work zone safety on bridges.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Maintain a log of notices regarding priority regulatory signs and traffic control signals that are missing or damaged, including the date and time the notice was received and the date and time of repair, replacement, or determination that repair was not warranted.
obligations.quote: The department shall maintain a log of notices regarding priority regulatory signs and traffic control signals that are missing or damaged to the extent that any such sign or signal is not operational, visible or legible to a motorist who must obey or rely upon such sign or signal.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to traffic control signals.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Repair or replace a missing or damaged traffic control signal, implement alternative traffic control measures if repair will take longer than twenty-four hours, or make a determination that repair or replacement is not warranted.
obligations.quote: Within twenty-four hours of receiving notice that a traffic control signal is missing or damaged to the extent that such signal is not operational or visible to a motorist who must obey or rely upon such signal the department shall: (i) repair or replace such signal, (ii)implement alternative measures to control traffic if such repair or replacement will take greater than twenty-four hours, or (iii) make a determination that repair or replacement is not warranted.
obligations.deadline_text: Within twenty-four hours of receiving notice that a traffic control signal is missing or damaged
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to traffic control signals.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Study means of enhancing the safety of pedestrians and bicyclists where motor vehicles make left turns, and develop a comprehensive plan that considers design modifications including removing motor vehicle parking, installing leading pedestrian intervals, designating exclusive left turn lanes, and installing exclusive pedestrian phases.
obligations.quote: the department shall study means of enhancing the safety of pedestrians and bicyclists where motor vehicles make left turns. obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a study on left turns.

obligations.quote: Open streets shall be managed and operated in accordance with this section and rules of the department. In addition to any other requirement, such rules shall provide:
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: On an annual basis, evaluate existing open streets to determine whether any could benefit from additional traffic calming measures and streetscape elements, including conversion to shared streets or pedestrian plazas, bicycle parking, signage, street markings, bollards, tree plantings, parking removal, street furniture, and accessibility improvements.
obligations.quote: On an annual basis, the department shall evaluate existing open streets to determine whether any such open streets could benefit from additional traffic calming measures and streetscape elements, including but not limited to conversion into a shared street or pedestrian plaza, bicycle parking, signage, street markings, bollards or street barriers, tree plantings, parking removal, street furniture and accessibility improvements, to include raising of the street grade.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Prior to the designation of an open street, provide notice to affected council members, community boards and community organizations.
obligations.quote: Prior to the designation of an open street, the department shall provide notice to affected council members, community boards and community organizations.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: On an annual basis, submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report evaluating the open streets program, including recommendations for modifications or expansion.
obligations.quote: On an annual basis, the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report evaluating the open streets program, including any recommendations for modifications or expansion.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Regularly post on the department's website an updated list of open streets, hours of operation and any temporary suspension.
obligations.quote: the department shall regularly post on the department's website an updated list of open streets, hours of operation and any temporary suspension.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the open streets program.
